8477         assert(exp->tokens[*tok_idx] == LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_LOG); 
8478         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, ((options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) || !set->val.bln ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
8479                 lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
8480         ++(*tok_idx); 
8481  
8482         /* lazy evaluation */ 
8483         if ((options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) || ((set->type == LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN) && !set->val.bln)) { 
8484             rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, LYXP_EXPR_AND, set, options | LYXP_SKIP_EXPR); 
8485             LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
8486             continue; 
8487         } 
8488  
8489         set_fill_set(&set2, &orig_set); 
8490         rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, LYXP_EXPR_AND, &set2, options); 
8491         LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
8492  
8493         /* eval - just get boolean value actually */ 
8494         if (set->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) { 
8495             set_scnode_clear_ctx(&set2, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE); 
8496             lyxp_set_scnode_merge(set, &set2); 
8497         } else { 
8498             lyxp_set_cast(&set2, LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN); 
8499             set_fill_set(set, &set2); 
8500         } 
8501     } 
8502  
8503 cleanup: 
8504     lyxp_set_free_content(&orig_set); 
8505     lyxp_set_free_content(&set2); 
8506     return rc; 
8507 } 
8508  
8509 /** 
8510  * @brief Evaluate OrExpr. Logs directly on error. 
8511  * 
8512  * [13] OrExpr ::= AndExpr | OrExpr 'or' AndExpr 
8513  * 
8514  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
8515  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
8516  * @param[in] repeat How many times this expression is repeated. 
8517  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set. 
8518  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
8519  * @return LY_ERR (LY_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when) 
8520  */ 
8521 static LY_ERR 
8522 eval_or_expr(const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, uint16_t repeat, struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
8523 { 
8524     LY_ERR rc; 
8525     struct lyxp_set orig_set, set2; 
8526     uint16_t i; 
8527  
8528     assert(repeat); 
8529  
8530     set_init(&orig_set, set); 
8531     set_init(&set2, set); 
8532  
8533     set_fill_set(&orig_set, set); 
8534  
8535     rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, LYXP_EXPR_OR, set, options); 
8536     LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
8537  
8538     /* cast to boolean, we know that will be the final result */ 
8539     if (!(options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) && (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL)) { 
8540         set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE); 
8541     } else { 
8542         lyxp_set_cast(set, LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN); 
8543     } 
8544  
8545     /* ('or' AndExpr)* */ 
8546     for (i = 0; i < repeat; ++i) { 
8547         assert(exp->tokens[*tok_idx] == LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_LOG); 
8548         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, ((options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) || set->val.bln ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
8549                 lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
8550         ++(*tok_idx); 
8551  
8552         /* lazy evaluation */ 
8553         if ((options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) || ((set->type == LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN) && set->val.bln)) { 
8554             rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, LYXP_EXPR_OR, set, options | LYXP_SKIP_EXPR); 
8555             LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
8556             continue; 
8557         } 
8558  
8559         set_fill_set(&set2, &orig_set); 
8560         /* expr_type cound have been LYXP_EXPR_NONE in all these later calls (except for the first one), 
8561          * but it does not matter */ 
8562         rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, LYXP_EXPR_OR, &set2, options); 
8563         LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
8564  
8565         /* eval - just get boolean value actually */ 
8566         if (set->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) { 
8567             set_scnode_clear_ctx(&set2, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE); 
8568             lyxp_set_scnode_merge(set, &set2); 
8569         } else { 
8570             lyxp_set_cast(&set2, LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN); 
8571             set_fill_set(set, &set2); 
8572         } 
8573     } 
8574  
8575 cleanup: 
8576     lyxp_set_free_content(&orig_set); 
8577     lyxp_set_free_content(&set2); 
8578     return rc; 
8579 } 
8580  
8581 /** 
8582  * @brief Decide what expression is at the pointer @p tok_idx and evaluate it accordingly. 
8583  * 
8584  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
8585  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
8586  * @param[in] etype Expression type to evaluate. 
8587  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set. 
8588  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
8589  * @return LY_ERR (LY_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when) 
8590  */ 
8591 static LY_ERR 
8592 eval_expr_select(const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, enum lyxp_expr_type etype, struct lyxp_set *set, 
8593         uint32_t options) 
8594 { 
8595     uint16_t i, count; 
8596     enum lyxp_expr_type next_etype; 
8597     LY_ERR rc; 
8598  
8599     /* process operator repeats */ 
8600     if (!exp->repeat[*tok_idx]) { 
8601         next_etype = LYXP_EXPR_NONE; 
8602     } else { 
8603         /* find etype repeat */ 
8604         for (i = 0; exp->repeat[*tok_idx][i] > etype; ++i) {} 
8605  
8606         /* select one-priority lower because etype expression called us */ 
8607         if (i) { 
8608             next_etype = exp->repeat[*tok_idx][i - 1]; 
8609             /* count repeats for that expression */ 
8610             for (count = 0; i && exp->repeat[*tok_idx][i - 1] == next_etype; ++count, --i) {} 
8611         } else { 
8612             next_etype = LYXP_EXPR_NONE; 
8613         } 
8614     } 
8615  
8616     /* decide what expression are we parsing based on the repeat */ 
8617     switch (next_etype) { 
8618     case LYXP_EXPR_OR: 
8619         rc = eval_or_expr(exp, tok_idx, count, set, options); 
8620         break; 
8621     case LYXP_EXPR_AND: 
8622         rc = eval_and_expr(exp, tok_idx, count, set, options); 
8623         break; 
8624     case LYXP_EXPR_EQUALITY: 
8625         rc = eval_equality_expr(exp, tok_idx, count, set, options); 
8626         break; 
8627     case LYXP_EXPR_RELATIONAL: 
8628         rc = eval_relational_expr(exp, tok_idx, count, set, options); 
8629         break; 
8630     case LYXP_EXPR_ADDITIVE: 
8631         rc = eval_additive_expr(exp, tok_idx, count, set, options); 
8632         break; 
8633     case LYXP_EXPR_MULTIPLICATIVE: 
8634         rc = eval_multiplicative_expr(exp, tok_idx, count, set, options); 
8635         break; 
8636     case LYXP_EXPR_UNARY: 
8637         rc = eval_unary_expr(exp, tok_idx, count, set, options); 
8638         break; 
8639     case LYXP_EXPR_UNION: 
8640         rc = eval_union_expr(exp, tok_idx, count, set, options); 
8641         break; 
8642     case LYXP_EXPR_NONE: 
8643         rc = eval_path_expr(exp, tok_idx, set, options); 
8644         break; 
8645     default: 
8646         LOGINT_RET(set->ctx); 
8647     } 
8648  
8649     return rc; 
8650 } 
8651  
8652 /** 
8653  * @brief Get root type. 
8654  * 
8655  * @param[in] ctx_node Context node. 
8656  * @param[in] ctx_scnode Schema context node. 
8657  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
8658  * @return Root type. 
8659  */ 
8660 static enum lyxp_node_type 
8661 lyxp_get_root_type(const struct lyd_node *ctx_node, const struct lysc_node *ctx_scnode, uint32_t options) 
8662 { 
8663     const struct lysc_node *op; 
8664  
8665     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
8666         /* schema */ 
8667         for (op = ctx_scnode; op && !(op->nodetype & (LYS_RPC | LYS_ACTION | LYS_NOTIF)); op = op->parent) {} 
8668  
8669         if (op || (options & LYXP_SCNODE)) { 
8670             /* general root that can access everything */ 
8671             return LYXP_NODE_ROOT; 
8672         } else if (!ctx_scnode || (ctx_scnode->flags & LYS_CONFIG_W)) { 
8673             /* root context node can access only config data (because we said so, it is unspecified) */ 
8674             return LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG; 
8675         } 
8676         return LYXP_NODE_ROOT; 
8677     } 
8678  
8679     /* data */ 
8680     op = ctx_node ? ctx_node->schema : NULL; 
8681     for ( ; op && !(op->nodetype & (LYS_RPC | LYS_ACTION | LYS_NOTIF)); op = op->parent) {} 
8682  
8683     if (op || !(options & LYXP_SCHEMA)) { 
8684         /* general root that can access everything */ 
8685         return LYXP_NODE_ROOT; 
8686     } else if (!ctx_node || !ctx_node->schema || (ctx_node->schema->flags & LYS_CONFIG_W)) { 
8687         /* root context node can access only config data (because we said so, it is unspecified) */ 
8688         return LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG; 
8689     } 
8690     return LYXP_NODE_ROOT; 
8691 } 
8692  
8693 LY_ERR 
8694 lyxp_eval(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, const struct lyxp_expr *exp, const struct lys_module *cur_mod, 
8695         LY_VALUE_FORMAT format, void *prefix_data, const struct lyd_node *ctx_node, const struct lyd_node *tree, 
8696         const struct lyxp_var *vars, struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
8697 { 
8698     uint16_t tok_idx = 0; 
8699     LY_ERR rc; 
8700  
8701     LY_CHECK_ARG_RET(ctx, ctx, exp, set, LY_EINVAL); 
8702     if (!cur_mod && ((format == LY_VALUE_SCHEMA) || (format == LY_VALUE_SCHEMA_RESOLVED))) { 
8703         LOGARG(NULL, "Current module must be set if schema format is used."); 
8704         return LY_EINVAL; 
8705     } 
8706  
8707     if (tree) { 
8708         /* adjust the pointer to be the first top-level sibling */ 
8709         while (tree->parent) { 
8710             tree = lyd_parent(tree); 
8711         } 
8712         tree = lyd_first_sibling(tree); 
8713     } 
8714  
8715     /* prepare set for evaluation */ 
8716     memset(set, 0, sizeof *set); 
8717     set->type = LYXP_SET_NODE_SET; 
8718     set->root_type = lyxp_get_root_type(ctx_node, NULL, options); 
8719     set_insert_node(set, (struct lyd_node *)ctx_node, 0, ctx_node ? LYXP_NODE_ELEM : set->root_type, 0); 
8720  
8721     set->ctx = (struct ly_ctx *)ctx; 
8722     set->cur_node = ctx_node; 
8723     for (set->context_op = ctx_node ? ctx_node->schema : NULL; 
8724             set->context_op && !(set->context_op->nodetype & (LYS_RPC | LYS_ACTION | LYS_NOTIF)); 
8725             set->context_op = set->context_op->parent) {} 
8726     set->tree = tree; 
8727     set->cur_mod = cur_mod; 
8728     set->format = format; 
8729     set->prefix_data = prefix_data; 
8730     set->vars = vars; 
8731  
8732     LOG_LOCSET(NULL, set->cur_node, NULL, NULL); 
8733  
8734     /* evaluate */ 
8735     rc = eval_expr_select(exp, &tok_idx, 0, set, options); 
8736     if (rc != LY_SUCCESS) { 
8737         lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
8738     } 
8739  
8740     if (set->cur_node) { 
8741         LOG_LOCBACK(0, 1, 0, 0); 
8742     } 
8743     return rc; 
8744 }

8750 void

8844 LY_ERR 
8845 lyxp_set_cast(struct lyxp_set *set, enum lyxp_set_type target) 
8846 { 
8847     long double num; 
8848     char *str; 
8849     LY_ERR rc; 
8850  
8851     if (!set || (set->type == target)) { 
8852         return LY_SUCCESS; 
8853     } 
8854  
8855     /* it's not possible to convert anything into a node set */ 
8856     assert(target != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET); 
8857  
8858     if (set->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) { 
8859         lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
8860         return LY_EINVAL; 
8861     } 
8862  
8863     /* to STRING */ 
8864     if ((target == LYXP_SET_STRING) || ((target == LYXP_SET_NUMBER) && (set->type == LYXP_SET_NODE_SET))) { 
8865         switch (set->type) { 
8866         case LYXP_SET_NUMBER: 
8867             if (isnan(set->val.num)) { 
8868                 set->val.str = strdup("NaN"); 
8869                 LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!set->val.str, LOGMEM(set->ctx), -1); 
8870             } else if ((set->val.num == 0) || (set->val.num == -0.0f)) { 
8871                 set->val.str = strdup("0"); 
8872                 LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!set->val.str, LOGMEM(set->ctx), -1); 
8873             } else if (isinf(set->val.num) && !signbit(set->val.num)) { 
8874                 set->val.str = strdup("Infinity"); 
8875                 LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!set->val.str, LOGMEM(set->ctx), -1); 
8876             } else if (isinf(set->val.num) && signbit(set->val.num)) { 
8877                 set->val.str = strdup("-Infinity"); 
8878                 LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!set->val.str, LOGMEM(set->ctx), -1); 
8879             } else if ((long long)set->val.num == set->val.num) { 
8880                 if (asprintf(&str, "%lld", (long long)set->val.num) == -1) { 
8881                     LOGMEM_RET(set->ctx); 
8882                 } 
8883                 set->val.str = str; 
8884             } else { 
8885                 if (asprintf(&str, "%03.1Lf", set->val.num) == -1) { 
8886                     LOGMEM_RET(set->ctx); 
8887                 } 
8888                 set->val.str = str; 
8889             } 
8890             break; 
8891         case LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN: 
8892             if (set->val.bln) { 
8893                 set->val.str = strdup("true"); 
8894             } else { 
8895                 set->val.str = strdup("false"); 
8896             } 
8897             LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!set->val.str, LOGMEM(set->ctx), LY_EMEM); 
8898             break; 
8899         case LYXP_SET_NODE_SET: 
8900             /* we need the set sorted, it affects the result */ 
8901             assert(!set_sort(set)); 
8902  
8903             rc = cast_node_set_to_string(set, &str); 
8904             LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
8905             lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
8906             set->val.str = str; 
8907             break; 
8908         default: 
8909             LOGINT_RET(set->ctx); 
8910         } 
8911         set->type = LYXP_SET_STRING; 
8912     } 
8913  
8914     /* to NUMBER */ 
8915     if (target == LYXP_SET_NUMBER) { 
8916         switch (set->type) { 
8917         case LYXP_SET_STRING: 
8918             num = cast_string_to_number(set->val.str); 
8919             lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
8920             set->val.num = num; 
8921             break; 
8922         case LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN: 
8923             if (set->val.bln) { 
8924                 set->val.num = 1; 
8925             } else { 
8926                 set->val.num = 0; 
8927             } 
8928             break; 
8929         default: 
8930             LOGINT_RET(set->ctx); 
8931         } 
8932         set->type = LYXP_SET_NUMBER; 
8933     } 
8934  
8935     /* to BOOLEAN */ 
8936     if (target == LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN) { 
8937         switch (set->type) { 
8938         case LYXP_SET_NUMBER: 
8939             if ((set->val.num == 0) || (set->val.num == -0.0f) || isnan(set->val.num)) { 
8940                 set->val.bln = 0; 
8941             } else { 
8942                 set->val.bln = 1; 
8943             } 
8944             break; 
8945         case LYXP_SET_STRING: 
8946             if (set->val.str[0]) { 
8947                 lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
8948                 set->val.bln = 1; 
8949             } else { 
8950                 lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
8951                 set->val.bln = 0; 
8952             } 
8953             break; 
8954         case LYXP_SET_NODE_SET: 
8955             if (set->used) { 
8956                 lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
8957                 set->val.bln = 1; 
8958             } else { 
8959                 lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
8960                 set->val.bln = 0; 
8961             } 
8962             break; 
8963         default: 
8964             LOGINT_RET(set->ctx); 
8965         } 
8966         set->type = LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN; 
8967     } 
8968  
8969     return LY_SUCCESS; 
8970 } 
8971  
8972 LY_ERR 
8973 lyxp_atomize(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, const struct lyxp_expr *exp, const struct lys_module *cur_mod, 
8974         LY_VALUE_FORMAT format, void *prefix_data, const struct lysc_node *ctx_scnode, struct lyxp_set *set, 
8975         uint32_t options) 
8976 { 
8977     LY_ERR ret; 
8978     uint16_t tok_idx = 0; 
8979  
8980     LY_CHECK_ARG_RET(ctx, ctx, exp, set, LY_EINVAL); 
8981     if (!cur_mod && ((format == LY_VALUE_SCHEMA) || (format == LY_VALUE_SCHEMA_RESOLVED))) { 
8982         LOGARG(NULL, "Current module must be set if schema format is used."); 
8983         return LY_EINVAL; 
8984     } 
8985  
8986     /* prepare set for evaluation */ 
8987     memset(set, 0, sizeof *set); 
8988     set->type = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET; 
8989     set->root_type = lyxp_get_root_type(NULL, ctx_scnode, options); 
8990     LY_CHECK_RET(lyxp_set_scnode_insert_node(set, ctx_scnode, ctx_scnode ? LYXP_NODE_ELEM : set->root_type, NULL)); 
8991     set->val.scnodes[0].in_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_START; 
8992  
8993     set->ctx = (struct ly_ctx *)ctx; 
8994     set->cur_scnode = ctx_scnode; 
8995     for (set->context_op = ctx_scnode; 
8996             set->context_op && !(set->context_op->nodetype & (LYS_RPC | LYS_ACTION | LYS_NOTIF)); 
8997             set->context_op = set->context_op->parent) {} 
8998     set->cur_mod = cur_mod; 
8999     set->format = format; 
9000     set->prefix_data = prefix_data; 
9001  
9002     LOG_LOCSET(set->cur_scnode, NULL, NULL, NULL); 
9003  
9004     /* evaluate */ 
9005     ret = eval_expr_select(exp, &tok_idx, 0, set, options); 
9006  
9007     LOG_LOCBACK(1, 0, 0, 0); 
9008     return ret; 
9009 }

9011 LIBYANG_API_DEF const char * 
9012 lyxp_get_expr(const struct lyxp_expr *path) 
9013 { 
9014     if (!path) { 
9015         return NULL; 
9016     } 
9017  
9018     return path->expr; 
9019 }

  51 /* Functions are divided into the following basic classes: 
  52  * 
  53  * (re)parse functions: 
  54  * Parse functions parse the expression into 
  55  * tokens (syntactic analysis). 
  56  * Reparse functions perform semantic analysis 
  57  * (do not save the result, just a check) of 
  58  * the expression and fill repeat indices. 
  59  * 
  60  * warn functions: 
  61  * Warn functions check specific reasonable conditions for schema XPath 
  62  * and print a warning if they are not satisfied. 
  63  * 
  64  * moveto functions: 
  65  * They and only they actually change the context (set). 
  66  * 
  67  * eval functions: 
  68  * They execute a parsed XPath expression on some data subtree. 
  69  */ 
  70  
  71 /** 
  72  * @brief Print the type of an XPath \p set. 
  73  * 
  74  * @param[in] set Set to use. 
  75  * @return Set type string. 
  76  */ 
  77 static const char * 
  78 print_set_type(struct lyxp_set *set) 
  79 { 
  80     switch (set->type) { 
  81     case LYXP_SET_NODE_SET: 
  82         return "node set"; 
  83     case LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET: 
  84         return "schema node set"; 
  85     case LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN: 
  86         return "boolean"; 
  87     case LYXP_SET_NUMBER: 
  88         return "number"; 
  89     case LYXP_SET_STRING: 
  90         return "string"; 
  91     } 
  92  
  93     return NULL; 
  94 } 
  95  
  96 const char * 
  97 lyxp_print_token(enum lyxp_token tok) 
  98 { 
  99     switch (tok) { 
 100     case LYXP_TOKEN_PAR1: 
 101         return "("; 
 102     case LYXP_TOKEN_PAR2: 
 103         return ")"; 
 104     case LYXP_TOKEN_BRACK1: 
 105         return "["; 
 106     case LYXP_TOKEN_BRACK2: 
 107         return "]"; 
 108     case LYXP_TOKEN_DOT: 
 109         return "."; 
 110     case LYXP_TOKEN_DDOT: 
 111         return ".."; 
 112     case LYXP_TOKEN_AT: 
 113         return "@"; 
 114     case LYXP_TOKEN_COMMA: 
 115         return ","; 
 116     case LYXP_TOKEN_NAMETEST: 
 117         return "NameTest"; 
 118     case LYXP_TOKEN_NODETYPE: 
 119         return "NodeType"; 
 120     case LYXP_TOKEN_VARREF: 
 121         return "VariableReference"; 
 122     case LYXP_TOKEN_FUNCNAME: 
 123         return "FunctionName"; 
 124     case LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_LOG: 
 125         return "Operator(Logic)"; 
 126     case LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_EQUAL: 
 127         return "Operator(Equal)"; 
 128     case LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_NEQUAL: 
 129         return "Operator(Non-equal)"; 
 130     case LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_COMP: 
 131         return "Operator(Comparison)"; 
 132     case LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_MATH: 
 133         return "Operator(Math)"; 
 134     case LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_UNI: 
 135         return "Operator(Union)"; 
 136     case LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_PATH: 
 137         return "Operator(Path)"; 
 138     case LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_RPATH: 
 139         return "Operator(Recursive Path)"; 
 140     case LYXP_TOKEN_LITERAL: 
 141         return "Literal"; 
 142     case LYXP_TOKEN_NUMBER: 
 143         return "Number"; 
 144     default: 
 145         LOGINT(NULL); 
 146         return ""; 
 147     } 
 148 }

 150 /** 
 151  * @brief Print the whole expression \p exp to debug output. 
 152  * 
 153  * @param[in] exp Expression to use. 
 154  */ 
 155 static void 
 156 print_expr_struct_debug(const struct lyxp_expr *exp) 
 157 { 
 158 #define MSG_BUFFER_SIZE 128 
 159     char tmp[MSG_BUFFER_SIZE]; 
 160     uint32_t i, j; 
 161  
 162     if (!exp || (ly_ll < LY_LLDBG)) { 
 163         return; 
 164     } 
 165  
 166     LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "expression \"%s\":", exp->expr); 
 167     for (i = 0; i < exp->used; ++i) { 
 168         sprintf(tmp, "\ttoken %s, in expression \"%.*s\"", lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[i]), exp->tok_len[i], 
 169                 &exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[i]]); 
 170         if (exp->repeat && exp->repeat[i]) { 
 171             sprintf(tmp + strlen(tmp), " (repeat %d", exp->repeat[i][0]); 
 172             for (j = 1; exp->repeat[i][j]; ++j) { 
 173                 sprintf(tmp + strlen(tmp), ", %d", exp->repeat[i][j]); 
 174             } 
 175             strcat(tmp, ")"); 
 176         } 
 177         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, tmp); 
 178     } 
 179 #undef MSG_BUFFER_SIZE 
 180 }

 184 /** 
 185  * @brief Print XPath set content to debug output. 
 186  * 
 187  * @param[in] set Set to print. 
 188  */ 
 189 static void 
 190 print_set_debug(struct lyxp_set *set) 
 191 { 
 192     uint32_t i; 
 193     char *str; 
 194     struct lyxp_set_node *item; 
 195     struct lyxp_set_scnode *sitem; 
 196  
 197     if (ly_ll < LY_LLDBG) { 
 198         return; 
 199     } 
 200  
 201     switch (set->type) { 
 202     case LYXP_SET_NODE_SET: 
 203         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "set NODE SET:"); 
 204         for (i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
 205             item = &set->val.nodes[i]; 
 206  
 207             switch (item->type) { 
 208             case LYXP_NODE_NONE: 
 209                 LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "\t%d (pos %u): NONE", i + 1, item->pos); 
 210                 break; 
 211             case LYXP_NODE_ROOT: 
 212                 LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "\t%d (pos %u): ROOT", i + 1, item->pos); 
 213                 break; 
 214             case LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG: 
 215                 LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "\t%d (pos %u): ROOT CONFIG", i + 1, item->pos); 
 216                 break; 
 217             case LYXP_NODE_ELEM: 
 218                 if ((item->node->schema->nodetype == LYS_LIST) && (lyd_child(item->node)->schema->nodetype == LYS_LEAF)) { 
 219                     LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "\t%d (pos %u): ELEM %s (1st child val: %s)", i + 1, item->pos, 
 220                             item->node->schema->name, lyd_get_value(lyd_child(item->node))); 
 221                 } else if (item->node->schema->nodetype == LYS_LEAFLIST) { 
 222                     LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "\t%d (pos %u): ELEM %s (val: %s)", i + 1, item->pos, 
 223                             item->node->schema->name, lyd_get_value(item->node)); 
 224                 } else { 
 225                     LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "\t%d (pos %u): ELEM %s", i + 1, item->pos, item->node->schema->name); 
 226                 } 
 227                 break; 
 228             case LYXP_NODE_TEXT: 
 229                 if (item->node->schema->nodetype & LYS_ANYDATA) { 
 230                     LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "\t%d (pos %u): TEXT <%s>", i + 1, item->pos, 
 231                             item->node->schema->nodetype == LYS_ANYXML ? "anyxml" : "anydata"); 
 232                 } else { 
 233                     LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "\t%d (pos %u): TEXT %s", i + 1, item->pos, lyd_get_value(item->node)); 
 234                 } 
 235                 break; 
 236             case LYXP_NODE_META: 
 237                 LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "\t%d (pos %u): META %s = %s", i + 1, item->pos, set->val.meta[i].meta->name, 
 238                         set->val.meta[i].meta->value); 
 239                 break; 
 240             } 
 241         } 
 242         break; 
 243  
 244     case LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET: 
 245         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "set SCNODE SET:"); 
 246         for (i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
 247             sitem = &set->val.scnodes[i]; 
 248  
 249             switch (sitem->type) { 
 250             case LYXP_NODE_ROOT: 
 251                 LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "\t%d (%u): ROOT", i + 1, sitem->in_ctx); 
 252                 break; 
 253             case LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG: 
 254                 LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "\t%d (%u): ROOT CONFIG", i + 1, sitem->in_ctx); 
 255                 break; 
 256             case LYXP_NODE_ELEM: 
 257                 LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "\t%d (%u): ELEM %s", i + 1, sitem->in_ctx, sitem->scnode->name); 
 258                 break; 
 259             default: 
 260                 LOGINT(NULL); 
 261                 break; 
 262             } 
 263         } 
 264         break; 
 265  
 266     case LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN: 
 267         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "set BOOLEAN"); 
 268         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "\t%s", (set->val.bln ? "true" : "false")); 
 269         break; 
 270  
 271     case LYXP_SET_STRING: 
 272         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "set STRING"); 
 273         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "\t%s", set->val.str); 
 274         break; 
 275  
 276     case LYXP_SET_NUMBER: 
 277         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "set NUMBER"); 
 278  
 279         if (isnan(set->val.num)) { 
 280             str = strdup("NaN"); 
 281         } else if ((set->val.num == 0) || (set->val.num == -0.0f)) { 
 282             str = strdup("0"); 
 283         } else if (isinf(set->val.num) && !signbit(set->val.num)) { 
 284             str = strdup("Infinity"); 
 285         } else if (isinf(set->val.num) && signbit(set->val.num)) { 
 286             str = strdup("-Infinity"); 
 287         } else if ((long long)set->val.num == set->val.num) { 
 288             if (asprintf(&str, "%lld", (long long)set->val.num) == -1) { 
 289                 str = NULL; 
 290             } 
 291         } else { 
 292             if (asprintf(&str, "%03.1Lf", set->val.num) == -1) { 
 293                 str = NULL; 
 294             } 
 295         } 
 296         LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!str, LOGMEM(NULL), ); 
 297  
 298         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "\t%s", str); 
 299         free(str); 
 300     } 
 301 } 
 302  
 303 #endif

 305 /** 
 306  * @brief Realloc the string \p str. 
 307  * 
 308  * @param[in] ctx libyang context for logging. 
 309  * @param[in] needed How much free space is required. 
 310  * @param[in,out] str Pointer to the string to use. 
 311  * @param[in,out] used Used bytes in \p str. 
 312  * @param[in,out] size Allocated bytes in \p str. 
 313  * @return LY_ERR 
 314  */ 
 315 static LY_ERR 
 316 cast_string_realloc(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, uint16_t needed, char **str, uint16_t *used, uint16_t *size) 
 317 { 
 318     if (*size - *used < needed) { 
 319         do { 
 320             if ((UINT16_MAX - *size) < LYXP_STRING_CAST_SIZE_STEP) { 
 321                 LOGERR(ctx, LY_EINVAL, "XPath string length limit (%u) reached.", UINT16_MAX); 
 322                 return LY_EINVAL; 
 323             } 
 324             *size += LYXP_STRING_CAST_SIZE_STEP; 
 325         } while (*size - *used < needed); 
 326         *str = ly_realloc(*str, *size * sizeof(char)); 
 327         LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!(*str), LOGMEM(ctx), LY_EMEM); 
 328     } 
 329  
 330     return LY_SUCCESS; 
 331 }

 333 /** 
 334  * @brief Cast nodes recursively to one string @p str. 
 335  * 
 336  * @param[in] node Node to cast. 
 337  * @param[in] fake_cont Whether to put the data into a "fake" container. 
 338  * @param[in] root_type Type of the XPath root. 
 339  * @param[in] indent Current indent. 
 340  * @param[in,out] str Resulting string. 
 341  * @param[in,out] used Used bytes in @p str. 
 342  * @param[in,out] size Allocated bytes in @p str. 
 343  * @return LY_ERR 
 344  */ 
 345 static LY_ERR 
 346 cast_string_recursive(const struct lyd_node *node, ly_bool fake_cont, enum lyxp_node_type root_type, uint16_t indent, char **str, 
 347         uint16_t *used, uint16_t *size) 
 348 { 
 349     char *buf, *line, *ptr = NULL; 
 350     const char *value_str; 
 351     const struct lyd_node *child; 
 352     struct lyd_node *tree; 
 353     struct lyd_node_any *any; 
 354     LY_ERR rc; 
 355  
 356     if ((root_type == LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG) && (node->schema->flags & LYS_CONFIG_R)) { 
 357         return LY_SUCCESS; 
 358     } 
 359  
 360     if (fake_cont) { 
 361         rc = cast_string_realloc(LYD_CTX(node), 1, str, used, size); 
 362         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
 363         strcpy(*str + (*used - 1), "\n"); 
 364         ++(*used); 
 365  
 366         ++indent; 
 367     } 
 368  
 369     switch (node->schema->nodetype) { 
 370     case LYS_CONTAINER: 
 371     case LYS_LIST: 
 372     case LYS_RPC: 
 373     case LYS_NOTIF: 
 374         rc = cast_string_realloc(LYD_CTX(node), 1, str, used, size); 
 375         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
 376         strcpy(*str + (*used - 1), "\n"); 
 377         ++(*used); 
 378  
 379         for (child = lyd_child(node); child; child = child->next) { 
 380             rc = cast_string_recursive(child, 0, root_type, indent + 1, str, used, size); 
 381             LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
 382         } 
 383  
 384         break; 
 385  
 386     case LYS_LEAF: 
 387     case LYS_LEAFLIST: 
 388         value_str = lyd_get_value(node); 
 389  
 390         /* print indent */ 
 391         LY_CHECK_RET(cast_string_realloc(LYD_CTX(node), indent * 2 + strlen(value_str) + 1, str, used, size)); 
 392         memset(*str + (*used - 1), ' ', indent * 2); 
 393         *used += indent * 2; 
 394  
 395         /* print value */ 
 396         if (*used == 1) { 
 397             sprintf(*str + (*used - 1), "%s", value_str); 
 398             *used += strlen(value_str); 
 399         } else { 
 400             sprintf(*str + (*used - 1), "%s\n", value_str); 
 401             *used += strlen(value_str) + 1; 
 402         } 
 403  
 404         break; 
 405  
 406     case LYS_ANYXML: 
 407     case LYS_ANYDATA: 
 408         any = (struct lyd_node_any *)node; 
 409         if (!(void *)any->value.tree) { 
 410             /* no content */ 
 411             buf = strdup(""); 
 412             LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!buf, LOGMEM(LYD_CTX(node)), LY_EMEM); 
 413         } else { 
 414             struct ly_out *out; 
 415  
 416             if (any->value_type == LYD_ANYDATA_LYB) { 
 417                 /* try to parse it into a data tree */ 
 418                 if (lyd_parse_data_mem((struct ly_ctx *)LYD_CTX(node), any->value.mem, LYD_LYB, LYD_PARSE_ONLY | LYD_PARSE_STRICT, 0, &tree) == LY_SUCCESS) { 
 419                     /* successfully parsed */ 
 420                     free(any->value.mem); 
 421                     any->value.tree = tree; 
 422                     any->value_type = LYD_ANYDATA_DATATREE; 
 423                 } 
 424                 /* error is covered by the following switch where LYD_ANYDATA_LYB causes failure */ 
 425             } 
 426  
 427             switch (any->value_type) { 
 428             case LYD_ANYDATA_STRING: 
 429             case LYD_ANYDATA_XML: 
 430             case LYD_ANYDATA_JSON: 
 431                 buf = strdup(any->value.json); 
 432                 LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!buf, LOGMEM(LYD_CTX(node)), LY_EMEM); 
 433                 break; 
 434             case LYD_ANYDATA_DATATREE: 
 435                 LY_CHECK_RET(ly_out_new_memory(&buf, 0, &out)); 
 436                 rc = lyd_print_all(out, any->value.tree, LYD_XML, 0); 
 437                 ly_out_free(out, NULL, 0); 
 438                 LY_CHECK_RET(rc < 0, -rc); 
 439                 break; 
 440             case LYD_ANYDATA_LYB: 
 441                 LOGERR(LYD_CTX(node), LY_EINVAL, "Cannot convert LYB anydata into string."); 
 442                 return LY_EINVAL; 
 443             } 
 444         } 
 445  
 446         line = strtok_r(buf, "\n", &ptr); 
 447         do { 
 448             rc = cast_string_realloc(LYD_CTX(node), indent * 2 + strlen(line) + 1, str, used, size); 
 449             if (rc != LY_SUCCESS) { 
 450                 free(buf); 
 451                 return rc; 
 452             } 
 453             memset(*str + (*used - 1), ' ', indent * 2); 
 454             *used += indent * 2; 
 455  
 456             strcpy(*str + (*used - 1), line); 
 457             *used += strlen(line); 
 458  
 459             strcpy(*str + (*used - 1), "\n"); 
 460             *used += 1; 
 461         } while ((line = strtok_r(NULL, "\n", &ptr))); 
 462  
 463         free(buf); 
 464         break; 
 465  
 466     default: 
 467         LOGINT_RET(LYD_CTX(node)); 
 468     } 
 469  
 470     if (fake_cont) { 
 471         rc = cast_string_realloc(LYD_CTX(node), 1, str, used, size); 
 472         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
 473         strcpy(*str + (*used - 1), "\n"); 
 474         ++(*used); 
 475  
 476         --indent; 
 477     } 
 478  
 479     return LY_SUCCESS; 
 480 }

 482 /** 
 483  * @brief Cast an element into a string. 
 484  * 
 485  * @param[in] node Node to cast. 
 486  * @param[in] fake_cont Whether to put the data into a "fake" container. 
 487  * @param[in] root_type Type of the XPath root. 
 488  * @param[out] str Element cast to dynamically-allocated string. 
 489  * @return LY_ERR 
 490  */ 
 491 static LY_ERR 
 492 cast_string_elem(struct lyd_node *node, ly_bool fake_cont, enum lyxp_node_type root_type, char **str) 
 493 { 
 494     uint16_t used, size; 
 495     LY_ERR rc; 
 496  
 497     *str = malloc(LYXP_STRING_CAST_SIZE_START * sizeof(char)); 
 498     LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!*str, LOGMEM(LYD_CTX(node)), LY_EMEM); 
 499     (*str)[0] = '\0'; 
 500     used = 1; 
 501     size = LYXP_STRING_CAST_SIZE_START; 
 502  
 503     rc = cast_string_recursive(node, fake_cont, root_type, 0, str, &used, &size); 
 504     if (rc != LY_SUCCESS) { 
 505         free(*str); 
 506         return rc; 
 507     } 
 508  
 509     if (size > used) { 
 510         *str = ly_realloc(*str, used * sizeof(char)); 
 511         LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!*str, LOGMEM(LYD_CTX(node)), LY_EMEM); 
 512     } 
 513     return LY_SUCCESS; 
 514 }

 516 /** 
 517  * @brief Cast a LYXP_SET_NODE_SET set into a string. 
 518  *        Context position aware. 
 519  * 
 520  * @param[in] set Set to cast. 
 521  * @param[out] str Cast dynamically-allocated string. 
 522  * @return LY_ERR 
 523  */ 
 524 static LY_ERR 
 525 cast_node_set_to_string(struct lyxp_set *set, char **str) 
 526 { 
 527     if (!set->used) { 
 528         *str = strdup(""); 
 529         if (!*str) { 
 530             LOGMEM_RET(set->ctx); 
 531         } 
 532         return LY_SUCCESS; 
 533     } 
 534  
 535     switch (set->val.nodes[0].type) { 
 536     case LYXP_NODE_NONE: 
 537         /* invalid */ 
 538         LOGINT_RET(set->ctx); 
 539     case LYXP_NODE_ROOT: 
 540     case LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG: 
 541         return cast_string_elem(set->val.nodes[0].node, 1, set->root_type, str); 
 542     case LYXP_NODE_ELEM: 
 543     case LYXP_NODE_TEXT: 
 544         return cast_string_elem(set->val.nodes[0].node, 0, set->root_type, str); 
 545     case LYXP_NODE_META: 
 546         *str = strdup(lyd_get_meta_value(set->val.meta[0].meta)); 
 547         if (!*str) { 
 548             LOGMEM_RET(set->ctx); 
 549         } 
 550         return LY_SUCCESS; 
 551     } 
 552  
 553     LOGINT_RET(set->ctx); 
 554 }

 556 /** 
 557  * @brief Cast a string into an XPath number. 
 558  * 
 559  * @param[in] str String to use. 
 560  * @return Cast number. 
 561  */ 
 562 static long double 
 563 cast_string_to_number(const char *str) 
 564 { 
 565     long double num; 
 566     char *ptr; 
 567  
 568     errno = 0; 
 569     num = strtold(str, &ptr); 
 570     if (errno || *ptr) { 
 571         num = NAN; 
 572     } 
 573     return num; 
 574 }

 576 /** 
 577  * @brief Callback for checking value equality. 
 578  * 
 579  * Implementation of ::lyht_value_equal_cb. 
 580  * 
 581  * @param[in] val1_p First value. 
 582  * @param[in] val2_p Second value. 
 583  * @param[in] mod Whether hash table is being modified. 
 584  * @param[in] cb_data Callback data. 
 585  * @return Boolean value whether values are equal or not. 
 586  */ 
 587 static ly_bool 
 588 set_values_equal_cb(void *val1_p, void *val2_p, ly_bool UNUSED(mod), void *UNUSED(cb_data)) 
 589 { 
 590     struct lyxp_set_hash_node *val1, *val2; 
 591  
 592     val1 = (struct lyxp_set_hash_node *)val1_p; 
 593     val2 = (struct lyxp_set_hash_node *)val2_p; 
 594  
 595     if ((val1->node == val2->node) && (val1->type == val2->type)) { 
 596         return 1; 
 597     } 
 598  
 599     return 0; 
 600 }

 602 /** 
 603  * @brief Insert node and its hash into set. 
 604  * 
 605  * @param[in] set et to insert to. 
 606  * @param[in] node Node with hash. 
 607  * @param[in] type Node type. 
 608  */ 
 609 static void 
 610 set_insert_node_hash(struct lyxp_set *set, struct lyd_node *node, enum lyxp_node_type type) 
 611 { 
 612     LY_ERR r; 
 613     uint32_t i, hash; 
 614     struct lyxp_set_hash_node hnode; 
 615  
 616     if (!set->ht && (set->used >= LYD_HT_MIN_ITEMS)) { 
 617         /* create hash table and add all the nodes */ 
 618         set->ht = lyht_new(1, sizeof(struct lyxp_set_hash_node), set_values_equal_cb, NULL, 1); 
 619         for (i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
 620             hnode.node = set->val.nodes[i].node; 
 621             hnode.type = set->val.nodes[i].type; 
 622  
 623             hash = dict_hash_multi(0, (const char *)&hnode.node, sizeof hnode.node); 
 624             hash = dict_hash_multi(hash, (const char *)&hnode.type, sizeof hnode.type); 
 625             hash = dict_hash_multi(hash, NULL, 0); 
 626  
 627             r = lyht_insert(set->ht, &hnode, hash, NULL); 
 628             assert(!r); 
 629             (void)r; 
 630  
 631             if (hnode.node == node) { 
 632                 /* it was just added, do not add it twice */ 
 633                 node = NULL; 
 634             } 
 635         } 
 636     } 
 637  
 638     if (set->ht && node) { 
 639         /* add the new node into hash table */ 
 640         hnode.node = node; 
 641         hnode.type = type; 
 642  
 643         hash = dict_hash_multi(0, (const char *)&hnode.node, sizeof hnode.node); 
 644         hash = dict_hash_multi(hash, (const char *)&hnode.type, sizeof hnode.type); 
 645         hash = dict_hash_multi(hash, NULL, 0); 
 646  
 647         r = lyht_insert(set->ht, &hnode, hash, NULL); 
 648         assert(!r); 
 649         (void)r; 
 650     } 
 651 } 
 652  
 653 /** 
 654  * @brief Remove node and its hash from set. 
 655  * 
 656  * @param[in] set Set to remove from. 
 657  * @param[in] node Node to remove. 
 658  * @param[in] type Node type. 
 659  */ 
 660 static void 
 661 set_remove_node_hash(struct lyxp_set *set, struct lyd_node *node, enum lyxp_node_type type) 
 662 { 
 663     LY_ERR r; 
 664     struct lyxp_set_hash_node hnode; 
 665     uint32_t hash; 
 666  
 667     if (set->ht) { 
 668         hnode.node = node; 
 669         hnode.type = type; 
 670  
 671         hash = dict_hash_multi(0, (const char *)&hnode.node, sizeof hnode.node); 
 672         hash = dict_hash_multi(hash, (const char *)&hnode.type, sizeof hnode.type); 
 673         hash = dict_hash_multi(hash, NULL, 0); 
 674  
 675         r = lyht_remove(set->ht, &hnode, hash); 
 676         assert(!r); 
 677         (void)r; 
 678  
 679         if (!set->ht->used) { 
 680             lyht_free(set->ht); 
 681             set->ht = NULL; 
 682         } 
 683     } 
 684 } 
 685  
 686 /** 
 687  * @brief Check whether node is in set based on its hash. 
 688  * 
 689  * @param[in] set Set to search in. 
 690  * @param[in] node Node to search for. 
 691  * @param[in] type Node type. 
 692  * @param[in] skip_idx Index in @p set to skip. 
 693  * @return LY_ERR 
 694  */ 
 695 static LY_ERR 
 696 set_dup_node_hash_check(const struct lyxp_set *set, struct lyd_node *node, enum lyxp_node_type type, int skip_idx) 
 697 { 
 698     struct lyxp_set_hash_node hnode, *match_p; 
 699     uint32_t hash; 
 700  
 701     hnode.node = node; 
 702     hnode.type = type; 
 703  
 704     hash = dict_hash_multi(0, (const char *)&hnode.node, sizeof hnode.node); 
 705     hash = dict_hash_multi(hash, (const char *)&hnode.type, sizeof hnode.type); 
 706     hash = dict_hash_multi(hash, NULL, 0); 
 707  
 708     if (!lyht_find(set->ht, &hnode, hash, (void **)&match_p)) { 
 709         if ((skip_idx > -1) && (set->val.nodes[skip_idx].node == match_p->node) && (set->val.nodes[skip_idx].type == match_p->type)) { 
 710             /* we found it on the index that should be skipped, find another */ 
 711             hnode = *match_p; 
 712             if (lyht_find_next(set->ht, &hnode, hash, (void **)&match_p)) { 
 713                 /* none other found */ 
 714                 return LY_SUCCESS; 
 715             } 
 716         } 
 717  
 718         return LY_EEXIST; 
 719     } 
 720  
 721     /* not found */ 
 722     return LY_SUCCESS; 
 723 }

 725 void 
 726 lyxp_set_free_content(struct lyxp_set *set) 
 727 { 
 728     if (!set) { 
 729         return; 
 730     } 
 731  
 732     if (set->type == LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
 733         free(set->val.nodes); 
 734         lyht_free(set->ht); 
 735     } else if (set->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) { 
 736         free(set->val.scnodes); 
 737         lyht_free(set->ht); 
 738     } else { 
 739         if (set->type == LYXP_SET_STRING) { 
 740             free(set->val.str); 
 741         } 
 742         set->type = LYXP_SET_NODE_SET; 
 743     } 
 744  
 745     set->val.nodes = NULL; 
 746     set->used = 0; 
 747     set->size = 0; 
 748     set->ht = NULL; 
 749     set->ctx_pos = 0; 
 750     set->ctx_size = 0; 
 751 }

 753 /** 
 754  * @brief Free dynamically-allocated set. 
 755  * 
 756  * @param[in] set Set to free. 
 757  */ 
 758 static void 
 759 lyxp_set_free(struct lyxp_set *set) 
 760 { 
 761     if (!set) { 
 762         return; 
 763     } 
 764  
 765     lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
 766     free(set); 
 767 }

 769 /** 
 770  * @brief Initialize set context. 
 771  * 
 772  * @param[in] new Set to initialize. 
 773  * @param[in] set Arbitrary initialized set. 
 774  */ 
 775 static void 
 776 set_init(struct lyxp_set *new, const struct lyxp_set *set) 
 777 { 
 778     memset(new, 0, sizeof *new); 
 779     if (set) { 
 780         new->ctx = set->ctx; 
 781         new->cur_node = set->cur_node; 
 782         new->root_type = set->root_type; 
 783         new->context_op = set->context_op; 
 784         new->tree = set->tree; 
 785         new->cur_mod = set->cur_mod; 
 786         new->format = set->format; 
 787         new->prefix_data = set->prefix_data; 
 788         new->vars = set->vars; 
 789     } 
 790 }

 792 /** 
 793  * @brief Create a deep copy of a set. 
 794  * 
 795  * @param[in] set Set to copy. 
 796  * @return Copy of @p set. 
 797  */ 
 798 static struct lyxp_set * 
 799 set_copy(struct lyxp_set *set) 
 800 { 
 801     struct lyxp_set *ret; 
 802     uint32_t i; 
 803  
 804     if (!set) { 
 805         return NULL; 
 806     } 
 807  
 808     ret = malloc(sizeof *ret); 
 809     LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!ret, LOGMEM(set->ctx), NULL); 
 810     set_init(ret, set); 
 811  
 812     if (set->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) { 
 813         ret->type = set->type; 
 814  
 815         for (i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
 816             if ((set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_CTX) || 
 817                     (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_START)) { 
 818                 uint32_t idx; 
 819                 LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(lyxp_set_scnode_insert_node(ret, set->val.scnodes[i].scnode, set->val.scnodes[i].type, &idx), 
 820                         lyxp_set_free(ret), NULL); 
 821                 /* coverity seems to think scnodes can be NULL */ 
 822                 if (!ret->val.scnodes) { 
 823                     lyxp_set_free(ret); 
 824                     return NULL; 
 825                 } 
 826                 ret->val.scnodes[idx].in_ctx = set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx; 
 827             } 
 828         } 
 829     } else if (set->type == LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
 830         ret->type = set->type; 
 831         if (set->used) { 
 832             ret->val.nodes = malloc(set->used * sizeof *ret->val.nodes); 
 833             LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!ret->val.nodes, LOGMEM(set->ctx); free(ret), NULL); 
 834             memcpy(ret->val.nodes, set->val.nodes, set->used * sizeof *ret->val.nodes); 
 835         } else { 
 836             ret->val.nodes = NULL; 
 837         } 
 838  
 839         ret->used = ret->size = set->used; 
 840         ret->ctx_pos = set->ctx_pos; 
 841         ret->ctx_size = set->ctx_size; 
 842         if (set->ht) { 
 843             ret->ht = lyht_dup(set->ht); 
 844         } 
 845     } else { 
 846         memcpy(ret, set, sizeof *ret); 
 847         if (set->type == LYXP_SET_STRING) { 
 848             ret->val.str = strdup(set->val.str); 
 849             LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!ret->val.str, LOGMEM(set->ctx); free(ret), NULL); 
 850         } 
 851     } 
 852  
 853     return ret; 
 854 }

 856 /** 
 857  * @brief Fill XPath set with a string. Any current data are disposed of. 
 858  * 
 859  * @param[in] set Set to fill. 
 860  * @param[in] string String to fill into \p set. 
 861  * @param[in] str_len Length of \p string. 0 is a valid value! 
 862  */ 
 863 static void 
 864 set_fill_string(struct lyxp_set *set, const char *string, uint16_t str_len) 
 865 { 
 866     lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
 867  
 868     set->type = LYXP_SET_STRING; 
 869     if ((str_len == 0) && (string[0] != '\0')) { 
 870         string = ""; 
 871     } 
 872     set->val.str = strndup(string, str_len); 
 873 }

 879  * @param[in] number Number to fill into \p set. 
 880  */ 
 881 static void 
 882 set_fill_number(struct lyxp_set *set, long double number) 
 883 {

 885  
 886     set->type = LYXP_SET_NUMBER; 
 887     set->val.num = number;

 890 /** 
 891  * @brief Fill XPath set with a boolean. Any current data are disposed of. 
 892  * 
 893  * @param[in] set Set to fill. 
 894  * @param[in] boolean Boolean to fill into \p set. 
 895  */ 
 896 static void 
 897 set_fill_boolean(struct lyxp_set *set, ly_bool boolean) 
 898 { 
 899     lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
 900  
 901     set->type = LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN;
