 904  
 905 /** 
 906  * @brief Fill XPath set with the value from another set (deep assign). 
 907  *        Any current data are disposed of. 
 908  * 
 909  * @param[in] trg Set to fill. 
 910  * @param[in] src Source set to copy into \p trg. 
 911  */ 
 912 static void 
 913 set_fill_set(struct lyxp_set *trg, const struct lyxp_set *src) 
 914 { 
 915     if (!trg || !src) { 
 916         return; 
 917     } 
 918  
 919     if (trg->type == LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
 920         free(trg->val.nodes); 
 921     } else if (trg->type == LYXP_SET_STRING) { 
 922         free(trg->val.str); 
 923     } 
 924     set_init(trg, src); 
 925  
 926     if (src->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) { 
 927         trg->type = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET; 
 928         trg->used = src->used; 
 929         trg->size = src->used; 
 930  
 931         if (trg->size) { 
 932             trg->val.scnodes = ly_realloc(trg->val.scnodes, trg->size * sizeof *trg->val.scnodes); 
 933             LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!trg->val.scnodes, LOGMEM(src->ctx); memset(trg, 0, sizeof *trg), ); 
 934             memcpy(trg->val.scnodes, src->val.scnodes, src->used * sizeof *src->val.scnodes); 
 935         } else { 
 936             trg->val.scnodes = NULL; 
 937         } 
 938     } else if (src->type == LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN) { 
 939         set_fill_boolean(trg, src->val.bln); 
 940     } else if (src->type == LYXP_SET_NUMBER) { 
 941         set_fill_number(trg, src->val.num); 
 942     } else if (src->type == LYXP_SET_STRING) { 
 943         set_fill_string(trg, src->val.str, strlen(src->val.str)); 
 944     } else { 
 945         if (trg->type == LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
 946             free(trg->val.nodes); 
 947         } else if (trg->type == LYXP_SET_STRING) { 
 948             free(trg->val.str); 
 949         } 
 950  
 951         assert(src->type == LYXP_SET_NODE_SET); 
 952  
 953         trg->type = LYXP_SET_NODE_SET; 
 954         trg->used = src->used; 
 955         trg->size = src->used; 
 956         trg->ctx_pos = src->ctx_pos; 
 957         trg->ctx_size = src->ctx_size; 
 958  
 959         if (trg->size) { 
 960             trg->val.nodes = malloc(trg->size * sizeof *trg->val.nodes); 
 961             LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!trg->val.nodes, LOGMEM(src->ctx); memset(trg, 0, sizeof *trg), ); 
 962             memcpy(trg->val.nodes, src->val.nodes, src->used * sizeof *src->val.nodes); 
 963         } else { 
 964             trg->val.nodes = NULL; 
 965         } 
 966         if (src->ht) { 
 967             trg->ht = lyht_dup(src->ht); 
 968         } else { 
 969             trg->ht = NULL; 
 970         } 
 971     } 
 972 } 
 973  
 974 /** 
 975  * @brief Clear context of all schema nodes. 
 976  * 
 977  * @param[in] set Set to clear. 
 978  * @param[in] new_ctx New context state for all the nodes currently in the context. 
 979  */ 
 980 static void 
 981 set_scnode_clear_ctx(struct lyxp_set *set, int32_t new_ctx) 
 982 { 
 983     uint32_t i; 
 984  
 985     for (i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
 986         if (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_CTX) { 
 987             set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx = new_ctx; 
 988         } else if (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_START) { 
 989             set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_START_USED; 
 990         } 
 991     } 
 992 } 
 993  
 994 /** 
 995  * @brief Remove a node from a set. Removing last node changes 
 996  *        set into LYXP_SET_EMPTY. Context position aware. 
 997  * 
 998  * @param[in] set Set to use. 
 999  * @param[in] idx Index from @p set of the node to be removed. 
1000  */ 
1001 static void 
1002 set_remove_node(struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t idx) 
1003 { 
1004     assert(set && (set->type == LYXP_SET_NODE_SET)); 
1005     assert(idx < set->used); 
1006  
1007     set_remove_node_hash(set, set->val.nodes[idx].node, set->val.nodes[idx].type); 
1008  
1009     --set->used; 
1010     if (idx < set->used) { 
1011         memmove(&set->val.nodes[idx], &set->val.nodes[idx + 1], (set->used - idx) * sizeof *set->val.nodes); 
1012     } else if (!set->used) { 
1013         lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
1014     } 
1015 } 
1016  
1017 /** 
1018  * @brief Remove a node from a set by setting its type to LYXP_NODE_NONE. 
1019  * 
1020  * @param[in] set Set to use. 
1021  * @param[in] idx Index from @p set of the node to be removed. 
1022  */ 
1023 static void 
1024 set_remove_node_none(struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t idx) 
1025 { 
1026     assert(set && (set->type == LYXP_SET_NODE_SET)); 
1027     assert(idx < set->used); 
1028  
1029     if (set->val.nodes[idx].type == LYXP_NODE_ELEM) { 
1030         set_remove_node_hash(set, set->val.nodes[idx].node, set->val.nodes[idx].type); 
1031     } 
1032     set->val.nodes[idx].type = LYXP_NODE_NONE; 
1033 } 
1034  
1035 /** 
1036  * @brief Remove all LYXP_NODE_NONE nodes from a set. Removing last node changes 
1037  *        set into LYXP_SET_EMPTY. Context position aware. 
1038  * 
1039  * @param[in] set Set to consolidate. 
1040  */ 
1041 static void 
1042 set_remove_nodes_none(struct lyxp_set *set) 
1043 { 
1044     uint32_t i, orig_used, end = 0; 
1045     int64_t start; 
1046  
1047     assert(set); 
1048  
1049     orig_used = set->used; 
1050     set->used = 0; 
1051     for (i = 0; i < orig_used; ) { 
1052         start = -1; 
1053         do { 
1054             if ((set->val.nodes[i].type != LYXP_NODE_NONE) && (start == -1)) { 
1055                 start = i; 
1056             } else if ((start > -1) && (set->val.nodes[i].type == LYXP_NODE_NONE)) { 
1057                 end = i; 
1058                 ++i; 
1059                 break; 
1060             } 
1061  
1062             ++i; 
1063             if (i == orig_used) { 
1064                 end = i; 
1065             } 
1066         } while (i < orig_used); 
1067  
1068         if (start > -1) { 
1069             /* move the whole chunk of valid nodes together */ 
1070             if (set->used != (unsigned)start) { 
1071                 memmove(&set->val.nodes[set->used], &set->val.nodes[start], (end - start) * sizeof *set->val.nodes); 
1072             } 
1073             set->used += end - start; 
1074         } 
1075     } 
1076 } 
1077  
1078 /** 
1079  * @brief Check for duplicates in a node set. 
1080  * 
1081  * @param[in] set Set to check. 
1082  * @param[in] node Node to look for in @p set. 
1083  * @param[in] node_type Type of @p node. 
1084  * @param[in] skip_idx Index from @p set to skip. 
1085  * @return LY_ERR 
1086  */ 
1087 static LY_ERR 
1088 set_dup_node_check(const struct lyxp_set *set, const struct lyd_node *node, enum lyxp_node_type node_type, int skip_idx) 
1089 { 
1090     uint32_t i; 
1091  
1092     if (set->ht && node) { 
1093         return set_dup_node_hash_check(set, (struct lyd_node *)node, node_type, skip_idx); 
1094     } 
1095  
1096     for (i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
1097         if ((skip_idx > -1) && (i == (unsigned)skip_idx)) { 
1098             continue; 
1099         } 
1100  
1101         if ((set->val.nodes[i].node == node) && (set->val.nodes[i].type == node_type)) { 
1102             return LY_EEXIST; 
1103         } 
1104     } 
1105  
1106     return LY_SUCCESS; 
1107 } 
1108  
1109 ly_bool 
1110 lyxp_set_scnode_contains(struct lyxp_set *set, const struct lysc_node *node, enum lyxp_node_type node_type, int skip_idx, 
1111         uint32_t *index_p) 
1112 { 
1113     uint32_t i; 
1114  
1115     for (i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
1116         if ((skip_idx > -1) && (i == (unsigned)skip_idx)) { 
1117             continue; 
1118         } 
1119  
1120         if ((set->val.scnodes[i].scnode == node) && (set->val.scnodes[i].type == node_type)) { 
1121             if (index_p) { 
1122                 *index_p = i; 
1123             } 
1124             return 1; 
1125         } 
1126     } 
1127  
1128     return 0; 
1129 } 
1130  
1131 void 
1132 lyxp_set_scnode_merge(struct lyxp_set *set1, struct lyxp_set *set2) 
1133 { 
1134     uint32_t orig_used, i, j; 
1135  
1136     assert((set1->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) && (set2->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET)); 
1137  
1138     if (!set2->used) { 
1139         return; 
1140     } 
1141  
1142     if (!set1->used) { 
1143         /* release hidden allocated data (lyxp_set.size) */ 
1144         lyxp_set_free_content(set1); 
1145         /* direct copying of the entire structure */ 
1146         memcpy(set1, set2, sizeof *set1); 
1147         return; 
1148     } 
1149  
1150     if (set1->used + set2->used > set1->size) { 
1151         set1->size = set1->used + set2->used; 
1152         set1->val.scnodes = ly_realloc(set1->val.scnodes, set1->size * sizeof *set1->val.scnodes); 
1153         LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!set1->val.scnodes, LOGMEM(set1->ctx), ); 
1154     } 
1155  
1156     orig_used = set1->used; 
1157  
1158     for (i = 0; i < set2->used; ++i) { 
1159         for (j = 0; j < orig_used; ++j) { 
1160             /* detect duplicities */ 
1161             if (set1->val.scnodes[j].scnode == set2->val.scnodes[i].scnode) { 
1162                 break; 
1163             } 
1164         } 
1165  
1166         if (j < orig_used) { 
1167             /* node is there, but update its status if needed */ 
1168             if (set1->val.scnodes[j].in_ctx == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_START_USED) { 
1169                 set1->val.scnodes[j].in_ctx = set2->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx; 
1170             } else if ((set1->val.scnodes[j].in_ctx == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE) && 
1171                     (set2->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_VAL)) { 
1172                 set1->val.scnodes[j].in_ctx = set2->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx; 
1173             } 
1174         } else { 
1175             memcpy(&set1->val.scnodes[set1->used], &set2->val.scnodes[i], sizeof *set2->val.scnodes); 
1176             ++set1->used; 
1177         } 
1178     } 
1179  
1180     lyxp_set_free_content(set2); 
1181     set2->type = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET; 
1182 } 
1183  
1184 /** 
1185  * @brief Insert a node into a set. Context position aware. 
1186  * 
1187  * @param[in] set Set to use. 
1188  * @param[in] node Node to insert to @p set. 
1189  * @param[in] pos Sort position of @p node. If left 0, it is filled just before sorting. 
1190  * @param[in] node_type Node type of @p node. 
1191  * @param[in] idx Index in @p set to insert into. 
1192  */ 
1193 static void 
1194 set_insert_node(struct lyxp_set *set, const struct lyd_node *node, uint32_t pos, enum lyxp_node_type node_type, uint32_t idx) 
1195 { 
1196     assert(set && (set->type == LYXP_SET_NODE_SET)); 
1197  
1198     if (!set->size) { 
1199         /* first item */ 
1200         if (idx) { 
1201             /* no real harm done, but it is a bug */ 
1202             LOGINT(set->ctx); 
1203             idx = 0; 
1204         } 
1205         set->val.nodes = malloc(LYXP_SET_SIZE_START * sizeof *set->val.nodes); 
1206         LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!set->val.nodes, LOGMEM(set->ctx), ); 
1207         set->type = LYXP_SET_NODE_SET; 
1208         set->used = 0; 
1209         set->size = LYXP_SET_SIZE_START; 
1210         set->ctx_pos = 1; 
1211         set->ctx_size = 1; 
1212         set->ht = NULL; 
1213     } else { 
1214         /* not an empty set */ 
1215         if (set->used == set->size) { 
1216  
1217             /* set is full */ 
1218             set->val.nodes = ly_realloc(set->val.nodes, (set->size + LYXP_SET_SIZE_STEP) * sizeof *set->val.nodes); 
1219             LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!set->val.nodes, LOGMEM(set->ctx), ); 
1220             set->size += LYXP_SET_SIZE_STEP; 
1221         } 
1222  
1223         if (idx > set->used) { 
1224             LOGINT(set->ctx); 
1225             idx = set->used; 
1226         } 
1227  
1228         /* make space for the new node */ 
1229         if (idx < set->used) { 
1230             memmove(&set->val.nodes[idx + 1], &set->val.nodes[idx], (set->used - idx) * sizeof *set->val.nodes); 
1231         } 
1232     } 
1233  
1234     /* finally assign the value */ 
1235     set->val.nodes[idx].node = (struct lyd_node *)node; 
1236     set->val.nodes[idx].type = node_type; 
1237     set->val.nodes[idx].pos = pos; 
1238     ++set->used; 
1239  
1240     /* add into hash table */ 
1241     set_insert_node_hash(set, (struct lyd_node *)node, node_type); 
1242 } 
1243  
1244 LY_ERR 
1245 lyxp_set_scnode_insert_node(struct lyxp_set *set, const struct lysc_node *node, enum lyxp_node_type node_type, uint32_t *index_p) 
1246 { 
1247     uint32_t index; 
1248  
1249     assert(set->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET); 
1250  
1251     if (lyxp_set_scnode_contains(set, node, node_type, -1, &index)) { 
1252         set->val.scnodes[index].in_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_CTX; 
1253     } else { 
1254         if (set->used == set->size) { 
1255             set->val.scnodes = ly_realloc(set->val.scnodes, (set->size + LYXP_SET_SIZE_STEP) * sizeof *set->val.scnodes); 
1256             LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!set->val.scnodes, LOGMEM(set->ctx), LY_EMEM); 
1257             set->size += LYXP_SET_SIZE_STEP; 
1258         } 
1259  
1260         index = set->used; 
1261         set->val.scnodes[index].scnode = (struct lysc_node *)node; 
1262         set->val.scnodes[index].type = node_type; 
1263         set->val.scnodes[index].in_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_CTX; 
1264         ++set->used; 
1265     } 
1266  
1267     if (index_p) { 
1268         *index_p = index; 
1269     } 
1270  
1271     return LY_SUCCESS; 
1272 } 
1273  
1274 /** 
1275  * @brief Set all nodes with ctx 1 to a new unique context value. 
1276  * 
1277  * @param[in] set Set to modify. 
1278  * @return New context value. 
1279  */ 
1280 static int32_t 
1281 set_scnode_new_in_ctx(struct lyxp_set *set) 
1282 { 
1283     uint32_t i; 
1284     int32_t ret_ctx; 
1285  
1286     assert(set->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET); 
1287  
1288     ret_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_PRED_CTX; 
1289 retry: 
1290     for (i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
1291         if (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx >= ret_ctx) { 
1292             ret_ctx = set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx + 1; 
1293             goto retry; 
1294         } 
1295     } 
1296     for (i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
1297         if (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_CTX) { 
1298             set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx = ret_ctx; 
1299         } 
1300     } 
1301  
1302     return ret_ctx; 
1303 } 
1304  
1305 /** 
1306  * @brief Get unique @p node position in the data. 
1307  * 
1308  * @param[in] node Node to find. 
1309  * @param[in] node_type Node type of @p node. 
1310  * @param[in] root Root node. 
1311  * @param[in] root_type Type of the XPath @p root node. 
1312  * @param[in] prev Node that we think is before @p node in DFS from @p root. Can optionally 
1313  * be used to increase efficiency and start the DFS from this node. 
1314  * @param[in] prev_pos Node @p prev position. Optional, but must be set if @p prev is set. 
1315  * @return Node position. 
1316  */ 
1317 static uint32_t 
1318 get_node_pos(const struct lyd_node *node, enum lyxp_node_type node_type, const struct lyd_node *root, 
1319         enum lyxp_node_type root_type, const struct lyd_node **prev, uint32_t *prev_pos) 
1320 { 
1321     const struct lyd_node *elem = NULL, *top_sibling; 
1322     uint32_t pos = 1; 
1323     ly_bool found = 0; 
1324  
1325     assert(prev && prev_pos && !root->prev->next); 
1326  
1327     if ((node_type == LYXP_NODE_ROOT) || (node_type == LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG)) { 
1328         return 0; 
1329     } 
1330  
1331     if (*prev) { 
1332         /* start from the previous element instead from the root */ 
1333         pos = *prev_pos; 
1334         for (top_sibling = *prev; top_sibling->parent; top_sibling = lyd_parent(top_sibling)) {} 
1335         goto dfs_search; 
1336     } 
1337  
1338     LY_LIST_FOR(root, top_sibling) { 
1339         LYD_TREE_DFS_BEGIN(top_sibling, elem) { 
1340 dfs_search: 
1341             LYD_TREE_DFS_continue = 0; 
1342  
1343             if (*prev && !elem) { 
1344                 /* resume previous DFS */ 
1345                 elem = LYD_TREE_DFS_next = (struct lyd_node *)*prev; 
1346                 LYD_TREE_DFS_continue = 0; 
1347             } 
1348  
1349             if ((root_type == LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG) && (elem->schema->flags & LYS_CONFIG_R)) { 
1350                 /* skip */ 
1351                 LYD_TREE_DFS_continue = 1; 
1352             } else { 
1353                 if (elem == node) { 
1354                     found = 1; 
1355                     break; 
1356                 } 
1357                 ++pos; 
1358             } 
1359  
1360             LYD_TREE_DFS_END(top_sibling, elem); 
1361         } 
1362  
1363         /* node found */ 
1364         if (found) { 
1365             break; 
1366         } 
1367     } 
1368  
1369     if (!found) { 
1370         if (!(*prev)) { 
1371             /* we went from root and failed to find it, cannot be */ 
1372             LOGINT(LYD_CTX(node)); 
1373             return 0; 
1374         } else { 
1375             /* start the search again from the beginning */ 
1376             *prev = root; 
1377  
1378             top_sibling = root; 
1379             pos = 1; 
1380             goto dfs_search; 
1381         } 
1382     } 
1383  
1384     /* remember the last found node for next time */ 
1385     *prev = node; 
1386     *prev_pos = pos; 
1387  
1388     return pos; 
1389 } 
1390  
1391 /** 
1392  * @brief Assign (fill) missing node positions. 
1393  * 
1394  * @param[in] set Set to fill positions in. 
1395  * @param[in] root Context root node. 
1396  * @param[in] root_type Context root type. 
1397  * @return LY_ERR 
1398  */ 
1399 static LY_ERR 
1400 set_assign_pos(struct lyxp_set *set, const struct lyd_node *root, enum lyxp_node_type root_type) 
1401 { 
1402     const struct lyd_node *prev = NULL, *tmp_node; 
1403     uint32_t i, tmp_pos = 0; 
1404  
1405     for (i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
1406         if (!set->val.nodes[i].pos) { 
1407             tmp_node = NULL; 
1408             switch (set->val.nodes[i].type) { 
1409             case LYXP_NODE_META: 
1410                 tmp_node = set->val.meta[i].meta->parent; 
1411                 if (!tmp_node) { 
1412                     LOGINT_RET(root->schema->module->ctx); 
1413                 } 
1414             /* fall through */ 
1415             case LYXP_NODE_ELEM: 
1416             case LYXP_NODE_TEXT: 
1417                 if (!tmp_node) { 
1418                     tmp_node = set->val.nodes[i].node; 
1419                 } 
1420                 set->val.nodes[i].pos = get_node_pos(tmp_node, set->val.nodes[i].type, root, root_type, &prev, &tmp_pos); 
1421                 break; 
1422             default: 
1423                 /* all roots have position 0 */ 
1424                 break; 
1425             } 
1426         } 
1427     } 
1428  
1429     return LY_SUCCESS; 
1430 } 
1431  
1432 /** 
1433  * @brief Get unique @p meta position in the parent metadata. 
1434  * 
1435  * @param[in] meta Metadata to use. 
1436  * @return Metadata position. 
1437  */ 
1438 static uint16_t 
1439 get_meta_pos(struct lyd_meta *meta) 
1440 { 
1441     uint16_t pos = 0; 
1442     struct lyd_meta *meta2; 
1443  
1444     for (meta2 = meta->parent->meta; meta2 && (meta2 != meta); meta2 = meta2->next) { 
1445         ++pos; 
1446     } 
1447  
1448     assert(meta2); 
1449     return pos; 
1450 } 
1451  
1452 /** 
1453  * @brief Compare 2 nodes in respect to XPath document order. 
1454  * 
1455  * @param[in] item1 1st node. 
1456  * @param[in] item2 2nd node. 
1457  * @return If 1st > 2nd returns 1, 1st == 2nd returns 0, and 1st < 2nd returns -1. 
1458  */ 
1459 static int 
1460 set_sort_compare(struct lyxp_set_node *item1, struct lyxp_set_node *item2) 
1461 { 
1462     uint32_t meta_pos1 = 0, meta_pos2 = 0; 
1463  
1464     if (item1->pos < item2->pos) { 
1465         return -1; 
1466     } 
1467  
1468     if (item1->pos > item2->pos) { 
1469         return 1; 
1470     } 
1471  
1472     /* node positions are equal, the fun case */ 
1473  
1474     /* 1st ELEM - == - 2nd TEXT, 1st TEXT - == - 2nd ELEM */ 
1475     /* special case since text nodes are actually saved as their parents */ 
1476     if ((item1->node == item2->node) && (item1->type != item2->type)) { 
1477         if (item1->type == LYXP_NODE_ELEM) { 
1478             assert(item2->type == LYXP_NODE_TEXT); 
1479             return -1; 
1480         } else { 
1481             assert((item1->type == LYXP_NODE_TEXT) && (item2->type == LYXP_NODE_ELEM)); 
1482             return 1; 
1483         } 
1484     } 
1485  
1486     /* we need meta positions now */ 
1487     if (item1->type == LYXP_NODE_META) { 
1488         meta_pos1 = get_meta_pos((struct lyd_meta *)item1->node); 
1489     } 
1490     if (item2->type == LYXP_NODE_META) { 
1491         meta_pos2 = get_meta_pos((struct lyd_meta *)item2->node); 
1492     } 
1493  
1494     /* 1st ROOT - 2nd ROOT, 1st ELEM - 2nd ELEM, 1st TEXT - 2nd TEXT, 1st META - =pos= - 2nd META */ 
1495     /* check for duplicates */ 
1496     if (item1->node == item2->node) { 
1497         assert((item1->type == item2->type) && ((item1->type != LYXP_NODE_META) || (meta_pos1 == meta_pos2))); 
1498         return 0; 
1499     } 
1500  
1501     /* 1st ELEM - 2nd TEXT, 1st ELEM - any pos - 2nd META */ 
1502     /* elem is always first, 2nd node is after it */ 
1503     if (item1->type == LYXP_NODE_ELEM) { 
1504         assert(item2->type != LYXP_NODE_ELEM); 
1505         return -1; 
1506     } 
1507  
1508     /* 1st TEXT - 2nd ELEM, 1st TEXT - any pos - 2nd META, 1st META - any pos - 2nd ELEM, 1st META - >pos> - 2nd META */ 
1509     /* 2nd is before 1st */ 
1510     if (((item1->type == LYXP_NODE_TEXT) && 
1511             ((item2->type == LYXP_NODE_ELEM) || (item2->type == LYXP_NODE_META))) || 
1512             ((item1->type == LYXP_NODE_META) && (item2->type == LYXP_NODE_ELEM)) || 
1513             (((item1->type == LYXP_NODE_META) && (item2->type == LYXP_NODE_META)) && 
1514             (meta_pos1 > meta_pos2))) { 
1515         return 1; 
1516     } 
1517  
1518     /* 1st META - any pos - 2nd TEXT, 1st META <pos< - 2nd META */ 
1519     /* 2nd is after 1st */ 
1520     return -1; 
1521 } 
1522  
1523 /** 
1524  * @brief Set cast for comparisons. 
1525  * 
1526  * @param[in] trg Target set to cast source into. 
1527  * @param[in] src Source set. 
1528  * @param[in] type Target set type. 
1529  * @param[in] src_idx Source set node index. 
1530  * @return LY_ERR 
1531  */ 
1532 static LY_ERR 
1533 set_comp_cast(struct lyxp_set *trg, struct lyxp_set *src, enum lyxp_set_type type, uint32_t src_idx) 
1534 { 
1535     assert(src->type == LYXP_SET_NODE_SET); 
1536  
1537     set_init(trg, src); 
1538  
1539     /* insert node into target set */ 
1540     set_insert_node(trg, src->val.nodes[src_idx].node, src->val.nodes[src_idx].pos, src->val.nodes[src_idx].type, 0); 
1541  
1542     /* cast target set appropriately */ 
1543     return lyxp_set_cast(trg, type); 
1544 } 
1545  
1546 /** 
1547  * @brief Set content canonization for comparisons. 
1548  * 
1549  * @param[in] trg Target set to put the canononized source into. 
1550  * @param[in] src Source set. 
1551  * @param[in] xp_node Source XPath node/meta to use for canonization. 
1552  * @return LY_ERR 
1553  */ 
1554 static LY_ERR 
1555 set_comp_canonize(struct lyxp_set *trg, const struct lyxp_set *src, const struct lyxp_set_node *xp_node) 
1556 { 
1557     const struct lysc_type *type = NULL; 
1558     struct lyd_value val; 
1559     struct ly_err_item *err = NULL; 
1560     char *str, *ptr; 
1561     LY_ERR rc; 
1562  
1563     /* is there anything to canonize even? */ 
1564     if ((src->type == LYXP_SET_NUMBER) || (src->type == LYXP_SET_STRING)) { 
1565         /* do we have a type to use for canonization? */ 
1566         if ((xp_node->type == LYXP_NODE_ELEM) && (xp_node->node->schema->nodetype & LYD_NODE_TERM)) { 
1567             type = ((struct lyd_node_term *)xp_node->node)->value.realtype; 
1568         } else if (xp_node->type == LYXP_NODE_META) { 
1569             type = ((struct lyd_meta *)xp_node->node)->value.realtype; 
1570         } 
1571     } 
1572     if (!type) { 
1573         goto fill; 
1574     } 
1575  
1576     if (src->type == LYXP_SET_NUMBER) { 
1577         /* canonize number */ 
1578         if (asprintf(&str, "%Lf", src->val.num) == -1) { 
1579             LOGMEM(src->ctx); 
1580             return LY_EMEM; 
1581         } 
1582     } else { 
1583         /* canonize string */ 
1584         str = strdup(src->val.str); 
1585     } 
1586  
1587     /* ignore errors, the value may not satisfy schema constraints */ 
1588     rc = type->plugin->store(src->ctx, type, str, strlen(str), LYPLG_TYPE_STORE_DYNAMIC, src->format, src->prefix_data, 
1589             LYD_HINT_DATA, xp_node->node->schema, &val, NULL, &err); 
1590     ly_err_free(err); 
1591     if (rc) { 
1592         /* invalid value */ 
1593         /* function store automaticaly dealloc value when fail */ 
1594         goto fill; 
1595     } 
1596  
1597     /* use the canonized value */ 
1598     set_init(trg, src); 
1599     trg->type = src->type; 
1600     if (src->type == LYXP_SET_NUMBER) { 
1601         trg->val.num = strtold(type->plugin->print(src->ctx, &val, LY_VALUE_CANON, NULL, NULL, NULL), &ptr); 
1602         LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(ptr[0], LOGINT(src->ctx), LY_EINT); 
1603     } else { 
1604         trg->val.str = strdup(type->plugin->print(src->ctx, &val, LY_VALUE_CANON, NULL, NULL, NULL)); 
1605     } 
1606     type->plugin->free(src->ctx, &val); 
1607     return LY_SUCCESS; 
1608  
1609 fill: 
1610     /* no canonization needed/possible */ 
1611     set_fill_set(trg, src); 
1612     return LY_SUCCESS; 
1613 } 
1614  
1615 #ifndef NDEBUG 
1616  
1617 /** 
1618  * @brief Bubble sort @p set into XPath document order. 
1619  *        Context position aware. Unused in the 'Release' build target. 
1620  * 
1621  * @param[in] set Set to sort. 
1622  * @return How many times the whole set was traversed - 1 (if set was sorted, returns 0). 
1623  */ 
1624 static int 
1625 set_sort(struct lyxp_set *set) 
1626 { 
1627     uint32_t i, j; 
1628     int ret = 0, cmp; 
1629     ly_bool inverted, change; 
1630     const struct lyd_node *root; 
1631     struct lyxp_set_node item; 
1632     struct lyxp_set_hash_node hnode; 
1633     uint64_t hash; 
1634  
1635     if ((set->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) || (set->used < 2)) { 
1636         return 0; 
1637     } 
1638  
1639     /* find first top-level node to be used as anchor for positions */ 
1640     for (root = set->tree; root->parent; root = lyd_parent(root)) {} 
1641     for ( ; root->prev->next; root = root->prev) {} 
1642  
1643     /* fill positions */ 
1644     if (set_assign_pos(set, root, set->root_type)) { 
1645         return -1; 
1646     } 
1647  
1648     LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "SORT BEGIN"); 
1649     print_set_debug(set); 
1650  
1651     for (i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
1652         inverted = 0; 
1653         change = 0; 
1654  
1655         for (j = 1; j < set->used - i; ++j) { 
1656             /* compare node positions */ 
1657             if (inverted) { 
1658                 cmp = set_sort_compare(&set->val.nodes[j], &set->val.nodes[j - 1]); 
1659             } else { 
1660                 cmp = set_sort_compare(&set->val.nodes[j - 1], &set->val.nodes[j]); 
1661             } 
1662  
1663             /* swap if needed */ 
1664             if ((inverted && (cmp < 0)) || (!inverted && (cmp > 0))) { 
1665                 change = 1; 
1666  
1667                 item = set->val.nodes[j - 1]; 
1668                 set->val.nodes[j - 1] = set->val.nodes[j]; 
1669                 set->val.nodes[j] = item; 
1670             } else { 
1671                 /* whether node_pos1 should be smaller than node_pos2 or the other way around */ 
1672                 inverted = !inverted; 
1673             } 
1674         } 
1675  
1676         ++ret; 
1677  
1678         if (!change) { 
1679             break; 
1680         } 
1681     } 
1682  
1683     LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "SORT END %d", ret); 
1684     print_set_debug(set); 
1685  
1686     /* check node hashes */ 
1687     if (set->used >= LYD_HT_MIN_ITEMS) { 
1688         assert(set->ht); 
1689         for (i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
1690             hnode.node = set->val.nodes[i].node; 
1691             hnode.type = set->val.nodes[i].type; 
1692  
1693             hash = dict_hash_multi(0, (const char *)&hnode.node, sizeof hnode.node); 
1694             hash = dict_hash_multi(hash, (const char *)&hnode.type, sizeof hnode.type); 
1695             hash = dict_hash_multi(hash, NULL, 0); 
1696  
1697             assert(!lyht_find(set->ht, &hnode, hash, NULL)); 
1698         } 
1699     } 
1700  
1701     return ret - 1; 
1702 } 
1703  
1704 #endif 
1705  
1706 /** 
1707  * @brief Merge 2 sorted sets into one. 
1708  * 
1709  * @param[in,out] trg Set to merge into. Duplicates are removed. 
1710  * @param[in] src Set to be merged into @p trg. It is cast to #LYXP_SET_EMPTY on success. 
1711  * @return LY_ERR 
1712  */ 
1713 static LY_ERR 
1714 set_sorted_merge(struct lyxp_set *trg, struct lyxp_set *src) 
1715 { 
1716     uint32_t i, j, k, count, dup_count; 
1717     int cmp; 
1718     const struct lyd_node *root; 
1719  
1720     if ((trg->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) || (src->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET)) { 
1721         return LY_EINVAL; 
1722     } 
1723  
1724     if (!src->used) { 
1725         return LY_SUCCESS; 
1726     } else if (!trg->used) { 
1727         set_fill_set(trg, src); 
1728         lyxp_set_free_content(src); 
1729         return LY_SUCCESS; 
1730     } 
1731  
1732     /* find first top-level node to be used as anchor for positions */ 
1733     for (root = trg->tree; root->parent; root = lyd_parent(root)) {} 
1734     for ( ; root->prev->next; root = root->prev) {} 
1735  
1736     /* fill positions */ 
1737     if (set_assign_pos(trg, root, trg->root_type) || set_assign_pos(src, root, src->root_type)) { 
1738         return LY_EINT; 
1739     } 
1740  
1741 #ifndef NDEBUG 
1742     LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "MERGE target"); 
1743     print_set_debug(trg); 
1744     LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "MERGE source"); 
1745     print_set_debug(src); 
1746 #endif 
1747  
1748     /* make memory for the merge (duplicates are not detected yet, so space 
1749      * will likely be wasted on them, too bad) */ 
1750     if (trg->size - trg->used < src->used) { 
1751         trg->size = trg->used + src->used; 
1752  
1753         trg->val.nodes = ly_realloc(trg->val.nodes, trg->size * sizeof *trg->val.nodes); 
1754         LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!trg->val.nodes, LOGMEM(src->ctx), LY_EMEM); 
1755     } 
1756  
1757     i = 0; 
1758     j = 0; 
1759     count = 0; 
1760     dup_count = 0; 
1761     do { 
1762         cmp = set_sort_compare(&src->val.nodes[i], &trg->val.nodes[j]); 
1763         if (!cmp) { 
1764             if (!count) { 
1765                 /* duplicate, just skip it */ 
1766                 ++i; 
1767                 ++j; 
1768             } else { 
1769                 /* we are copying something already, so let's copy the duplicate too, 
1770                  * we are hoping that afterwards there are some more nodes to 
1771                  * copy and this way we can copy them all together */ 
1772                 ++count; 
1773                 ++dup_count; 
1774                 ++i; 
1775                 ++j; 
1776             } 
1777         } else if (cmp < 0) { 
1778             /* inserting src node into trg, just remember it for now */ 
1779             ++count; 
1780             ++i; 
1781  
1782             /* insert the hash now */ 
1783             set_insert_node_hash(trg, src->val.nodes[i - 1].node, src->val.nodes[i - 1].type); 
1784         } else if (count) { 
1785 copy_nodes: 
1786             /* time to actually copy the nodes, we have found the largest block of nodes */ 
1787             memmove(&trg->val.nodes[j + (count - dup_count)], 
1788                     &trg->val.nodes[j], 
1789                     (trg->used - j) * sizeof *trg->val.nodes); 
1790             memcpy(&trg->val.nodes[j - dup_count], &src->val.nodes[i - count], count * sizeof *src->val.nodes); 
1791  
1792             trg->used += count - dup_count; 
1793             /* do not change i, except the copying above, we are basically doing exactly what is in the else branch below */ 
1794             j += count - dup_count; 
1795  
1796             count = 0; 
1797             dup_count = 0; 
1798         } else { 
1799             ++j; 
1800         } 
1801     } while ((i < src->used) && (j < trg->used)); 
1802  
1803     if ((i < src->used) || count) { 
1804         /* insert all the hashes first */ 
1805         for (k = i; k < src->used; ++k) { 
1806             set_insert_node_hash(trg, src->val.nodes[k].node, src->val.nodes[k].type); 
1807         } 
1808  
1809         /* loop ended, but we need to copy something at trg end */ 
1810         count += src->used - i; 
1811         i = src->used; 
1812         goto copy_nodes; 
1813     } 
1814  
1815     /* we are inserting hashes before the actual node insert, which causes 
1816      * situations when there were initially not enough items for a hash table, 
1817      * but even after some were inserted, hash table was not created (during 
1818      * insertion the number of items is not updated yet) */ 
1819     if (!trg->ht && (trg->used >= LYD_HT_MIN_ITEMS)) { 
1820         set_insert_node_hash(trg, NULL, 0); 
1821     } 
1822  
1823 #ifndef NDEBUG 
1824     LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "MERGE result"); 
1825     print_set_debug(trg); 
1826 #endif 
1827  
1828     lyxp_set_free_content(src); 
1829     return LY_SUCCESS; 
1830 } 
1831  
1832 LY_ERR 
1833 lyxp_check_token(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t tok_idx, enum lyxp_token want_tok) 
1834 { 
1835     if (exp->used == tok_idx) { 
1836         if (ctx) { 
1837             LOGVAL(ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_EOF); 
1838         } 
1839         return LY_EINCOMPLETE; 
1840     } 
1841  
1842     if (want_tok && (exp->tokens[tok_idx] != want_tok)) { 
1843         if (ctx) { 
1844             LOGVAL(ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INTOK2, lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[tok_idx]), 
1845                     &exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[tok_idx]], lyxp_print_token(want_tok)); 
1846         } 
1847         return LY_ENOT; 
1848     } 
1849  
1850     return LY_SUCCESS; 
1851 } 
1852  
1853 LY_ERR 
1854 lyxp_next_token(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, enum lyxp_token want_tok) 
1855 { 
1856     LY_CHECK_RET(lyxp_check_token(ctx, exp, *tok_idx, want_tok)); 
1857  
1858     /* skip the token */ 
1859     ++(*tok_idx); 
1860  
1861     return LY_SUCCESS; 
1862 } 
1863  
1864 /* just like lyxp_check_token() but tests for 2 tokens */ 
1865 static LY_ERR 
1866 exp_check_token2(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t tok_idx, enum lyxp_token want_tok1, 
1867         enum lyxp_token want_tok2) 
1868 { 
1869     if (exp->used == tok_idx) { 
1870         if (ctx) { 
1871             LOGVAL(ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_EOF); 
1872         } 
1873         return LY_EINCOMPLETE; 
1874     } 
1875  
1876     if ((exp->tokens[tok_idx] != want_tok1) && (exp->tokens[tok_idx] != want_tok2)) { 
1877         if (ctx) { 
1878             LOGVAL(ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INTOK, lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[tok_idx]), 
1879                     &exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[tok_idx]]); 
1880         } 
1881         return LY_ENOT; 
1882     } 
1883  
1884     return LY_SUCCESS; 
1885 } 
1886  
1887 LY_ERR 
1888 lyxp_next_token2(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, enum lyxp_token want_tok1, 
1889         enum lyxp_token want_tok2) 
1890 { 
1891     LY_CHECK_RET(exp_check_token2(ctx, exp, *tok_idx, want_tok1, want_tok2)); 
1892  
1893     /* skip the token */ 
1894     ++(*tok_idx); 
1895  
1896     return LY_SUCCESS; 
1897 } 
1898  
1899 /** 
1900  * @brief Stack operation push on the repeat array. 
1901  * 
1902  * @param[in] exp Expression to use. 
1903  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expresion \p exp. 
1904  * @param[in] repeat_op_idx Index from \p exp of the operator token. This value is pushed. 
1905  */ 
1906 static void 
1907 exp_repeat_push(struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t tok_idx, uint16_t repeat_op_idx) 
1908 { 
1909     uint16_t i; 
1910  
1911     if (exp->repeat[tok_idx]) { 
1912         for (i = 0; exp->repeat[tok_idx][i]; ++i) {} 
1913         exp->repeat[tok_idx] = realloc(exp->repeat[tok_idx], (i + 2) * sizeof *exp->repeat[tok_idx]); 
1914         LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!exp->repeat[tok_idx], LOGMEM(NULL), ); 
1915         exp->repeat[tok_idx][i] = repeat_op_idx; 
1916         exp->repeat[tok_idx][i + 1] = 0; 
1917     } else { 
1918         exp->repeat[tok_idx] = calloc(2, sizeof *exp->repeat[tok_idx]); 
1919         LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!exp->repeat[tok_idx], LOGMEM(NULL), ); 
1920         exp->repeat[tok_idx][0] = repeat_op_idx; 
1921     } 
1922 } 
1923  
1924 /** 
1925  * @brief Reparse Predicate. Logs directly on error. 
1926  * 
1927  * [7] Predicate ::= '[' Expr ']' 
1928  * 
1929  * @param[in] ctx Context for logging. 
1930  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
1931  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
1932  * @param[in] depth Current number of nested expressions. 
1933  * @return LY_ERR 
1934  */ 
1935 static LY_ERR 
1936 reparse_predicate(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, uint16_t depth) 
1937 { 
1938     LY_ERR rc; 
1939  
1940     rc = lyxp_check_token(ctx, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_BRACK1); 
1941     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
1942     ++(*tok_idx); 
1943  
1944     rc = reparse_or_expr(ctx, exp, tok_idx, depth); 
1945     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
1946  
1947     rc = lyxp_check_token(ctx, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_BRACK2); 
1948     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
1949     ++(*tok_idx); 
1950  
1951     return LY_SUCCESS; 
1952 } 
1953  
1954 /** 
1955  * @brief Reparse RelativeLocationPath. Logs directly on error. 
1956  * 
1957  * [4] RelativeLocationPath ::= Step | RelativeLocationPath '/' Step | RelativeLocationPath '//' Step 
1958  * [5] Step ::= '@'? NodeTest Predicate* | '.' | '..' 
1959  * [6] NodeTest ::= NameTest | NodeType '(' ')' 
1960  * 
1961  * @param[in] ctx Context for logging. 
1962  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
1963  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression \p exp. 
1964  * @param[in] depth Current number of nested expressions. 
1965  * @return LY_ERR (LY_EINCOMPLETE on forward reference) 
1966  */ 
1967 static LY_ERR 
1968 reparse_relative_location_path(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, uint16_t depth) 
1969 { 
1970     LY_ERR rc; 
1971  
1972     rc = lyxp_check_token(ctx, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_NONE); 
1973     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
1974  
1975     goto step; 
1976     do { 
1977         /* '/' or '//' */ 
1978         ++(*tok_idx); 
1979  
1980         rc = lyxp_check_token(ctx, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_NONE); 
1981         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
1982 step: 
1983         /* Step */ 
1984         switch (exp->tokens[*tok_idx]) { 
1985         case LYXP_TOKEN_DOT: 
1986             ++(*tok_idx); 
1987             break; 
1988  
1989         case LYXP_TOKEN_DDOT: 
1990             ++(*tok_idx); 
1991             break; 
1992  
1993         case LYXP_TOKEN_AT: 
1994             ++(*tok_idx); 
1995  
1996             rc = lyxp_check_token(ctx, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_NONE); 
1997             LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
1998             if ((exp->tokens[*tok_idx] != LYXP_TOKEN_NAMETEST) && (exp->tokens[*tok_idx] != LYXP_TOKEN_NODETYPE)) { 
1999                 LOGVAL(ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INTOK, lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), &exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]]); 
2000                 return LY_EVALID; 
2001             } 
2002         /* fall through */ 
2003         case LYXP_TOKEN_NAMETEST: 
2004             ++(*tok_idx); 
2005             goto reparse_predicate; 
2006  
2007         case LYXP_TOKEN_NODETYPE: 
2008             ++(*tok_idx); 
2009  
2010             /* '(' */ 
2011             rc = lyxp_check_token(ctx, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_PAR1); 
2012             LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2013             ++(*tok_idx); 
2014  
2015             /* ')' */ 
2016             rc = lyxp_check_token(ctx, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_PAR2); 
2017             LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2018             ++(*tok_idx); 
2019  
2020 reparse_predicate: 
2021             /* Predicate* */ 
2022             while (!lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_BRACK1)) { 
2023                 rc = reparse_predicate(ctx, exp, tok_idx, depth); 
2024                 LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2025             } 
2026             break; 
2027         default: 
2028             LOGVAL(ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INTOK, lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), &exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]]); 
2029             return LY_EVALID; 
2030         } 
2031     } while (!exp_check_token2(NULL, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_PATH, LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_RPATH)); 
2032  
2033     return LY_SUCCESS; 
2034 } 
2035  
2036 /** 
2037  * @brief Reparse AbsoluteLocationPath. Logs directly on error. 
2038  * 
2039  * [3] AbsoluteLocationPath ::= '/' RelativeLocationPath? | '//' RelativeLocationPath 
2040  * 
2041  * @param[in] ctx Context for logging. 
2042  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
2043  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression \p exp. 
2044  * @param[in] depth Current number of nested expressions. 
2045  * @return LY_ERR 
2046  */ 
2047 static LY_ERR 
2048 reparse_absolute_location_path(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, uint16_t depth) 
2049 { 
2050     LY_ERR rc; 
2051  
2052     LY_CHECK_RET(exp_check_token2(ctx, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_PATH, LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_RPATH)); 
2053  
2054     /* '/' RelativeLocationPath? */ 
2055     if (exp->tokens[*tok_idx] == LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_PATH) { 
2056         /* '/' */ 
2057         ++(*tok_idx); 
2058  
2059         if (lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_NONE)) { 
2060             return LY_SUCCESS; 
2061         } 
2062         switch (exp->tokens[*tok_idx]) { 
2063         case LYXP_TOKEN_DOT: 
2064         case LYXP_TOKEN_DDOT: 
2065         case LYXP_TOKEN_AT: 
2066         case LYXP_TOKEN_NAMETEST: 
2067         case LYXP_TOKEN_NODETYPE: 
2068             rc = reparse_relative_location_path(ctx, exp, tok_idx, depth); 
2069             LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2070         /* fall through */ 
2071         default: 
2072             break; 
2073         } 
2074  
2075     } else { 
2076         /* '//' RelativeLocationPath */ 
2077         ++(*tok_idx); 
2078  
2079         rc = reparse_relative_location_path(ctx, exp, tok_idx, depth); 
2080         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2081     } 
2082  
2083     return LY_SUCCESS; 
2084 }
