2086 /** 
2087  * @brief Reparse FunctionCall. Logs directly on error. 
2088  * 
2089  * [9] FunctionCall ::= FunctionName '(' ( Expr ( ',' Expr )* )? ')' 
2090  * 
2091  * @param[in] ctx Context for logging. 
2092  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
2093  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
2094  * @param[in] depth Current number of nested expressions. 
2095  * @return LY_ERR 
2096  */ 
2097 static LY_ERR 
2098 reparse_function_call(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, uint16_t depth) 
2099 { 
2100     int8_t min_arg_count = -1; 
2101     uint32_t arg_count, max_arg_count = 0; 
2102     uint16_t func_tok_idx; 
2103     LY_ERR rc; 
2104  
2105     rc = lyxp_check_token(ctx, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_FUNCNAME); 
2106     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2107     func_tok_idx = *tok_idx; 
2108     switch (exp->tok_len[*tok_idx]) { 
2109     case 3: 
2110         if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "not", 3)) { 
2111             min_arg_count = 1; 
2112             max_arg_count = 1; 
2113         } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "sum", 3)) { 
2114             min_arg_count = 1; 
2115             max_arg_count = 1; 
2116         } 
2117         break; 
2118     case 4: 
2119         if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "lang", 4)) { 
2120             min_arg_count = 1; 
2121             max_arg_count = 1; 
2122         } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "last", 4)) { 
2123             min_arg_count = 0; 
2124             max_arg_count = 0; 
2125         } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "name", 4)) { 
2126             min_arg_count = 0; 
2127             max_arg_count = 1; 
2128         } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "true", 4)) { 
2129             min_arg_count = 0; 
2130             max_arg_count = 0; 
2131         } 
2132         break; 
2133     case 5: 
2134         if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "count", 5)) { 
2135             min_arg_count = 1; 
2136             max_arg_count = 1; 
2137         } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "false", 5)) { 
2138             min_arg_count = 0; 
2139             max_arg_count = 0; 
2140         } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "floor", 5)) { 
2141             min_arg_count = 1; 
2142             max_arg_count = 1; 
2143         } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "round", 5)) { 
2144             min_arg_count = 1; 
2145             max_arg_count = 1; 
2146         } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "deref", 5)) { 
2147             min_arg_count = 1; 
2148             max_arg_count = 1; 
2149         } 
2150         break; 
2151     case 6: 
2152         if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "concat", 6)) { 
2153             min_arg_count = 2; 
2154             max_arg_count = UINT32_MAX; 
2155         } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "number", 6)) { 
2156             min_arg_count = 0; 
2157             max_arg_count = 1; 
2158         } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "string", 6)) { 
2159             min_arg_count = 0; 
2160             max_arg_count = 1; 
2161         } 
2162         break; 
2163     case 7: 
2164         if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "boolean", 7)) { 
2165             min_arg_count = 1; 
2166             max_arg_count = 1; 
2167         } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "ceiling", 7)) { 
2168             min_arg_count = 1; 
2169             max_arg_count = 1; 
2170         } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "current", 7)) { 
2171             min_arg_count = 0; 
2172             max_arg_count = 0; 
2173         } 
2174         break; 
2175     case 8: 
2176         if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "contains", 8)) { 
2177             min_arg_count = 2; 
2178             max_arg_count = 2; 
2179         } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "position", 8)) { 
2180             min_arg_count = 0; 
2181             max_arg_count = 0; 
2182         } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "re-match", 8)) { 
2183             min_arg_count = 2; 
2184             max_arg_count = 2; 
2185         } 
2186         break; 
2187     case 9: 
2188         if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "substring", 9)) { 
2189             min_arg_count = 2; 
2190             max_arg_count = 3; 
2191         } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "translate", 9)) { 
2192             min_arg_count = 3; 
2193             max_arg_count = 3; 
2194         } 
2195         break; 
2196     case 10: 
2197         if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "local-name", 10)) { 
2198             min_arg_count = 0; 
2199             max_arg_count = 1; 
2200         } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "enum-value", 10)) { 
2201             min_arg_count = 1; 
2202             max_arg_count = 1; 
2203         } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "bit-is-set", 10)) { 
2204             min_arg_count = 2; 
2205             max_arg_count = 2; 
2206         } 
2207         break; 
2208     case 11: 
2209         if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "starts-with", 11)) { 
2210             min_arg_count = 2; 
2211             max_arg_count = 2; 
2212         } 
2213         break; 
2214     case 12: 
2215         if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "derived-from", 12)) { 
2216             min_arg_count = 2; 
2217             max_arg_count = 2; 
2218         } 
2219         break; 
2220     case 13: 
2221         if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "namespace-uri", 13)) { 
2222             min_arg_count = 0; 
2223             max_arg_count = 1; 
2224         } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "string-length", 13)) { 
2225             min_arg_count = 0; 
2226             max_arg_count = 1; 
2227         } 
2228         break; 
2229     case 15: 
2230         if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "normalize-space", 15)) { 
2231             min_arg_count = 0; 
2232             max_arg_count = 1; 
2233         } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "substring-after", 15)) { 
2234             min_arg_count = 2; 
2235             max_arg_count = 2; 
2236         } 
2237         break; 
2238     case 16: 
2239         if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "substring-before", 16)) { 
2240             min_arg_count = 2; 
2241             max_arg_count = 2; 
2242         } 
2243         break; 
2244     case 20: 
2245         if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "derived-from-or-self", 20)) { 
2246             min_arg_count = 2; 
2247             max_arg_count = 2; 
2248         } 
2249         break; 
2250     } 
2251     if (min_arg_count == -1) { 
2252         LOGVAL(ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INFUNC, exp->tok_len[*tok_idx], &exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]]); 
2253         return LY_EINVAL; 
2254     } 
2255     ++(*tok_idx); 
2256  
2257     /* '(' */ 
2258     rc = lyxp_check_token(ctx, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_PAR1); 
2259     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2260     ++(*tok_idx); 
2261  
2262     /* ( Expr ( ',' Expr )* )? */ 
2263     arg_count = 0; 
2264     rc = lyxp_check_token(ctx, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_NONE); 
2265     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2266     if (exp->tokens[*tok_idx] != LYXP_TOKEN_PAR2) { 
2267         ++arg_count; 
2268         rc = reparse_or_expr(ctx, exp, tok_idx, depth); 
2269         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2270     } 
2271     while (!lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_COMMA)) { 
2272         ++(*tok_idx); 
2273  
2274         ++arg_count; 
2275         rc = reparse_or_expr(ctx, exp, tok_idx, depth); 
2276         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2277     } 
2278  
2279     /* ')' */ 
2280     rc = lyxp_check_token(ctx, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_PAR2); 
2281     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2282     ++(*tok_idx); 
2283  
2284     if ((arg_count < (uint32_t)min_arg_count) || (arg_count > max_arg_count)) { 
2285         LOGVAL(ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INARGCOUNT, arg_count, exp->tok_len[func_tok_idx], &exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[func_tok_idx]]); 
2286         return LY_EVALID; 
2287     } 
2288  
2289     return LY_SUCCESS; 
2290 } 
2291  
2292 /** 
2293  * @brief Reparse PathExpr. Logs directly on error. 
2294  * 
2295  * [10] PathExpr ::= LocationPath | PrimaryExpr Predicate* 
2296  *                 | PrimaryExpr Predicate* '/' RelativeLocationPath 
2297  *                 | PrimaryExpr Predicate* '//' RelativeLocationPath 
2298  * [2] LocationPath ::= RelativeLocationPath | AbsoluteLocationPath 
2299  * [8] PrimaryExpr ::= VariableReference | '(' Expr ')' | Literal | Number | FunctionCall 
2300  * 
2301  * @param[in] ctx Context for logging. 
2302  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
2303  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
2304  * @param[in] depth Current number of nested expressions. 
2305  * @return LY_ERR 
2306  */ 
2307 static LY_ERR 
2308 reparse_path_expr(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, uint16_t depth) 
2309 { 
2310     LY_ERR rc; 
2311  
2312     if (lyxp_check_token(ctx, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_NONE)) { 
2313         return LY_EVALID; 
2314     } 
2315  
2316     switch (exp->tokens[*tok_idx]) { 
2317     case LYXP_TOKEN_PAR1: 
2318         /* '(' Expr ')' Predicate* */ 
2319         ++(*tok_idx); 
2320  
2321         rc = reparse_or_expr(ctx, exp, tok_idx, depth); 
2322         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2323  
2324         rc = lyxp_check_token(ctx, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_PAR2); 
2325         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2326         ++(*tok_idx); 
2327         goto predicate; 
2328     case LYXP_TOKEN_DOT: 
2329     case LYXP_TOKEN_DDOT: 
2330     case LYXP_TOKEN_AT: 
2331     case LYXP_TOKEN_NAMETEST: 
2332     case LYXP_TOKEN_NODETYPE: 
2333         /* RelativeLocationPath */ 
2334         rc = reparse_relative_location_path(ctx, exp, tok_idx, depth); 
2335         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2336         break; 
2337     case LYXP_TOKEN_VARREF: 
2338         /* VariableReference */ 
2339         ++(*tok_idx); 
2340         goto predicate; 
2341     case LYXP_TOKEN_FUNCNAME: 
2342         /* FunctionCall */ 
2343         rc = reparse_function_call(ctx, exp, tok_idx, depth); 
2344         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2345         goto predicate; 
2346     case LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_PATH: 
2347     case LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_RPATH: 
2348         /* AbsoluteLocationPath */ 
2349         rc = reparse_absolute_location_path(ctx, exp, tok_idx, depth); 
2350         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2351         break; 
2352     case LYXP_TOKEN_LITERAL: 
2353         /* Literal */ 
2354         ++(*tok_idx); 
2355         goto predicate; 
2356     case LYXP_TOKEN_NUMBER: 
2357         /* Number */ 
2358         ++(*tok_idx); 
2359         goto predicate; 
2360     default: 
2361         LOGVAL(ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INTOK, lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), &exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]]); 
2362         return LY_EVALID; 
2363     } 
2364  
2365     return LY_SUCCESS; 
2366  
2367 predicate: 
2368     /* Predicate* */ 
2369     while (!lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_BRACK1)) { 
2370         rc = reparse_predicate(ctx, exp, tok_idx, depth); 
2371         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2372     } 
2373  
2374     /* ('/' or '//') RelativeLocationPath */ 
2375     if (!exp_check_token2(NULL, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_PATH, LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_RPATH)) { 
2376  
2377         /* '/' or '//' */ 
2378         ++(*tok_idx); 
2379  
2380         rc = reparse_relative_location_path(ctx, exp, tok_idx, depth); 
2381         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2382     } 
2383  
2384     return LY_SUCCESS; 
2385 } 
2386  
2387 /** 
2388  * @brief Reparse UnaryExpr. Logs directly on error. 
2389  * 
2390  * [17] UnaryExpr ::= UnionExpr | '-' UnaryExpr 
2391  * [18] UnionExpr ::= PathExpr | UnionExpr '|' PathExpr 
2392  * 
2393  * @param[in] ctx Context for logging. 
2394  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
2395  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
2396  * @param[in] depth Current number of nested expressions. 
2397  * @return LY_ERR 
2398  */ 
2399 static LY_ERR 
2400 reparse_unary_expr(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, uint16_t depth) 
2401 { 
2402     uint16_t prev_exp; 
2403     LY_ERR rc; 
2404  
2405     /* ('-')* */ 
2406     prev_exp = *tok_idx; 
2407     while (!lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_MATH) && 
2408             (exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]] == '-')) { 
2409         exp_repeat_push(exp, prev_exp, LYXP_EXPR_UNARY); 
2410         ++(*tok_idx); 
2411     } 
2412  
2413     /* PathExpr */ 
2414     prev_exp = *tok_idx; 
2415     rc = reparse_path_expr(ctx, exp, tok_idx, depth); 
2416     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2417  
2418     /* ('|' PathExpr)* */ 
2419     while (!lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_UNI)) { 
2420         exp_repeat_push(exp, prev_exp, LYXP_EXPR_UNION); 
2421         ++(*tok_idx); 
2422  
2423         rc = reparse_path_expr(ctx, exp, tok_idx, depth); 
2424         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2425     } 
2426  
2427     return LY_SUCCESS; 
2428 } 
2429  
2430 /** 
2431  * @brief Reparse AdditiveExpr. Logs directly on error. 
2432  * 
2433  * [15] AdditiveExpr ::= MultiplicativeExpr 
2434  *                     | AdditiveExpr '+' MultiplicativeExpr 
2435  *                     | AdditiveExpr '-' MultiplicativeExpr 
2436  * [16] MultiplicativeExpr ::= UnaryExpr 
2437  *                     | MultiplicativeExpr '*' UnaryExpr 
2438  *                     | MultiplicativeExpr 'div' UnaryExpr 
2439  *                     | MultiplicativeExpr 'mod' UnaryExpr 
2440  * 
2441  * @param[in] ctx Context for logging. 
2442  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
2443  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
2444  * @param[in] depth Current number of nested expressions. 
2445  * @return LY_ERR 
2446  */ 
2447 static LY_ERR 
2448 reparse_additive_expr(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, uint16_t depth) 
2449 { 
2450     uint16_t prev_add_exp, prev_mul_exp; 
2451     LY_ERR rc; 
2452  
2453     prev_add_exp = *tok_idx; 
2454     goto reparse_multiplicative_expr; 
2455  
2456     /* ('+' / '-' MultiplicativeExpr)* */ 
2457     while (!lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_MATH) && 
2458             ((exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]] == '+') || (exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]] == '-'))) { 
2459         exp_repeat_push(exp, prev_add_exp, LYXP_EXPR_ADDITIVE); 
2460         ++(*tok_idx); 
2461  
2462 reparse_multiplicative_expr: 
2463         /* UnaryExpr */ 
2464         prev_mul_exp = *tok_idx; 
2465         rc = reparse_unary_expr(ctx, exp, tok_idx, depth); 
2466         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2467  
2468         /* ('*' / 'div' / 'mod' UnaryExpr)* */ 
2469         while (!lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_MATH) && 
2470                 ((exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]] == '*') || (exp->tok_len[*tok_idx] == 3))) { 
2471             exp_repeat_push(exp, prev_mul_exp, LYXP_EXPR_MULTIPLICATIVE); 
2472             ++(*tok_idx); 
2473  
2474             rc = reparse_unary_expr(ctx, exp, tok_idx, depth); 
2475             LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2476         } 
2477     } 
2478  
2479     return LY_SUCCESS; 
2480 } 
2481  
2482 /** 
2483  * @brief Reparse EqualityExpr. Logs directly on error. 
2484  * 
2485  * [13] EqualityExpr ::= RelationalExpr | EqualityExpr '=' RelationalExpr 
2486  *                     | EqualityExpr '!=' RelationalExpr 
2487  * [14] RelationalExpr ::= AdditiveExpr 
2488  *                       | RelationalExpr '<' AdditiveExpr 
2489  *                       | RelationalExpr '>' AdditiveExpr 
2490  *                       | RelationalExpr '<=' AdditiveExpr 
2491  *                       | RelationalExpr '>=' AdditiveExpr 
2492  * 
2493  * @param[in] ctx Context for logging. 
2494  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
2495  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
2496  * @param[in] depth Current number of nested expressions. 
2497  * @return LY_ERR 
2498  */ 
2499 static LY_ERR 
2500 reparse_equality_expr(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, uint16_t depth) 
2501 { 
2502     uint16_t prev_eq_exp, prev_rel_exp; 
2503     LY_ERR rc; 
2504  
2505     prev_eq_exp = *tok_idx; 
2506     goto reparse_additive_expr; 
2507  
2508     /* ('=' / '!=' RelationalExpr)* */ 
2509     while (!exp_check_token2(NULL, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_EQUAL, LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_NEQUAL)) { 
2510         exp_repeat_push(exp, prev_eq_exp, LYXP_EXPR_EQUALITY); 
2511         ++(*tok_idx); 
2512  
2513 reparse_additive_expr: 
2514         /* AdditiveExpr */ 
2515         prev_rel_exp = *tok_idx; 
2516         rc = reparse_additive_expr(ctx, exp, tok_idx, depth); 
2517         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2518  
2519         /* ('<' / '>' / '<=' / '>=' AdditiveExpr)* */ 
2520         while (!lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_COMP)) { 
2521             exp_repeat_push(exp, prev_rel_exp, LYXP_EXPR_RELATIONAL); 
2522             ++(*tok_idx); 
2523  
2524             rc = reparse_additive_expr(ctx, exp, tok_idx, depth); 
2525             LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2526         } 
2527     } 
2528  
2529     return LY_SUCCESS; 
2530 } 
2531  
2532 /** 
2533  * @brief Reparse OrExpr. Logs directly on error. 
2534  * 
2535  * [11] OrExpr ::= AndExpr | OrExpr 'or' AndExpr 
2536  * [12] AndExpr ::= EqualityExpr | AndExpr 'and' EqualityExpr 
2537  * 
2538  * @param[in] ctx Context for logging. 
2539  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
2540  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
2541  * @param[in] depth Current number of nested expressions. 
2542  * @return LY_ERR 
2543  */ 
2544 static LY_ERR 
2545 reparse_or_expr(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, uint16_t depth) 
2546 { 
2547     uint16_t prev_or_exp, prev_and_exp; 
2548     LY_ERR rc; 
2549  
2550     ++depth; 
2551     LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(depth > LYXP_MAX_BLOCK_DEPTH, LOGVAL(ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_DEPTH), LY_EINVAL); 
2552  
2553     prev_or_exp = *tok_idx; 
2554     goto reparse_equality_expr; 
2555  
2556     /* ('or' AndExpr)* */ 
2557     while (!lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_LOG) && (exp->tok_len[*tok_idx] == 2)) { 
2558         exp_repeat_push(exp, prev_or_exp, LYXP_EXPR_OR); 
2559         ++(*tok_idx); 
2560  
2561 reparse_equality_expr: 
2562         /* EqualityExpr */ 
2563         prev_and_exp = *tok_idx; 
2564         rc = reparse_equality_expr(ctx, exp, tok_idx, depth); 
2565         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2566  
2567         /* ('and' EqualityExpr)* */ 
2568         while (!lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_LOG) && (exp->tok_len[*tok_idx] == 3)) { 
2569             exp_repeat_push(exp, prev_and_exp, LYXP_EXPR_AND); 
2570             ++(*tok_idx); 
2571  
2572             rc = reparse_equality_expr(ctx, exp, tok_idx, depth); 
2573             LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
2574         } 
2575     } 
2576  
2577     return LY_SUCCESS; 
2578 } 
2579  
2580 /** 
2581  * @brief Parse NCName. 
2582  * 
2583  * @param[in] ncname Name to parse. 
2584  * @return Length of @p ncname valid bytes. 
2585  */ 
2586 static long int 
2587 parse_ncname(const char *ncname) 
2588 { 
2589     uint32_t uc; 
2590     size_t size; 
2591     long int len = 0; 
2592  
2593     LY_CHECK_RET(ly_getutf8(&ncname, &uc, &size), 0); 
2594     if (!is_xmlqnamestartchar(uc) || (uc == ':')) { 
2595         return len; 
2596     } 
2597  
2598     do { 
2599         len += size; 
2600         if (!*ncname) { 
2601             break; 
2602         } 
2603         LY_CHECK_RET(ly_getutf8(&ncname, &uc, &size), -len); 
2604     } while (is_xmlqnamechar(uc) && (uc != ':')); 
2605  
2606     return len; 
2607 } 
2608  
2609 /** 
2610  * @brief Add @p token into the expression @p exp. 
2611  * 
2612  * @param[in] ctx Context for logging. 
2613  * @param[in] exp Expression to use. 
2614  * @param[in] token Token to add. 
2615  * @param[in] tok_pos Token position in the XPath expression. 
2616  * @param[in] tok_len Token length in the XPath expression. 
2617  * @return LY_ERR 
2618  */ 
2619 static LY_ERR 
2620 exp_add_token(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, struct lyxp_expr *exp, enum lyxp_token token, uint16_t tok_pos, uint16_t tok_len) 
2621 { 
2622     uint32_t prev; 
2623  
2624     if (exp->used == exp->size) { 
2625         prev = exp->size; 
2626         exp->size += LYXP_EXPR_SIZE_STEP; 
2627         if (prev > exp->size) { 
2628             LOGINT(ctx); 
2629             return LY_EINT; 
2630         } 
2631  
2632         exp->tokens = ly_realloc(exp->tokens, exp->size * sizeof *exp->tokens); 
2633         LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!exp->tokens, LOGMEM(ctx), LY_EMEM); 
2634         exp->tok_pos = ly_realloc(exp->tok_pos, exp->size * sizeof *exp->tok_pos); 
2635         LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!exp->tok_pos, LOGMEM(ctx), LY_EMEM); 
2636         exp->tok_len = ly_realloc(exp->tok_len, exp->size * sizeof *exp->tok_len); 
2637         LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!exp->tok_len, LOGMEM(ctx), LY_EMEM); 
2638     } 
2639  
2640     exp->tokens[exp->used] = token; 
2641     exp->tok_pos[exp->used] = tok_pos; 
2642     exp->tok_len[exp->used] = tok_len; 
2643     ++exp->used; 
2644     return LY_SUCCESS; 
2645 } 
2646  
2647 void 
2648 lyxp_expr_free(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, struct lyxp_expr *expr) 
2649 { 
2650     uint16_t i; 
2651  
2652     if (!expr) { 
2653         return; 
2654     } 
2655  
2656     lydict_remove(ctx, expr->expr); 
2657     free(expr->tokens); 
2658     free(expr->tok_pos); 
2659     free(expr->tok_len); 
2660     if (expr->repeat) { 
2661         for (i = 0; i < expr->used; ++i) { 
2662             free(expr->repeat[i]); 
2663         } 
2664     } 
2665     free(expr->repeat); 
2666     free(expr); 
2667 } 
2668  
2669 LY_ERR 
2670 lyxp_expr_parse(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, const char *expr_str, size_t expr_len, ly_bool reparse, struct lyxp_expr **expr_p) 
2671 { 
2672     LY_ERR ret = LY_SUCCESS; 
2673     struct lyxp_expr *expr; 
2674     size_t parsed = 0, tok_len; 
2675     enum lyxp_token tok_type; 
2676     ly_bool prev_function_check = 0; 
2677     uint16_t tok_idx = 0; 
2678  
2679     assert(expr_p); 
2680  
2681     if (!expr_str[0]) { 
2682         LOGVAL(ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_EOF); 
2683         return LY_EVALID; 
2684     } 
2685  
2686     if (!expr_len) { 
2687         expr_len = strlen(expr_str); 
2688     } 
2689     if (expr_len > UINT16_MAX) { 
2690         LOGVAL(ctx, LYVE_XPATH, "XPath expression cannot be longer than %u characters.", UINT16_MAX); 
2691         return LY_EVALID; 
2692     } 
2693  
2694     /* init lyxp_expr structure */ 
2695     expr = calloc(1, sizeof *expr); 
2696     LY_CHECK_ERR_GOTO(!expr, LOGMEM(ctx); ret = LY_EMEM, error); 
2697     LY_CHECK_GOTO(ret = lydict_insert(ctx, expr_str, expr_len, &expr->expr), error); 
2698     expr->used = 0; 
2699     expr->size = LYXP_EXPR_SIZE_START; 
2700     expr->tokens = malloc(expr->size * sizeof *expr->tokens); 
2701     LY_CHECK_ERR_GOTO(!expr->tokens, LOGMEM(ctx); ret = LY_EMEM, error); 
2702  
2703     expr->tok_pos = malloc(expr->size * sizeof *expr->tok_pos); 
2704     LY_CHECK_ERR_GOTO(!expr->tok_pos, LOGMEM(ctx); ret = LY_EMEM, error); 
2705  
2706     expr->tok_len = malloc(expr->size * sizeof *expr->tok_len); 
2707     LY_CHECK_ERR_GOTO(!expr->tok_len, LOGMEM(ctx); ret = LY_EMEM, error); 
2708  
2709     /* make expr 0-terminated */ 
2710     expr_str = expr->expr; 
2711  
2712     while (is_xmlws(expr_str[parsed])) { 
2713         ++parsed; 
2714     } 
2715  
2716     do { 
2717         if (expr_str[parsed] == '(') { 
2718  
2719             /* '(' */ 
2720             tok_len = 1; 
2721             tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_PAR1; 
2722  
2723             if (prev_function_check && expr->used && (expr->tokens[expr->used - 1] == LYXP_TOKEN_NAMETEST)) { 
2724                 /* it is a NodeType/FunctionName after all */ 
2725                 if (((expr->tok_len[expr->used - 1] == 4) && 
2726                         (!strncmp(&expr_str[expr->tok_pos[expr->used - 1]], "node", 4) || 
2727                         !strncmp(&expr_str[expr->tok_pos[expr->used - 1]], "text", 4))) || 
2728                         ((expr->tok_len[expr->used - 1] == 7) && 
2729                         !strncmp(&expr_str[expr->tok_pos[expr->used - 1]], "comment", 7))) { 
2730                     expr->tokens[expr->used - 1] = LYXP_TOKEN_NODETYPE; 
2731                 } else { 
2732                     expr->tokens[expr->used - 1] = LYXP_TOKEN_FUNCNAME; 
2733                 } 
2734                 prev_function_check = 0; 
2735             } 
2736  
2737         } else if (expr_str[parsed] == ')') { 
2738  
2739             /* ')' */ 
2740             tok_len = 1; 
2741             tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_PAR2; 
2742  
2743         } else if (expr_str[parsed] == '[') { 
2744  
2745             /* '[' */ 
2746             tok_len = 1; 
2747             tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_BRACK1; 
2748  
2749         } else if (expr_str[parsed] == ']') { 
2750  
2751             /* ']' */ 
2752             tok_len = 1; 
2753             tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_BRACK2; 
2754  
2755         } else if (!strncmp(&expr_str[parsed], "..", 2)) { 
2756  
2757             /* '..' */ 
2758             tok_len = 2; 
2759             tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_DDOT; 
2760  
2761         } else if ((expr_str[parsed] == '.') && (!isdigit(expr_str[parsed + 1]))) { 
2762  
2763             /* '.' */ 
2764             tok_len = 1; 
2765             tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_DOT; 
2766  
2767         } else if (expr_str[parsed] == '@') { 
2768  
2769             /* '@' */ 
2770             tok_len = 1; 
2771             tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_AT; 
2772  
2773         } else if (expr_str[parsed] == ',') { 
2774  
2775             /* ',' */ 
2776             tok_len = 1; 
2777             tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_COMMA; 
2778  
2779         } else if (expr_str[parsed] == '\'') { 
2780  
2781             /* Literal with ' */ 
2782             for (tok_len = 1; (expr_str[parsed + tok_len] != '\0') && (expr_str[parsed + tok_len] != '\''); ++tok_len) {} 
2783             LY_CHECK_ERR_GOTO(expr_str[parsed + tok_len] == '\0', 
2784                     LOGVAL(ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_EOE, expr_str[parsed], &expr_str[parsed]); ret = LY_EVALID, 
2785                     error); 
2786             ++tok_len; 
2787             tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_LITERAL; 
2788  
2789         } else if (expr_str[parsed] == '\"') { 
2790  
2791             /* Literal with " */ 
2792             for (tok_len = 1; (expr_str[parsed + tok_len] != '\0') && (expr_str[parsed + tok_len] != '\"'); ++tok_len) {} 
2793             LY_CHECK_ERR_GOTO(expr_str[parsed + tok_len] == '\0', 
2794                     LOGVAL(ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_EOE, expr_str[parsed], &expr_str[parsed]); ret = LY_EVALID, 
2795                     error); 
2796             ++tok_len; 
2797             tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_LITERAL; 
2798  
2799         } else if ((expr_str[parsed] == '.') || (isdigit(expr_str[parsed]))) { 
2800  
2801             /* Number */ 
2802             for (tok_len = 0; isdigit(expr_str[parsed + tok_len]); ++tok_len) {} 
2803             if (expr_str[parsed + tok_len] == '.') { 
2804                 ++tok_len; 
2805                 for ( ; isdigit(expr_str[parsed + tok_len]); ++tok_len) {} 
2806             } 
2807             tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_NUMBER; 
2808  
2809         } else if (expr_str[parsed] == '$') { 
2810  
2811             /* VariableReference */ 
2812             parsed++; 
2813             long int ncname_len = parse_ncname(&expr_str[parsed]); 
2814             LY_CHECK_ERR_GOTO(ncname_len < 1, LOGVAL(ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INEXPR, expr_str[parsed - ncname_len], 
2815                     parsed - ncname_len + 1, expr_str); ret = LY_EVALID, error); 
2816             tok_len = ncname_len; 
2817             LY_CHECK_ERR_GOTO(expr_str[parsed + tok_len] == ':', 
2818                     LOGVAL(ctx, LYVE_XPATH, "Variable with prefix is not supported."); ret = LY_EVALID, 
2819                     error); 
2820             tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_VARREF; 
2821  
2822         } else if (expr_str[parsed] == '/') { 
2823  
2824             /* Operator '/', '//' */ 
2825             if (!strncmp(&expr_str[parsed], "//", 2)) { 
2826                 tok_len = 2; 
2827                 tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_RPATH; 
2828             } else { 
2829                 tok_len = 1; 
2830                 tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_PATH; 
2831             } 
2832  
2833         } else if (!strncmp(&expr_str[parsed], "!=", 2)) { 
2834  
2835             /* Operator '!=' */ 
2836             tok_len = 2; 
2837             tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_NEQUAL; 
2838  
2839         } else if (!strncmp(&expr_str[parsed], "<=", 2) || !strncmp(&expr_str[parsed], ">=", 2)) { 
2840  
2841             /* Operator '<=', '>=' */ 
2842             tok_len = 2; 
2843             tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_COMP; 
2844  
2845         } else if (expr_str[parsed] == '|') { 
2846  
2847             /* Operator '|' */ 
2848             tok_len = 1; 
2849             tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_UNI; 
2850  
2851         } else if ((expr_str[parsed] == '+') || (expr_str[parsed] == '-')) { 
2852  
2853             /* Operator '+', '-' */ 
2854             tok_len = 1; 
2855             tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_MATH; 
2856  
2857         } else if (expr_str[parsed] == '=') { 
2858  
2859             /* Operator '=' */ 
2860             tok_len = 1; 
2861             tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_EQUAL; 
2862  
2863         } else if ((expr_str[parsed] == '<') || (expr_str[parsed] == '>')) { 
2864  
2865             /* Operator '<', '>' */ 
2866             tok_len = 1; 
2867             tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_COMP; 
2868  
2869         } else if (expr->used && (expr->tokens[expr->used - 1] != LYXP_TOKEN_AT) && 
2870                 (expr->tokens[expr->used - 1] != LYXP_TOKEN_PAR1) && 
2871                 (expr->tokens[expr->used - 1] != LYXP_TOKEN_BRACK1) && 
2872                 (expr->tokens[expr->used - 1] != LYXP_TOKEN_COMMA) && 
2873                 (expr->tokens[expr->used - 1] != LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_LOG) && 
2874                 (expr->tokens[expr->used - 1] != LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_EQUAL) && 
2875                 (expr->tokens[expr->used - 1] != LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_NEQUAL) && 
2876                 (expr->tokens[expr->used - 1] != LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_COMP) && 
2877                 (expr->tokens[expr->used - 1] != LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_MATH) && 
2878                 (expr->tokens[expr->used - 1] != LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_UNI) && 
2879                 (expr->tokens[expr->used - 1] != LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_PATH) && 
2880                 (expr->tokens[expr->used - 1] != LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_RPATH)) { 
2881  
2882             /* Operator '*', 'or', 'and', 'mod', or 'div' */ 
2883             if (expr_str[parsed] == '*') { 
2884                 tok_len = 1; 
2885                 tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_MATH; 
2886  
2887             } else if (!strncmp(&expr_str[parsed], "or", 2)) { 
2888                 tok_len = 2; 
2889                 tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_LOG; 
2890  
2891             } else if (!strncmp(&expr_str[parsed], "and", 3)) { 
2892                 tok_len = 3; 
2893                 tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_LOG; 
2894  
2895             } else if (!strncmp(&expr_str[parsed], "mod", 3) || !strncmp(&expr_str[parsed], "div", 3)) { 
2896                 tok_len = 3; 
2897                 tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_MATH; 
2898  
2899             } else if (prev_function_check) { 
2900                 LOGVAL(ctx, LYVE_XPATH, "Invalid character 0x%x ('%c'), perhaps \"%.*s\" is supposed to be a function call.", 
2901                         expr_str[parsed], expr_str[parsed], expr->tok_len[expr->used - 1], &expr->expr[expr->tok_pos[expr->used - 1]]); 
2902                 ret = LY_EVALID; 
2903                 goto error; 
2904             } else { 
2905                 LOGVAL(ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INEXPR, expr_str[parsed], parsed + 1, expr_str); 
2906                 ret = LY_EVALID; 
2907                 goto error; 
2908             } 
2909         } else if (expr_str[parsed] == '*') { 
2910  
2911             /* NameTest '*' */ 
2912             tok_len = 1; 
2913             tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_NAMETEST; 
2914  
2915         } else { 
2916  
2917             /* NameTest (NCName ':' '*' | QName) or NodeType/FunctionName */ 
2918             long int ncname_len = parse_ncname(&expr_str[parsed]); 
2919             LY_CHECK_ERR_GOTO(ncname_len < 1, LOGVAL(ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INEXPR, expr_str[parsed - ncname_len], 
2920                     parsed - ncname_len + 1, expr_str); ret = LY_EVALID, error); 
2921             tok_len = ncname_len; 
2922  
2923             if (expr_str[parsed + tok_len] == ':') { 
2924                 ++tok_len; 
2925                 if (expr_str[parsed + tok_len] == '*') { 
2926                     ++tok_len; 
2927                 } else { 
2928                     ncname_len = parse_ncname(&expr_str[parsed + tok_len]); 
2929                     LY_CHECK_ERR_GOTO(ncname_len < 1, LOGVAL(ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INEXPR, expr_str[parsed - ncname_len], 
2930                             parsed - ncname_len + 1, expr_str); ret = LY_EVALID, error); 
2931                     tok_len += ncname_len; 
2932                 } 
2933                 /* remove old flag to prevent ambiguities */ 
2934                 prev_function_check = 0; 
2935                 tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_NAMETEST; 
2936             } else { 
2937                 /* there is no prefix so it can still be NodeType/FunctionName, we can't finally decide now */ 
2938                 prev_function_check = 1; 
2939                 tok_type = LYXP_TOKEN_NAMETEST; 
2940             } 
2941         } 
2942  
2943         /* store the token, move on to the next one */ 
2944         LY_CHECK_GOTO(ret = exp_add_token(ctx, expr, tok_type, parsed, tok_len), error); 
2945         parsed += tok_len; 
2946         while (is_xmlws(expr_str[parsed])) { 
2947             ++parsed; 
2948         } 
2949  
2950     } while (expr_str[parsed]); 
2951  
2952     if (reparse) { 
2953         /* prealloc repeat */ 
2954         expr->repeat = calloc(expr->size, sizeof *expr->repeat); 
2955         LY_CHECK_ERR_GOTO(!expr->repeat, LOGMEM(ctx); ret = LY_EMEM, error); 
2956  
2957         /* fill repeat */ 
2958         LY_CHECK_ERR_GOTO(reparse_or_expr(ctx, expr, &tok_idx, 0), ret = LY_EVALID, error); 
2959         if (expr->used > tok_idx) { 
2960             LOGVAL(ctx, LYVE_XPATH, "Unparsed characters \"%s\" left at the end of an XPath expression.", 
2961                     &expr->expr[expr->tok_pos[tok_idx]]); 
2962             ret = LY_EVALID; 
2963             goto error; 
2964         } 
2965     } 
2966  
2967     print_expr_struct_debug(expr); 
2968     *expr_p = expr; 
2969     return LY_SUCCESS; 
2970  
2971 error: 
2972     lyxp_expr_free(ctx, expr); 
2973     return ret; 
2974 } 
2975  
2976 LY_ERR 
2977 lyxp_expr_dup(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, const struct lyxp_expr *exp, struct lyxp_expr **dup_p) 
2978 { 
2979     LY_ERR ret = LY_SUCCESS; 
2980     struct lyxp_expr *dup = NULL; 
2981     uint32_t i, j; 
2982  
2983     if (!exp) { 
2984         goto cleanup; 
2985     } 
2986  
2987     dup = calloc(1, sizeof *dup); 
2988     LY_CHECK_ERR_GOTO(!dup, LOGMEM(ctx); ret = LY_EMEM, cleanup); 
2989  
2990     if (exp->used) { 
2991         dup->tokens = malloc(exp->used * sizeof *dup->tokens); 
2992         LY_CHECK_ERR_GOTO(!dup->tokens, LOGMEM(ctx); ret = LY_EMEM, cleanup); 
2993         memcpy(dup->tokens, exp->tokens, exp->used * sizeof *dup->tokens); 
2994  
2995         dup->tok_pos = malloc(exp->used * sizeof *dup->tok_pos); 
2996         LY_CHECK_ERR_GOTO(!dup->tok_pos, LOGMEM(ctx); ret = LY_EMEM, cleanup); 
2997         memcpy(dup->tok_pos, exp->tok_pos, exp->used * sizeof *dup->tok_pos); 
2998  
2999         dup->tok_len = malloc(exp->used * sizeof *dup->tok_len); 
3000         LY_CHECK_ERR_GOTO(!dup->tok_len, LOGMEM(ctx); ret = LY_EMEM, cleanup); 
3001         memcpy(dup->tok_len, exp->tok_len, exp->used * sizeof *dup->tok_len); 
3002  
3003         dup->repeat = malloc(exp->used * sizeof *dup->repeat); 
3004         LY_CHECK_ERR_GOTO(!dup->repeat, LOGMEM(ctx); ret = LY_EMEM, cleanup); 
3005         for (i = 0; i < exp->used; ++i) { 
3006             if (!exp->repeat[i]) { 
3007                 dup->repeat[i] = NULL; 
3008             } else { 
3009                 for (j = 0; exp->repeat[i][j]; ++j) {} 
3010                 /* the ending 0 as well */ 
3011                 ++j; 
3012  
3013                 dup->repeat[i] = malloc(j * sizeof **dup->repeat); 
3014                 LY_CHECK_ERR_GOTO(!dup->repeat[i], LOGMEM(ctx); ret = LY_EMEM, cleanup); 
3015                 memcpy(dup->repeat[i], exp->repeat[i], j * sizeof **dup->repeat); 
3016                 dup->repeat[i][j - 1] = 0; 
3017             } 
3018         } 
3019     } 
3020  
3021     dup->used = exp->used; 
3022     dup->size = exp->used; 
3023     LY_CHECK_GOTO(ret = lydict_insert(ctx, exp->expr, 0, &dup->expr), cleanup); 
3024  
3025 cleanup: 
3026     if (ret) { 
3027         lyxp_expr_free(ctx, dup); 
3028     } else { 
3029         *dup_p = dup; 
3030     } 
3031     return ret; 
3032 } 
3033  
3034 /** 
3035  * @brief Get the last-added schema node that is currently in the context. 
3036  * 
3037  * @param[in] set Set to search in. 
3038  * @return Last-added schema context node, NULL if no node is in context. 
3039  */ 
3040 static struct lysc_node * 
3041 warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(struct lyxp_set *set) 
3042 { 
3043     uint32_t i; 
3044  
3045     if (!set || (set->type != LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET)) { 
3046         return NULL; 
3047     } 
3048  
3049     i = set->used; 
3050     do { 
3051         --i; 
3052         if (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_CTX) { 
3053             /* if there are more, simply return the first found (last added) */ 
3054             return set->val.scnodes[i].scnode; 
3055         } 
3056     } while (i); 
3057  
3058     return NULL; 
3059 } 
3060  
3061 /** 
3062  * @brief Test whether a type is numeric - integer type or decimal64. 
3063  * 
3064  * @param[in] type Type to test. 
3065  * @return Boolean value whether @p type is numeric type or not. 
3066  */ 
3067 static ly_bool 
3068 warn_is_numeric_type(struct lysc_type *type) 
3069 { 
3070     struct lysc_type_union *uni; 
3071     ly_bool ret; 
3072     LY_ARRAY_COUNT_TYPE u; 
3073  
3074     switch (type->basetype) { 
3075     case LY_TYPE_DEC64: 
3076     case LY_TYPE_INT8: 
3077     case LY_TYPE_UINT8: 
3078     case LY_TYPE_INT16: 
3079     case LY_TYPE_UINT16: 
3080     case LY_TYPE_INT32: 
3081     case LY_TYPE_UINT32: 
3082     case LY_TYPE_INT64: 
3083     case LY_TYPE_UINT64: 
3084         return 1; 
3085     case LY_TYPE_UNION: 
3086         uni = (struct lysc_type_union *)type; 
3087         LY_ARRAY_FOR(uni->types, u) { 
3088             ret = warn_is_numeric_type(uni->types[u]); 
3089             if (ret) { 
3090                 /* found a suitable type */ 
3091                 return ret; 
3092             } 
3093         } 
3094         /* did not find any suitable type */ 
3095         return 0; 
3096     case LY_TYPE_LEAFREF: 
3097         return warn_is_numeric_type(((struct lysc_type_leafref *)type)->realtype); 
3098     default: 
3099         return 0; 
3100     } 
3101 } 
3102  
3103 /** 
3104  * @brief Test whether a type is string-like - no integers, decimal64 or binary. 
3105  * 
3106  * @param[in] type Type to test. 
3107  * @return Boolean value whether @p type's basetype is string type or not. 
3108  */ 
3109 static ly_bool 
3110 warn_is_string_type(struct lysc_type *type) 
3111 { 
3112     struct lysc_type_union *uni; 
3113     ly_bool ret; 
3114     LY_ARRAY_COUNT_TYPE u; 
3115  
3116     switch (type->basetype) { 
3117     case LY_TYPE_BITS: 
3118     case LY_TYPE_ENUM: 
3119     case LY_TYPE_IDENT: 
3120     case LY_TYPE_INST: 
3121     case LY_TYPE_STRING: 
3122         return 1; 
3123     case LY_TYPE_UNION: 
3124         uni = (struct lysc_type_union *)type; 
3125         LY_ARRAY_FOR(uni->types, u) { 
3126             ret = warn_is_string_type(uni->types[u]); 
3127             if (ret) { 
3128                 /* found a suitable type */ 
3129                 return ret; 
3130             } 
3131         } 
3132         /* did not find any suitable type */ 
3133         return 0; 
3134     case LY_TYPE_LEAFREF: 
3135         return warn_is_string_type(((struct lysc_type_leafref *)type)->realtype); 
3136     default: 
3137         return 0; 
3138     } 
3139 } 
3140  
3141 /** 
3142  * @brief Test whether a type is one specific type. 
3143  * 
3144  * @param[in] type Type to test. 
3145  * @param[in] base Expected type. 
3146  * @return Boolean value whether the given @p type is of the specific basetype @p base. 
3147  */ 
3148 static ly_bool 
3149 warn_is_specific_type(struct lysc_type *type, LY_DATA_TYPE base) 
3150 { 
3151     struct lysc_type_union *uni; 
3152     ly_bool ret; 
3153     LY_ARRAY_COUNT_TYPE u; 
3154  
3155     if (type->basetype == base) { 
3156         return 1; 
3157     } else if (type->basetype == LY_TYPE_UNION) { 
3158         uni = (struct lysc_type_union *)type; 
3159         LY_ARRAY_FOR(uni->types, u) { 
3160             ret = warn_is_specific_type(uni->types[u], base); 
3161             if (ret) { 
3162                 /* found a suitable type */ 
3163                 return ret; 
3164             } 
3165         } 
3166         /* did not find any suitable type */ 
3167         return 0; 
3168     } else if (type->basetype == LY_TYPE_LEAFREF) { 
3169         return warn_is_specific_type(((struct lysc_type_leafref *)type)->realtype, base); 
3170     } 
3171  
3172     return 0; 
3173 } 
3174  
3175 /** 
3176  * @brief Get next type of a (union) type. 
3177  * 
3178  * @param[in] type Base type. 
3179  * @param[in] prev_type Previously returned type. 
3180  * @return Next type or NULL. 
3181  */ 
3182 static struct lysc_type * 
3183 warn_is_equal_type_next_type(struct lysc_type *type, struct lysc_type *prev_type) 
3184 { 
3185     struct lysc_type_union *uni; 
3186     ly_bool found = 0; 
3187     LY_ARRAY_COUNT_TYPE u; 
3188  
3189     switch (type->basetype) { 
3190     case LY_TYPE_UNION: 
3191         uni = (struct lysc_type_union *)type; 
3192         if (!prev_type) { 
3193             return uni->types[0]; 
3194         } 
3195         LY_ARRAY_FOR(uni->types, u) { 
3196             if (found) { 
3197                 return uni->types[u]; 
3198             } 
3199             if (prev_type == uni->types[u]) { 
3200                 found = 1; 
3201             } 
3202         } 
3203         return NULL; 
3204     default: 
3205         if (prev_type) { 
3206             assert(type == prev_type); 
3207             return NULL; 
3208         } else { 
3209             return type; 
3210         } 
3211     } 
3212 } 
3213  
3214 /** 
3215  * @brief Test whether 2 types have a common type. 
3216  * 
3217  * @param[in] type1 First type. 
3218  * @param[in] type2 Second type. 
3219  * @return 1 if they do, 0 otherwise. 
3220  */ 
3221 static int 
3222 warn_is_equal_type(struct lysc_type *type1, struct lysc_type *type2) 
3223 { 
3224     struct lysc_type *t1, *rt1, *t2, *rt2; 
3225  
3226     t1 = NULL; 
3227     while ((t1 = warn_is_equal_type_next_type(type1, t1))) { 
3228         if (t1->basetype == LY_TYPE_LEAFREF) { 
3229             rt1 = ((struct lysc_type_leafref *)t1)->realtype; 
3230         } else { 
3231             rt1 = t1; 
3232         } 
3233  
3234         t2 = NULL; 
3235         while ((t2 = warn_is_equal_type_next_type(type2, t2))) { 
3236             if (t2->basetype == LY_TYPE_LEAFREF) { 
3237                 rt2 = ((struct lysc_type_leafref *)t2)->realtype; 
3238             } else { 
3239                 rt2 = t2; 
3240             } 
3241  
3242             if (rt2->basetype == rt1->basetype) { 
3243                 /* match found */ 
3244                 return 1; 
3245             } 
3246         } 
3247     } 
3248  
3249     return 0; 
3250 }

3252 /** 
3253  * @brief Print warning with information about the XPath subexpression that caused previous warning. 
3254  * 
3255  * @param[in] ctx Context for logging. 
3256  * @param[in] tok_pos Index of the subexpression in the whole expression. 
3257  * @param[in] subexpr Subexpression start. 
3258  * @param[in] subexpr_len Length of @p subexpr to print. 
3259  * @param[in] cur_scnode Expression context node. 
3260  */ 
3261 static void 
3262 warn_subexpr_log(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, uint16_t tok_pos, const char *subexpr, int subexpr_len, 
3263         const struct lysc_node *cur_scnode) 
3264 { 
3265     char *path; 
3266  
3267     path = lysc_path(cur_scnode, LYSC_PATH_LOG, NULL, 0); 
3268     LOGWRN(ctx, "Previous warning generated by XPath subexpression[%" PRIu16 "] \"%.*s\" with context node \"%s\".", 
3269             tok_pos, subexpr_len, subexpr, path); 
3270     free(path); 
3271 }

3273 /** 
3274  * @brief Check both operands of comparison operators. 
3275  * 
3276  * @param[in] ctx Context for errors. 
3277  * @param[in] set1 First operand set. 
3278  * @param[in] set2 Second operand set. 
3279  * @param[in] numbers_only Whether accept only numbers or other types are fine too (for '=' and '!='). 
3280  * @param[in] expr Start of the expression to print with the warning. 
3281  * @param[in] tok_pos Token position. 
3282  */ 
3283 static void 
3284 warn_operands(struct ly_ctx *ctx, struct lyxp_set *set1, struct lyxp_set *set2, ly_bool numbers_only, const char *expr, 
3285         uint16_t tok_pos) 
3286 { 
3287     struct lysc_node_leaf *node1, *node2; 
3288     ly_bool leaves = 1, warning = 0; 
3289  
3290     node1 = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(set1); 
3291     node2 = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(set2); 
3292  
3293     if (!node1 && !node2) { 
3294         /* no node-sets involved, nothing to do */ 
3295         return; 
3296     } 
3297  
3298     if (node1) { 
3299         if (!(node1->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST))) { 
3300             LOGWRN(ctx, "Node type %s \"%s\" used as operand.", lys_nodetype2str(node1->nodetype), node1->name); 
3301             warning = 1; 
3302             leaves = 0; 
3303         } else if (numbers_only && !warn_is_numeric_type(node1->type)) { 
3304             LOGWRN(ctx, "Node \"%s\" is not of a numeric type, but used where it was expected.", node1->name); 
3305             warning = 1; 
3306         } 
3307     } 
3308  
3309     if (node2) { 
3310         if (!(node2->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST))) { 
3311             LOGWRN(ctx, "Node type %s \"%s\" used as operand.", lys_nodetype2str(node2->nodetype), node2->name); 
3312             warning = 1; 
3313             leaves = 0; 
3314         } else if (numbers_only && !warn_is_numeric_type(node2->type)) { 
3315             LOGWRN(ctx, "Node \"%s\" is not of a numeric type, but used where it was expected.", node2->name); 
3316             warning = 1; 
3317         } 
3318     } 
3319  
3320     if (node1 && node2 && leaves && !numbers_only) { 
3321         if ((warn_is_numeric_type(node1->type) && !warn_is_numeric_type(node2->type)) || 
3322                 (!warn_is_numeric_type(node1->type) && warn_is_numeric_type(node2->type)) || 
3323                 (!warn_is_numeric_type(node1->type) && !warn_is_numeric_type(node2->type) && 
3324                 !warn_is_equal_type(node1->type, node2->type))) { 
3325             LOGWRN(ctx, "Incompatible types of operands \"%s\" and \"%s\" for comparison.", node1->name, node2->name); 
3326             warning = 1; 
3327         } 
3328     } 
3329  
3330     if (warning) { 
3331         warn_subexpr_log(ctx, tok_pos, expr + tok_pos, 20, set1->cur_scnode); 
3332     } 
3333 }

3335 /** 
3336  * @brief Check that a value is valid for a leaf. If not applicable, does nothing. 
3337  * 
3338  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
3339  * @param[in] set Set with the leaf/leaf-list. 
3340  * @param[in] val_exp Index of the value (literal/number) in @p exp. 
3341  * @param[in] equal_exp Index of the start of the equality expression in @p exp. 
3342  * @param[in] last_equal_exp Index of the end of the equality expression in @p exp. 
3343  */ 
3344 static void 
3345 warn_equality_value(const struct lyxp_expr *exp, struct lyxp_set *set, uint16_t val_exp, uint16_t equal_exp, 
3346         uint16_t last_equal_exp) 
3347 { 
3348     struct lysc_node *scnode; 
3349     struct lysc_type *type; 
3350     char *value; 
3351     struct lyd_value storage; 
3352     LY_ERR rc; 
3353     struct ly_err_item *err = NULL; 
3354  
3355     if ((scnode = warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(set)) && (scnode->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST)) && 
3356             ((exp->tokens[val_exp] == LYXP_TOKEN_LITERAL) || (exp->tokens[val_exp] == LYXP_TOKEN_NUMBER))) { 
3357         /* check that the node can have the specified value */ 
3358         if (exp->tokens[val_exp] == LYXP_TOKEN_LITERAL) { 
3359             value = strndup(exp->expr + exp->tok_pos[val_exp] + 1, exp->tok_len[val_exp] - 2); 
3360         } else { 
3361             value = strndup(exp->expr + exp->tok_pos[val_exp], exp->tok_len[val_exp]); 
3362         } 
3363         if (!value) { 
3364             LOGMEM(set->ctx); 
3365             return; 
3366         } 
3367  
3368         if ((((struct lysc_node_leaf *)scnode)->type->basetype == LY_TYPE_IDENT) && !strchr(value, ':')) { 
3369             LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Identityref \"%s\" comparison with identity \"%s\" without prefix, consider adding" 
3370                     " a prefix or best using \"derived-from(-or-self)()\" functions.", scnode->name, value); 
3371             warn_subexpr_log(set->ctx, exp->tok_pos[equal_exp], exp->expr + exp->tok_pos[equal_exp], 
3372                     (exp->tok_pos[last_equal_exp] - exp->tok_pos[equal_exp]) + exp->tok_len[last_equal_exp], 
3373                     set->cur_scnode); 
3374         } 
3375  
3376         type = ((struct lysc_node_leaf *)scnode)->type; 
3377         if (type->basetype != LY_TYPE_IDENT) { 
3378             rc = type->plugin->store(set->ctx, type, value, strlen(value), 0, set->format, set->prefix_data, 
3379                     LYD_HINT_DATA, scnode, &storage, NULL, &err); 
3380             if (rc == LY_EINCOMPLETE) { 
3381                 rc = LY_SUCCESS; 
3382             } 
3383  
3384             if (err) { 
3385                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Invalid value \"%s\" which does not fit the type (%s).", value, err->msg); 
3386                 ly_err_free(err); 
3387             } else if (rc != LY_SUCCESS) { 
3388                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Invalid value \"%s\" which does not fit the type.", value); 
3389             } 
3390             if (rc != LY_SUCCESS) { 
3391                 warn_subexpr_log(set->ctx, exp->tok_pos[equal_exp], exp->expr + exp->tok_pos[equal_exp], 
3392                         (exp->tok_pos[last_equal_exp] - exp->tok_pos[equal_exp]) + exp->tok_len[last_equal_exp], 
3393                         set->cur_scnode); 
3394             } else { 
3395                 type->plugin->free(set->ctx, &storage); 
3396             } 
3397         } 
3398         free(value); 
3399     } 
3400 }

3406 /** 
3407  * @brief Execute the YANG 1.1 bit-is-set(node-set, string) function. Returns LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN 
3408  *        depending on whether the first node bit value from the second argument is set. 
3409  * 
3410  * @param[in] args Array of arguments. 
3411  * @param[in] arg_count Count of elements in @p args. 
3412  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set at the same time. 
3413  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
3414  * @return LY_ERR 
3415  */ 
3416 static LY_ERR 
3417 xpath_bit_is_set(struct lyxp_set **args, uint16_t UNUSED(arg_count), struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
3418 { 
3419     struct lyd_node_term *leaf; 
3420     struct lysc_node_leaf *sleaf; 
3421     struct lyd_value_bits *bits; 
3422     LY_ERR rc = LY_SUCCESS; 
3423     LY_ARRAY_COUNT_TYPE u; 
3424  
3425     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
3426         if (args[0]->type != LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) { 
3427             LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s not a node-set as expected.", __func__); 
3428         } else if ((sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(args[0]))) { 
3429             if (!(sleaf->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST))) { 
3430                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is a %s node \"%s\".", __func__, lys_nodetype2str(sleaf->nodetype), 
3431                         sleaf->name); 
3432             } else if (!warn_is_specific_type(sleaf->type, LY_TYPE_BITS)) { 
3433                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is node \"%s\", not of type \"bits\".", __func__, sleaf->name); 
3434             } 
3435         } 
3436  
3437         if ((args[1]->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) && (sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(args[1]))) { 
3438             if (!(sleaf->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST))) { 
3439                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #2 of %s is a %s node \"%s\".", __func__, lys_nodetype2str(sleaf->nodetype), 
3440                         sleaf->name); 
3441             } else if (!warn_is_string_type(sleaf->type)) { 
3442                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #2 of %s is node \"%s\", not of string-type.", __func__, sleaf->name); 
3443             } 
3444         } 
3445         set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_VAL); 
3446         return rc; 
3447     } 
3448  
3449     if (args[0]->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
3450         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INARGTYPE, 1, print_set_type(args[0]), "bit-is-set(node-set, string)"); 
3451         return LY_EVALID; 
3452     } 
3453     rc = lyxp_set_cast(args[1], LYXP_SET_STRING); 
3454     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
3455  
3456     set_fill_boolean(set, 0); 
3457     if (args[0]->used) { 
3458         leaf = (struct lyd_node_term *)args[0]->val.nodes[0].node; 
3459         if ((leaf->schema->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST)) && (leaf->value.realtype->basetype == LY_TYPE_BITS)) { 
3460             LYD_VALUE_GET(&leaf->value, bits); 
3461             LY_ARRAY_FOR(bits->items, u) { 
3462                 if (!strcmp(bits->items[u]->name, args[1]->val.str)) { 
3463                     set_fill_boolean(set, 1); 
3464                     break; 
3465                 } 
3466             } 
3467         } 
3468     } 
3469  
3470     return LY_SUCCESS; 
3471 }

3500 /** 
3501  * @brief Execute the XPath ceiling(number) function. Returns LYXP_SET_NUMBER 
3502  *        with the first argument rounded up to the nearest integer.

3506  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set at the same time. 
3507  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
3508  * @return LY_ERR 
3509  */ 
3510 static LY_ERR 
3511 xpath_ceiling(struct lyxp_set **args, uint16_t UNUSED(arg_count), struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
3512 { 
3513     struct lysc_node_leaf *sleaf;

3516     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
3517         if (args[0]->type != LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) { 
3518             LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s not a node-set as expected.", __func__); 
3519         } else if ((sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(args[0]))) { 
3520             if (!(sleaf->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST))) {

3522                         sleaf->name); 
3523             } else if (!warn_is_specific_type(sleaf->type, LY_TYPE_DEC64)) { 
3524                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is node \"%s\", not of type \"decimal64\".", __func__, sleaf->name); 
3525             }

3530  
3531     rc = lyxp_set_cast(args[0], LYXP_SET_NUMBER);

3533     if ((long long)args[0]->val.num != args[0]->val.num) {

3536         set_fill_number(set, args[0]->val.num);

3542 /** 
3543  * @brief Execute the XPath concat(string, string, string*) function. 
3544  *        Returns LYXP_SET_STRING with the concatenation of all the arguments. 
3545  * 
3546  * @param[in] args Array of arguments. 
3547  * @param[in] arg_count Count of elements in @p args. 
3548  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set at the same time. 
3549  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
3550  * @return LY_ERR 
3551  */ 
3552 static LY_ERR 
3553 xpath_concat(struct lyxp_set **args, uint16_t arg_count, struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
3554 { 
3555     uint16_t i; 
3556     char *str = NULL; 
3557     size_t used = 1; 
3558     LY_ERR rc = LY_SUCCESS; 
3559     struct lysc_node_leaf *sleaf; 
3560  
3561     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
3562         for (i = 0; i < arg_count; ++i) { 
3563             if ((args[i]->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) && (sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(args[i]))) { 
3564                 if (!(sleaf->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST))) { 
3565                     LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #%u of %s is a %s node \"%s\".", 
3566                             i + 1, __func__, lys_nodetype2str(sleaf->nodetype), sleaf->name); 
3567                 } else if (!warn_is_string_type(sleaf->type)) { 
3568                     LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #%u of %s is node \"%s\", not of string-type.", i + 1, __func__, sleaf->name); 
3569                 } 
3570             } 
3571         } 
3572         set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_VAL); 
3573         return rc; 
3574     } 
3575  
3576     for (i = 0; i < arg_count; ++i) { 
3577         rc = lyxp_set_cast(args[i], LYXP_SET_STRING); 
3578         if (rc != LY_SUCCESS) { 
3579             free(str); 
3580             return rc; 
3581         } 
3582  
3583         str = ly_realloc(str, (used + strlen(args[i]->val.str)) * sizeof(char)); 
3584         LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!str, LOGMEM(set->ctx), LY_EMEM); 
3585         strcpy(str + used - 1, args[i]->val.str); 
3586         used += strlen(args[i]->val.str); 
3587     } 
3588  
3589     /* free, kind of */ 
3590     lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
3591     set->type = LYXP_SET_STRING; 
3592     set->val.str = str; 
3593  
3594     return LY_SUCCESS; 
3595 }

3684  *        with the context with the intial node. 
3685  * 
3686  * @param[in] args Array of arguments. 
3687  * @param[in] arg_count Count of elements in @p args. 
3688  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set at the same time. 
3689  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
3690  * @return LY_ERR 
3691  */ 
3692 static LY_ERR 
3693 xpath_current(struct lyxp_set **args, uint16_t arg_count, struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
3694 { 
3695     if (arg_count || args) { 
3696         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INARGCOUNT, arg_count, LY_PRI_LENSTR("current()")); 
3697         return LY_EVALID; 
3698     } 
3699  
3700     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
3701         set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE); 
3702  
3703         if (set->cur_scnode) { 
3704             LY_CHECK_RET(lyxp_set_scnode_insert_node(set, set->cur_scnode, LYXP_NODE_ELEM, NULL)); 
3705         } else { 
3706             /* root node */ 
3707             LY_CHECK_RET(lyxp_set_scnode_insert_node(set, NULL, set->root_type, NULL)); 
3708         } 
3709     } else { 
3710         lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
3711  
3712         if (set->cur_node) { 
3713             /* position is filled later */ 
3714             set_insert_node(set, set->cur_node, 0, LYXP_NODE_ELEM, 0); 
3715         } else { 
3716             /* root node */ 
3717             set_insert_node(set, NULL, 0, set->root_type, 0); 
3718         } 
3719     } 
3720  
3721     return LY_SUCCESS; 
3722 } 
3723  
3724 /** 
3725  * @brief Execute the YANG 1.1 deref(node-set) function. Returns LYXP_SET_NODE_SET with either 
3726  *        leafref or instance-identifier target node(s). 
3727  * 
3728  * @param[in] args Array of arguments. 
3729  * @param[in] arg_count Count of elements in @p args. 
3730  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set at the same time. 
3731  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
3732  * @return LY_ERR 
3733  */ 
3734 static LY_ERR 
3735 xpath_deref(struct lyxp_set **args, uint16_t UNUSED(arg_count), struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
3736 { 
3737     struct lyd_node_term *leaf; 
3738     struct lysc_node_leaf *sleaf = NULL; 
3739     struct lysc_type_leafref *lref; 
3740     const struct lysc_node *target; 
3741     struct ly_path *p; 
3742     struct lyd_node *node; 
3743     char *errmsg = NULL; 
3744     uint8_t oper; 
3745     LY_ERR r; 
3746  
3747     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
3748         if (args[0]->type != LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) { 
3749             LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s not a node-set as expected.", __func__); 
3750         } else if ((sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(args[0]))) { 
3751             if (!(sleaf->nodetype & LYD_NODE_TERM)) { 
3752                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is a %s node \"%s\".", __func__, lys_nodetype2str(sleaf->nodetype), 
3753                         sleaf->name); 
3754             } else if (!warn_is_specific_type(sleaf->type, LY_TYPE_LEAFREF) && 
3755                     !warn_is_specific_type(sleaf->type, LY_TYPE_INST)) { 
3756                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is node \"%s\", not of type \"leafref\" nor \"instance-identifier\".", 
3757                         __func__, sleaf->name); 
3758             } 
3759         } 
3760         set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_VAL); 
3761         if (sleaf && (sleaf->nodetype & LYD_NODE_TERM) && (sleaf->type->basetype == LY_TYPE_LEAFREF)) { 
3762             lref = (struct lysc_type_leafref *)sleaf->type; 
3763             oper = (sleaf->flags & LYS_IS_OUTPUT) ? LY_PATH_OPER_OUTPUT : LY_PATH_OPER_INPUT; 
3764  
3765             /* it was already evaluated on schema, it must succeed */ 
3766             r = ly_path_compile_leafref(set->ctx, &sleaf->node, NULL, lref->path, oper, LY_PATH_TARGET_MANY, 
3767                     LY_VALUE_SCHEMA_RESOLVED, lref->prefixes, &p); 
3768             if (!r) { 
3769                 /* get the target node */ 
3770                 target = p[LY_ARRAY_COUNT(p) - 1].node; 
3771                 ly_path_free(set->ctx, p); 
3772  
3773                 LY_CHECK_RET(lyxp_set_scnode_insert_node(set, target, LYXP_NODE_ELEM, NULL)); 
3774             } /* else the target was found before but is disabled so it was removed */ 
3775         } 
3776  
3777         return LY_SUCCESS; 
3778     } 
3779  
3780     if (args[0]->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
3781         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INARGTYPE, 1, print_set_type(args[0]), "deref(node-set)"); 
3782         return LY_EVALID; 
3783     } 
3784  
3785     lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
3786     if (args[0]->used) { 
3787         leaf = (struct lyd_node_term *)args[0]->val.nodes[0].node; 
3788         sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)leaf->schema; 
3789         if (sleaf->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST)) { 
3790             if (sleaf->type->basetype == LY_TYPE_LEAFREF) { 
3791                 /* find leafref target */ 
3792                 if (lyplg_type_resolve_leafref((struct lysc_type_leafref *)sleaf->type, &leaf->node, &leaf->value, set->tree, 
3793                         &node, &errmsg)) { 
3794                     LOGERR(set->ctx, LY_EVALID, errmsg); 
3795                     free(errmsg); 
3796                     return LY_EVALID; 
3797                 } 
3798             } else { 
3799                 assert(sleaf->type->basetype == LY_TYPE_INST); 
3800                 if (ly_path_eval(leaf->value.target, set->tree, &node)) { 
3801                     LOGERR(set->ctx, LY_EVALID, "Invalid instance-identifier \"%s\" value - required instance not found.", 
3802                             lyd_get_value(&leaf->node)); 
3803                     return LY_EVALID; 
3804                 } 
3805             } 
3806  
3807             /* insert it */ 
3808             set_insert_node(set, node, 0, LYXP_NODE_ELEM, 0); 
3809         } 
3810     } 
3811  
3812     return LY_SUCCESS; 
3813 } 
3814  
3815 static LY_ERR 
3816 xpath_derived_(struct lyxp_set **args, struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options, ly_bool self_match, const char *func) 
3817 { 
3818     uint32_t i; 
3819     LY_ARRAY_COUNT_TYPE u; 
3820     struct lyd_node_term *leaf; 
3821     struct lysc_node_leaf *sleaf; 
3822     struct lyd_meta *meta; 
3823     struct lyd_value *val; 
3824     const struct lys_module *mod; 
3825     const char *id_name; 
3826     uint16_t id_len; 
3827     struct lysc_ident *id; 
3828     LY_ERR rc = LY_SUCCESS; 
3829     ly_bool found; 
3830  
3831     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
3832         if (args[0]->type != LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) { 
3833             LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s not a node-set as expected.", func); 
3834         } else if ((sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(args[0]))) { 
3835             if (!(sleaf->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST))) { 
3836                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is a %s node \"%s\".", func, lys_nodetype2str(sleaf->nodetype), 
3837                         sleaf->name); 
3838             } else if (!warn_is_specific_type(sleaf->type, LY_TYPE_IDENT)) { 
3839                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is node \"%s\", not of type \"identityref\".", func, sleaf->name); 
3840             } 
3841         } 
3842  
3843         if ((args[1]->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) && (sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(args[1]))) { 
3844             if (!(sleaf->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST))) { 
3845                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #2 of %s is a %s node \"%s\".", func, lys_nodetype2str(sleaf->nodetype), 
3846                         sleaf->name); 
3847             } else if (!warn_is_string_type(sleaf->type)) { 
3848                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #2 of %s is node \"%s\", not of string-type.", func, sleaf->name); 
3849             } 
3850         } 
3851         set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_VAL); 
3852         return rc; 
3853     } 
3854  
3855     if (args[0]->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
3856         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INARGTYPE, 1, print_set_type(args[0]), "derived-from(-or-self)(node-set, string)"); 
3857         return LY_EVALID; 
3858     } 
3859     rc = lyxp_set_cast(args[1], LYXP_SET_STRING); 
3860     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
3861  
3862     /* parse the identity */ 
3863     id_name = args[1]->val.str; 
3864     id_len = strlen(id_name); 
3865     rc = moveto_resolve_model(&id_name, &id_len, set, set->cur_node ? set->cur_node->schema : NULL, &mod); 
3866     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
3867     if (!mod) { 
3868         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LYVE_XPATH, "Identity \"%.*s\" without a prefix.", (int)id_len, id_name); 
3869         return LY_EVALID; 
3870     } 
3871  
3872     /* find the identity */ 
3873     found = 0; 
3874     LY_ARRAY_FOR(mod->identities, u) { 
3875         if (!ly_strncmp(mod->identities[u].name, id_name, id_len)) { 
3876             /* we have match */ 
3877             found = 1; 
3878             break; 
3879         } 
3880     } 
3881     if (!found) { 
3882         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LYVE_XPATH, "Identity \"%.*s\" not found in module \"%s\".", (int)id_len, id_name, mod->name); 
3883         return LY_EVALID; 
3884     } 
3885     id = &mod->identities[u]; 
3886  
3887     set_fill_boolean(set, 0); 
3888     found = 0; 
3889     for (i = 0; i < args[0]->used; ++i) { 
3890         if ((args[0]->val.nodes[i].type != LYXP_NODE_ELEM) && (args[0]->val.nodes[i].type != LYXP_NODE_META)) { 
3891             continue; 
3892         } 
3893  
3894         if (args[0]->val.nodes[i].type == LYXP_NODE_ELEM) { 
3895             leaf = (struct lyd_node_term *)args[0]->val.nodes[i].node; 
3896             sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)leaf->schema; 
3897             val = &leaf->value; 
3898             if (!(sleaf->nodetype & LYD_NODE_TERM) || (leaf->value.realtype->basetype != LY_TYPE_IDENT)) { 
3899                 /* uninteresting */ 
3900                 continue; 
3901             } 
3902         } else { 
3903             meta = args[0]->val.meta[i].meta; 
3904             val = &meta->value; 
3905             if (val->realtype->basetype != LY_TYPE_IDENT) { 
3906                 /* uninteresting */ 
3907                 continue; 
3908             } 
3909         } 
3910  
3911         /* check the identity itself */ 
3912         if (self_match && (id == val->ident)) { 
3913             set_fill_boolean(set, 1); 
3914             found = 1; 
3915         } 
3916         if (!found && !lyplg_type_identity_isderived(id, val->ident)) { 
3917             set_fill_boolean(set, 1); 
3918             found = 1; 
3919         } 
3920  
3921         if (found) { 
3922             break; 
3923         } 
3924     } 
3925  
3926     return LY_SUCCESS; 
3927 }

3930  * @brief Execute the YANG 1.1 derived-from(node-set, string) function. Returns LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN depending 
3931  *        on whether the first argument nodes contain a node of an identity derived from the second 
3932  *        argument identity.

3941 xpath_derived_from(struct lyxp_set **args, uint16_t UNUSED(arg_count), struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options)

3963 /** 
3964  * @brief Execute the YANG 1.1 enum-value(node-set) function. Returns LYXP_SET_NUMBER 
3965  *        with the integer value of the first node's enum value, otherwise NaN. 
3966  * 
3967  * @param[in] args Array of arguments. 
3968  * @param[in] arg_count Count of elements in @p args. 
3969  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set at the same time. 
3970  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
3971  * @return LY_ERR 
3972  */ 
3973 static LY_ERR 
3974 xpath_enum_value(struct lyxp_set **args, uint16_t UNUSED(arg_count), struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
3975 { 
3976     struct lyd_node_term *leaf; 
3977     struct lysc_node_leaf *sleaf; 
3978     LY_ERR rc = LY_SUCCESS; 
3979  
3980     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
3981         if (args[0]->type != LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) { 
3982             LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s not a node-set as expected.", __func__); 
3983         } else if ((sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(args[0]))) { 
3984             if (!(sleaf->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST))) { 
3985                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is a %s node \"%s\".", __func__, lys_nodetype2str(sleaf->nodetype), 
3986                         sleaf->name); 
3987             } else if (!warn_is_specific_type(sleaf->type, LY_TYPE_ENUM)) { 
3988                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is node \"%s\", not of type \"enumeration\".", __func__, sleaf->name); 
3989             } 
3990         } 
3991         set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_VAL); 
3992         return rc; 
3993     } 
3994  
3995     if (args[0]->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
3996         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INARGTYPE, 1, print_set_type(args[0]), "enum-value(node-set)"); 
3997         return LY_EVALID; 
3998     } 
3999  
4000     set_fill_number(set, NAN); 
4001     if (args[0]->used) { 
4002         leaf = (struct lyd_node_term *)args[0]->val.nodes[0].node; 
4003         sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)leaf->schema; 
4004         if ((sleaf->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST)) && (sleaf->type->basetype == LY_TYPE_ENUM)) { 
4005             set_fill_number(set, leaf->value.enum_item->value); 
4006         } 
4007     } 
4008  
4009     return LY_SUCCESS; 
4010 }

4058 /** 
4059  * @brief Execute the XPath lang(string) function. Returns LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN 
4060  *        whether the language of the text matches the one from the argument. 
4061  * 
4062  * @param[in] args Array of arguments. 
4063  * @param[in] arg_count Count of elements in @p args. 
4064  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set at the same time. 
4065  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
4066  * @return LY_ERR 
4067  */ 
4068 static LY_ERR 
4069 xpath_lang(struct lyxp_set **args, uint16_t UNUSED(arg_count), struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
4070 { 
4071     const struct lyd_node *node; 
4072     struct lysc_node_leaf *sleaf; 
4073     struct lyd_meta *meta = NULL; 
4074     const char *val; 
4075     LY_ERR rc = LY_SUCCESS; 
4076  
4077     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
4078         if ((args[0]->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) && (sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(args[0]))) { 
4079             if (!(sleaf->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST))) { 
4080                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is a %s node \"%s\".", __func__, lys_nodetype2str(sleaf->nodetype), 
4081                         sleaf->name); 
4082             } else if (!warn_is_string_type(sleaf->type)) { 
4083                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is node \"%s\", not of string-type.", __func__, sleaf->name); 
4084             } 
4085         } 
4086         set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_VAL); 
4087         return rc; 
4088     } 
4089  
4090     rc = lyxp_set_cast(args[0], LYXP_SET_STRING); 
4091     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
4092  
4093     if (set->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
4094         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INCTX, print_set_type(set), "lang(string)"); 
4095         return LY_EVALID; 
4096     } else if (!set->used) { 
4097         set_fill_boolean(set, 0); 
4098         return LY_SUCCESS; 
4099     } 
4100  
4101     switch (set->val.nodes[0].type) { 
4102     case LYXP_NODE_ELEM: 
4103     case LYXP_NODE_TEXT: 
4104         node = set->val.nodes[0].node; 
4105         break; 
4106     case LYXP_NODE_META: 
4107         node = set->val.meta[0].meta->parent; 
4108         break; 
4109     default: 
4110         /* nothing to do with roots */ 
4111         set_fill_boolean(set, 0); 
4112         return LY_SUCCESS; 
4113     } 
4114  
4115     /* find lang metadata */ 
4116     for ( ; node; node = lyd_parent(node)) { 
4117         for (meta = node->meta; meta; meta = meta->next) { 
4118             /* annotations */ 
4119             if (meta->name && !strcmp(meta->name, "lang") && !strcmp(meta->annotation->module->name, "xml")) { 
4120                 break; 
4121             } 
4122         } 
4123  
4124         if (meta) { 
4125             break; 
4126         } 
4127     } 
4128  
4129     /* compare languages */ 
4130     if (!meta) { 
4131         set_fill_boolean(set, 0); 
4132     } else { 
4133         uint64_t i; 
4134  
4135         val = lyd_get_meta_value(meta); 
4136         for (i = 0; args[0]->val.str[i]; ++i) { 
4137             if (tolower(args[0]->val.str[i]) != tolower(val[i])) { 
4138                 set_fill_boolean(set, 0); 
4139                 break; 
4140             } 
4141         } 
4142         if (!args[0]->val.str[i]) { 
4143             if (!val[i] || (val[i] == '-')) { 
4144                 set_fill_boolean(set, 1); 
4145             } else { 
4146                 set_fill_boolean(set, 0); 
4147             } 
4148         } 
4149     } 
4150  
4151     return LY_SUCCESS; 
4152 }

4154 /** 
4155  * @brief Execute the XPath last() function. Returns LYXP_SET_NUMBER 
4156  *        with the context size. 
4157  * 
4158  * @param[in] args Array of arguments. 
4159  * @param[in] arg_count Count of elements in @p args. 
4160  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set at the same time. 
4161  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
4162  * @return LY_ERR 
4163  */ 
4164 static LY_ERR 
4165 xpath_last(struct lyxp_set **UNUSED(args), uint16_t UNUSED(arg_count), struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
4166 { 
4167     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
4168         set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE); 
4169         return LY_SUCCESS; 
4170     } 
4171  
4172     if (set->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
4173         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INCTX, print_set_type(set), "last()"); 
4174         return LY_EVALID; 
4175     } else if (!set->used) { 
4176         set_fill_number(set, 0); 
4177         return LY_SUCCESS; 
4178     } 
4179  
4180     set_fill_number(set, set->ctx_size); 
4181     return LY_SUCCESS; 
4182 } 
4183  
4184 /** 
4185  * @brief Execute the XPath local-name(node-set?) function. Returns LYXP_SET_STRING 
4186  *        with the node name without namespace from the argument or the context. 
4187  * 
4188  * @param[in] args Array of arguments. 
4189  * @param[in] arg_count Count of elements in @p args. 
4190  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set at the same time. 
4191  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
4192  * @return LY_ERR 
4193  */ 
4194 static LY_ERR 
4195 xpath_local_name(struct lyxp_set **args, uint16_t arg_count, struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
4196 { 
4197     struct lyxp_set_node *item; 
4198  
4199     /* suppress unused variable warning */ 
4200     (void)options; 
4201  
4202     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
4203         set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE); 
4204         return LY_SUCCESS; 
4205     } 
4206  
4207     if (arg_count) { 
4208         if (args[0]->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
4209             LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INARGTYPE, 1, print_set_type(args[0]), 
4210                     "local-name(node-set?)"); 
4211             return LY_EVALID; 
4212         } else if (!args[0]->used) { 
4213             set_fill_string(set, "", 0); 
4214             return LY_SUCCESS; 
4215         } 
4216  
4217         /* we need the set sorted, it affects the result */ 
4218         assert(!set_sort(args[0])); 
4219  
4220         item = &args[0]->val.nodes[0]; 
4221     } else { 
4222         if (set->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
4223             LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INCTX, print_set_type(set), "local-name(node-set?)"); 
4224             return LY_EVALID; 
4225         } else if (!set->used) { 
4226             set_fill_string(set, "", 0); 
4227             return LY_SUCCESS; 
4228         } 
4229  
4230         /* we need the set sorted, it affects the result */ 
4231         assert(!set_sort(set)); 
4232  
4233         item = &set->val.nodes[0]; 
4234     } 
4235  
4236     switch (item->type) { 
4237     case LYXP_NODE_NONE: 
4238         LOGINT_RET(set->ctx); 
4239     case LYXP_NODE_ROOT: 
4240     case LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG: 
4241     case LYXP_NODE_TEXT: 
4242         set_fill_string(set, "", 0); 
4243         break; 
4244     case LYXP_NODE_ELEM: 
4245         set_fill_string(set, item->node->schema->name, strlen(item->node->schema->name)); 
4246         break; 
4247     case LYXP_NODE_META: 
4248         set_fill_string(set, ((struct lyd_meta *)item->node)->name, strlen(((struct lyd_meta *)item->node)->name)); 
4249         break; 
4250     } 
4251  
4252     return LY_SUCCESS; 
4253 }
