4255 /** 
4256  * @brief Execute the XPath name(node-set?) function. Returns LYXP_SET_STRING 
4257  *        with the node name fully qualified (with namespace) from the argument or the context. 
4258  * 
4259  * @param[in] args Array of arguments. 
4260  * @param[in] arg_count Count of elements in @p args. 
4261  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set at the same time. 
4262  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
4263  * @return LY_ERR 
4264  */ 
4265 static LY_ERR 
4266 xpath_name(struct lyxp_set **args, uint16_t arg_count, struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
4267 { 
4268     struct lyxp_set_node *item; 
4269     struct lys_module *mod = NULL; 
4270     char *str; 
4271     const char *name = NULL; 
4272  
4273     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
4274         set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE); 
4275         return LY_SUCCESS; 
4276     } 
4277  
4278     if (arg_count) { 
4279         if (args[0]->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
4280             LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INARGTYPE, 1, print_set_type(args[0]), "name(node-set?)"); 
4281             return LY_EVALID; 
4282         } else if (!args[0]->used) { 
4283             set_fill_string(set, "", 0); 
4284             return LY_SUCCESS; 
4285         } 
4286  
4287         /* we need the set sorted, it affects the result */ 
4288         assert(!set_sort(args[0])); 
4289  
4290         item = &args[0]->val.nodes[0]; 
4291     } else { 
4292         if (set->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
4293             LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INCTX, print_set_type(set), "name(node-set?)"); 
4294             return LY_EVALID; 
4295         } else if (!set->used) { 
4296             set_fill_string(set, "", 0); 
4297             return LY_SUCCESS; 
4298         } 
4299  
4300         /* we need the set sorted, it affects the result */ 
4301         assert(!set_sort(set)); 
4302  
4303         item = &set->val.nodes[0]; 
4304     } 
4305  
4306     switch (item->type) { 
4307     case LYXP_NODE_NONE: 
4308         LOGINT_RET(set->ctx); 
4309     case LYXP_NODE_ROOT: 
4310     case LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG: 
4311     case LYXP_NODE_TEXT: 
4312         /* keep NULL */ 
4313         break; 
4314     case LYXP_NODE_ELEM: 
4315         mod = item->node->schema->module; 
4316         name = item->node->schema->name; 
4317         break; 
4318     case LYXP_NODE_META: 
4319         mod = ((struct lyd_meta *)item->node)->annotation->module; 
4320         name = ((struct lyd_meta *)item->node)->name; 
4321         break; 
4322     } 
4323  
4324     if (mod && name) { 
4325         int rc = asprintf(&str, "%s:%s", ly_get_prefix(mod, set->format, set->prefix_data), name); 
4326         LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(rc == -1, LOGMEM(set->ctx), LY_EMEM); 
4327         set_fill_string(set, str, strlen(str)); 
4328         free(str); 
4329     } else { 
4330         set_fill_string(set, "", 0); 
4331     } 
4332  
4333     return LY_SUCCESS; 
4334 }

4438 /** 
4439  * @brief Execute the XPath normalize-space(string?) function. Returns LYXP_SET_STRING 
4440  *        with normalized value (no leading, trailing, double white spaces) of the node 
4441  *        from the argument or the context. 
4442  * 
4443  * @param[in] args Array of arguments. 
4444  * @param[in] arg_count Count of elements in @p args. 
4445  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set at the same time. 
4446  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
4447  * @return LY_ERR 
4448  */ 
4449 static LY_ERR 
4450 xpath_normalize_space(struct lyxp_set **args, uint16_t arg_count, struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
4451 { 
4452     uint16_t i, new_used; 
4453     char *new; 
4454     ly_bool have_spaces = 0, space_before = 0; 
4455     struct lysc_node_leaf *sleaf; 
4456     LY_ERR rc = LY_SUCCESS; 
4457  
4458     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
4459         if (arg_count && (args[0]->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) && 
4460                 (sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(args[0]))) { 
4461             if (!(sleaf->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST))) { 
4462                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is a %s node \"%s\".", __func__, lys_nodetype2str(sleaf->nodetype), 
4463                         sleaf->name); 
4464             } else if (!warn_is_string_type(sleaf->type)) { 
4465                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is node \"%s\", not of string-type.", __func__, sleaf->name); 
4466             } 
4467         } 
4468         set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_VAL); 
4469         return rc; 
4470     } 
4471  
4472     if (arg_count) { 
4473         set_fill_set(set, args[0]); 
4474     } 
4475     rc = lyxp_set_cast(set, LYXP_SET_STRING); 
4476     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
4477  
4478     /* is there any normalization necessary? */ 
4479     for (i = 0; set->val.str[i]; ++i) { 
4480         if (is_xmlws(set->val.str[i])) { 
4481             if ((i == 0) || space_before || (!set->val.str[i + 1])) { 
4482                 have_spaces = 1; 
4483                 break; 
4484             } 
4485             space_before = 1; 
4486         } else { 
4487             space_before = 0; 
4488         } 
4489     } 
4490  
4491     /* yep, there is */ 
4492     if (have_spaces) { 
4493         /* it's enough, at least one character will go, makes space for ending '\0' */ 
4494         new = malloc(strlen(set->val.str) * sizeof(char)); 
4495         LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!new, LOGMEM(set->ctx), LY_EMEM); 
4496         new_used = 0; 
4497  
4498         space_before = 0; 
4499         for (i = 0; set->val.str[i]; ++i) { 
4500             if (is_xmlws(set->val.str[i])) { 
4501                 if ((i == 0) || space_before) { 
4502                     space_before = 1; 
4503                     continue; 
4504                 } else { 
4505                     space_before = 1; 
4506                 } 
4507             } else { 
4508                 space_before = 0; 
4509             } 
4510  
4511             new[new_used] = (space_before ? ' ' : set->val.str[i]); 
4512             ++new_used; 
4513         } 
4514  
4515         /* at worst there is one trailing space now */ 
4516         if (new_used && is_xmlws(new[new_used - 1])) { 
4517             --new_used; 
4518         } 
4519  
4520         new = ly_realloc(new, (new_used + 1) * sizeof(char)); 
4521         LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!new, LOGMEM(set->ctx), LY_EMEM); 
4522         new[new_used] = '\0'; 
4523  
4524         free(set->val.str); 
4525         set->val.str = new; 
4526     } 
4527  
4528     return LY_SUCCESS; 
4529 }

4624 /** 
4625  * @brief Execute the YANG 1.1 re-match(string, string) function. Returns LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN 
4626  *        depending on whether the second argument regex matches the first argument string. For details refer to 
4627  *        YANG 1.1 RFC section 10.2.1. 
4628  * 
4629  * @param[in] args Array of arguments. 
4630  * @param[in] arg_count Count of elements in @p args. 
4631  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set at the same time. 
4632  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
4633  * @return LY_ERR 
4634  */ 
4635 static LY_ERR 
4636 xpath_re_match(struct lyxp_set **args, uint16_t UNUSED(arg_count), struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
4637 { 
4638     struct lysc_pattern **patterns = NULL, **pattern; 
4639     struct lysc_node_leaf *sleaf; 
4640     LY_ERR rc = LY_SUCCESS; 
4641     struct ly_err_item *err; 
4642  
4643     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
4644         if ((args[0]->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) && (sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(args[0]))) { 
4645             if (!(sleaf->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST))) { 
4646                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is a %s node \"%s\".", __func__, lys_nodetype2str(sleaf->nodetype), sleaf->name); 
4647             } else if (!warn_is_string_type(sleaf->type)) { 
4648                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is node \"%s\", not of string-type.", __func__, sleaf->name); 
4649             } 
4650         } 
4651  
4652         if ((args[1]->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) && (sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(args[1]))) { 
4653             if (!(sleaf->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST))) { 
4654                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #2 of %s is a %s node \"%s\".", __func__, lys_nodetype2str(sleaf->nodetype), sleaf->name); 
4655             } else if (!warn_is_string_type(sleaf->type)) { 
4656                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #2 of %s is node \"%s\", not of string-type.", __func__, sleaf->name); 
4657             } 
4658         } 
4659         set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_VAL); 
4660         return rc; 
4661     } 
4662  
4663     rc = lyxp_set_cast(args[0], LYXP_SET_STRING); 
4664     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
4665     rc = lyxp_set_cast(args[1], LYXP_SET_STRING); 
4666     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
4667  
4668     LY_ARRAY_NEW_RET(set->ctx, patterns, pattern, LY_EMEM); 
4669     *pattern = calloc(1, sizeof **pattern); 
4670     LOG_LOCSET(NULL, set->cur_node, NULL, NULL); 
4671     rc = lys_compile_type_pattern_check(set->ctx, args[1]->val.str, &(*pattern)->code); 
4672     if (set->cur_node) { 
4673         LOG_LOCBACK(0, 1, 0, 0); 
4674     } 
4675     if (rc != LY_SUCCESS) { 
4676         LY_ARRAY_FREE(patterns); 
4677         return rc; 
4678     } 
4679  
4680     rc = lyplg_type_validate_patterns(patterns, args[0]->val.str, strlen(args[0]->val.str), &err); 
4681     pcre2_code_free((*pattern)->code); 
4682     free(*pattern); 
4683     LY_ARRAY_FREE(patterns); 
4684     if (rc && (rc != LY_EVALID)) { 
4685         ly_err_print(set->ctx, err); 
4686         ly_err_free(err); 
4687         return rc; 
4688     } 
4689  
4690     if (rc == LY_EVALID) { 
4691         ly_err_free(err); 
4692         set_fill_boolean(set, 0); 
4693     } else { 
4694         set_fill_boolean(set, 1); 
4695     } 
4696  
4697     return LY_SUCCESS; 
4698 }

4700 /** 
4701  * @brief Execute the XPath round(number) function. Returns LYXP_SET_NUMBER 
4702  *        with the rounded first argument. For details refer to 
4703  *        http://www.w3.org/TR/1999/REC-xpath-19991116/#function-round. 
4704  * 
4705  * @param[in] args Array of arguments. 
4706  * @param[in] arg_count Count of elements in @p args. 
4707  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set at the same time. 
4708  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
4709  * @return LY_ERR 
4710  */ 
4711 static LY_ERR 
4712 xpath_round(struct lyxp_set **args, uint16_t UNUSED(arg_count), struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
4713 { 
4714     struct lysc_node_leaf *sleaf; 
4715     LY_ERR rc = LY_SUCCESS; 
4716  
4717     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
4718         if (args[0]->type != LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) { 
4719             LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s not a node-set as expected.", __func__); 
4720         } else if ((sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(args[0]))) { 
4721             if (!(sleaf->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST))) { 
4722                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is a %s node \"%s\".", __func__, lys_nodetype2str(sleaf->nodetype), 
4723                         sleaf->name); 
4724             } else if (!warn_is_specific_type(sleaf->type, LY_TYPE_DEC64)) { 
4725                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is node \"%s\", not of type \"decimal64\".", __func__, sleaf->name); 
4726             } 
4727         } 
4728         set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_VAL); 
4729         return rc; 
4730     } 
4731  
4732     rc = lyxp_set_cast(args[0], LYXP_SET_NUMBER); 
4733     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
4734  
4735     /* cover only the cases where floor can't be used */ 
4736     if ((args[0]->val.num == -0.0f) || ((args[0]->val.num < 0) && (args[0]->val.num >= -0.5))) { 
4737         set_fill_number(set, -0.0f); 
4738     } else { 
4739         args[0]->val.num += 0.5; 
4740         rc = xpath_floor(args, 1, args[0], options); 
4741         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
4742         set_fill_number(set, args[0]->val.num); 
4743     } 
4744  
4745     return LY_SUCCESS; 
4746 }

4748 /** 
4749  * @brief Execute the XPath starts-with(string, string) function. 
4750  *        Returns LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN whether the second argument is 
4751  *        the prefix of the first or not. 
4752  * 
4753  * @param[in] args Array of arguments.

4879 /** 
4880  * @brief Execute the XPath substring(string, number, number?) function. 
4881  *        Returns LYXP_SET_STRING substring of the first argument starting 
4882  *        on the second argument index ending on the third argument index, 
4883  *        indexed from 1. For exact definition refer to 
4884  *        http://www.w3.org/TR/1999/REC-xpath-19991116/#function-substring. 
4885  * 
4886  * @param[in] args Array of arguments. 
4887  * @param[in] arg_count Count of elements in @p args. 
4888  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set at the same time. 
4889  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
4890  * @return LY_ERR 
4891  */ 
4892 static LY_ERR 
4893 xpath_substring(struct lyxp_set **args, uint16_t arg_count, struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
4894 { 
4895     int32_t start, len; 
4896     uint16_t str_start, str_len, pos; 
4897     struct lysc_node_leaf *sleaf; 
4898     LY_ERR rc = LY_SUCCESS; 
4899  
4900     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
4901         if ((args[0]->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) && (sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(args[0]))) { 
4902             if (!(sleaf->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST))) { 
4903                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is a %s node \"%s\".", __func__, lys_nodetype2str(sleaf->nodetype), sleaf->name); 
4904             } else if (!warn_is_string_type(sleaf->type)) { 
4905                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is node \"%s\", not of string-type.", __func__, sleaf->name); 
4906             } 
4907         } 
4908  
4909         if ((args[1]->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) && (sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(args[1]))) { 
4910             if (!(sleaf->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST))) { 
4911                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #2 of %s is a %s node \"%s\".", __func__, lys_nodetype2str(sleaf->nodetype), sleaf->name); 
4912             } else if (!warn_is_numeric_type(sleaf->type)) { 
4913                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #2 of %s is node \"%s\", not of numeric type.", __func__, sleaf->name); 
4914             } 
4915         } 
4916  
4917         if ((arg_count == 3) && (args[2]->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) && 
4918                 (sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(args[2]))) { 
4919             if (!(sleaf->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST))) { 
4920                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #3 of %s is a %s node \"%s\".", __func__, lys_nodetype2str(sleaf->nodetype), sleaf->name); 
4921             } else if (!warn_is_numeric_type(sleaf->type)) { 
4922                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #3 of %s is node \"%s\", not of numeric type.", __func__, sleaf->name); 
4923             } 
4924         } 
4925         set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_VAL); 
4926         return rc; 
4927     } 
4928  
4929     rc = lyxp_set_cast(args[0], LYXP_SET_STRING); 
4930     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
4931  
4932     /* start */ 
4933     if (xpath_round(&args[1], 1, args[1], options)) { 
4934         return -1; 
4935     } 
4936     if (isfinite(args[1]->val.num)) { 
4937         start = args[1]->val.num - 1; 
4938     } else if (isinf(args[1]->val.num) && signbit(args[1]->val.num)) { 
4939         start = INT32_MIN; 
4940     } else { 
4941         start = INT32_MAX; 
4942     } 
4943  
4944     /* len */ 
4945     if (arg_count == 3) { 
4946         rc = xpath_round(&args[2], 1, args[2], options); 
4947         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
4948         if (isnan(args[2]->val.num) || signbit(args[2]->val.num)) { 
4949             len = 0; 
4950         } else if (isfinite(args[2]->val.num)) { 
4951             len = args[2]->val.num; 
4952         } else { 
4953             len = INT32_MAX; 
4954         } 
4955     } else { 
4956         len = INT32_MAX; 
4957     } 
4958  
4959     /* find matching character positions */ 
4960     str_start = 0; 
4961     str_len = 0; 
4962     for (pos = 0; args[0]->val.str[pos]; ++pos) { 
4963         if (pos < start) { 
4964             ++str_start; 
4965         } else if (pos < start + len) { 
4966             ++str_len; 
4967         } else { 
4968             break; 
4969         } 
4970     } 
4971  
4972     set_fill_string(set, args[0]->val.str + str_start, str_len); 
4973     return LY_SUCCESS; 
4974 }

5082 /** 
5083  * @brief Execute the XPath sum(node-set) function. Returns LYXP_SET_NUMBER 
5084  *        with the sum of all the nodes in the context. 
5085  * 
5086  * @param[in] args Array of arguments. 
5087  * @param[in] arg_count Count of elements in @p args. 
5088  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set at the same time. 
5089  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
5090  * @return LY_ERR 
5091  */ 
5092 static LY_ERR 
5093 xpath_sum(struct lyxp_set **args, uint16_t UNUSED(arg_count), struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
5094 { 
5095     long double num; 
5096     char *str; 
5097     uint32_t i; 
5098     struct lyxp_set set_item; 
5099     struct lysc_node_leaf *sleaf; 
5100     LY_ERR rc = LY_SUCCESS; 
5101  
5102     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
5103         if (args[0]->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) { 
5104             for (i = 0; i < args[0]->used; ++i) { 
5105                 if (args[0]->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_CTX) { 
5106                     sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)args[0]->val.scnodes[i].scnode; 
5107                     if (!(sleaf->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST))) { 
5108                         LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is a %s node \"%s\".", __func__, 
5109                                 lys_nodetype2str(sleaf->nodetype), sleaf->name); 
5110                     } else if (!warn_is_numeric_type(sleaf->type)) { 
5111                         LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is node \"%s\", not of numeric type.", __func__, sleaf->name); 
5112                     } 
5113                 } 
5114             } 
5115         } 
5116         set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_VAL); 
5117         return rc; 
5118     } 
5119  
5120     set_fill_number(set, 0); 
5121  
5122     if (args[0]->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
5123         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INARGTYPE, 1, print_set_type(args[0]), "sum(node-set)"); 
5124         return LY_EVALID; 
5125     } else if (!args[0]->used) { 
5126         return LY_SUCCESS; 
5127     } 
5128  
5129     set_init(&set_item, set); 
5130  
5131     set_item.type = LYXP_SET_NODE_SET; 
5132     set_item.val.nodes = calloc(1, sizeof *set_item.val.nodes); 
5133     LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!set_item.val.nodes, LOGMEM(set->ctx), LY_EMEM); 
5134  
5135     set_item.used = 1; 
5136     set_item.size = 1; 
5137  
5138     for (i = 0; i < args[0]->used; ++i) { 
5139         set_item.val.nodes[0] = args[0]->val.nodes[i]; 
5140  
5141         rc = cast_node_set_to_string(&set_item, &str); 
5142         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
5143         num = cast_string_to_number(str); 
5144         free(str); 
5145         set->val.num += num; 
5146     } 
5147  
5148     free(set_item.val.nodes); 
5149  
5150     return LY_SUCCESS; 
5151 } 
5152  
5153 /** 
5154  * @brief Execute the XPath text() function (node type). Returns LYXP_SET_NODE_SET 
5155  *        with the text content of the nodes in the context. 
5156  * 
5157  * @param[in] args Array of arguments. 
5158  * @param[in] arg_count Count of elements in @p args. 
5159  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set at the same time. 
5160  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
5161  * @return LY_ERR 
5162  */ 
5163 static LY_ERR 
5164 xpath_text(struct lyxp_set **UNUSED(args), uint16_t UNUSED(arg_count), struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
5165 { 
5166     uint32_t i; 
5167  
5168     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
5169         set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_VAL); 
5170         return LY_SUCCESS; 
5171     } 
5172  
5173     if (set->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
5174         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INCTX, print_set_type(set), "text()"); 
5175         return LY_EVALID; 
5176     } 
5177  
5178     for (i = 0; i < set->used; ) { 
5179         switch (set->val.nodes[i].type) { 
5180         case LYXP_NODE_NONE: 
5181             LOGINT_RET(set->ctx); 
5182         case LYXP_NODE_ELEM: 
5183             if (set->val.nodes[i].node->schema->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST)) { 
5184                 set->val.nodes[i].type = LYXP_NODE_TEXT; 
5185                 ++i; 
5186                 break; 
5187             } 
5188         /* fall through */ 
5189         case LYXP_NODE_ROOT: 
5190         case LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG: 
5191         case LYXP_NODE_TEXT: 
5192         case LYXP_NODE_META: 
5193             set_remove_node(set, i); 
5194             break; 
5195         } 
5196     } 
5197  
5198     return LY_SUCCESS; 
5199 }

5201 /** 
5202  * @brief Execute the XPath translate(string, string, string) function. 
5203  *        Returns LYXP_SET_STRING with the first argument with the characters 
5204  *        from the second argument replaced by those on the corresponding 
5205  *        positions in the third argument. 
5206  * 
5207  * @param[in] args Array of arguments. 
5208  * @param[in] arg_count Count of elements in @p args. 
5209  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set at the same time. 
5210  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
5211  * @return LY_ERR 
5212  */ 
5213 static LY_ERR 
5214 xpath_translate(struct lyxp_set **args, uint16_t UNUSED(arg_count), struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
5215 { 
5216     uint16_t i, j, new_used; 
5217     char *new; 
5218     ly_bool have_removed; 
5219     struct lysc_node_leaf *sleaf; 
5220     LY_ERR rc = LY_SUCCESS; 
5221  
5222     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
5223         if ((args[0]->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) && (sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(args[0]))) { 
5224             if (!(sleaf->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST))) { 
5225                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is a %s node \"%s\".", __func__, lys_nodetype2str(sleaf->nodetype), sleaf->name); 
5226             } else if (!warn_is_string_type(sleaf->type)) { 
5227                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #1 of %s is node \"%s\", not of string-type.", __func__, sleaf->name); 
5228             } 
5229         } 
5230  
5231         if ((args[1]->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) && (sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(args[1]))) { 
5232             if (!(sleaf->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST))) { 
5233                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #2 of %s is a %s node \"%s\".", __func__, lys_nodetype2str(sleaf->nodetype), sleaf->name); 
5234             } else if (!warn_is_string_type(sleaf->type)) { 
5235                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #2 of %s is node \"%s\", not of string-type.", __func__, sleaf->name); 
5236             } 
5237         } 
5238  
5239         if ((args[2]->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) && (sleaf = (struct lysc_node_leaf *)warn_get_scnode_in_ctx(args[2]))) { 
5240             if (!(sleaf->nodetype & (LYS_LEAF | LYS_LEAFLIST))) { 
5241                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #3 of %s is a %s node \"%s\".", __func__, lys_nodetype2str(sleaf->nodetype), sleaf->name); 
5242             } else if (!warn_is_string_type(sleaf->type)) { 
5243                 LOGWRN(set->ctx, "Argument #3 of %s is node \"%s\", not of string-type.", __func__, sleaf->name); 
5244             } 
5245         } 
5246         set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_VAL); 
5247         return rc; 
5248     } 
5249  
5250     rc = lyxp_set_cast(args[0], LYXP_SET_STRING); 
5251     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
5252     rc = lyxp_set_cast(args[1], LYXP_SET_STRING); 
5253     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
5254     rc = lyxp_set_cast(args[2], LYXP_SET_STRING); 
5255     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
5256  
5257     new = malloc((strlen(args[0]->val.str) + 1) * sizeof(char)); 
5258     LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!new, LOGMEM(set->ctx), LY_EMEM); 
5259     new_used = 0; 
5260  
5261     have_removed = 0; 
5262     for (i = 0; args[0]->val.str[i]; ++i) { 
5263         ly_bool found = 0; 
5264  
5265         for (j = 0; args[1]->val.str[j]; ++j) { 
5266             if (args[0]->val.str[i] == args[1]->val.str[j]) { 
5267                 /* removing this char */ 
5268                 if (j >= strlen(args[2]->val.str)) { 
5269                     have_removed = 1; 
5270                     found = 1; 
5271                     break; 
5272                 } 
5273                 /* replacing this char */ 
5274                 new[new_used] = args[2]->val.str[j]; 
5275                 ++new_used; 
5276                 found = 1; 
5277                 break; 
5278             } 
5279         } 
5280  
5281         /* copying this char */ 
5282         if (!found) { 
5283             new[new_used] = args[0]->val.str[i]; 
5284             ++new_used; 
5285         } 
5286     } 
5287  
5288     if (have_removed) { 
5289         new = ly_realloc(new, (new_used + 1) * sizeof(char)); 
5290         LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(!new, LOGMEM(set->ctx), LY_EMEM); 
5291     } 
5292     new[new_used] = '\0'; 
5293  
5294     lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
5295     set->type = LYXP_SET_STRING; 
5296     set->val.str = new; 
5297  
5298     return LY_SUCCESS; 
5299 }

5301 /** 
5302  * @brief Execute the XPath true() function. Returns LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN 
5303  *        with true value. 
5304  * 
5305  * @param[in] args Array of arguments. 
5306  * @param[in] arg_count Count of elements in @p args. 
5307  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set at the same time. 
5308  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
5309  * @return LY_ERR 
5310  */ 
5311 static LY_ERR 
5312 xpath_true(struct lyxp_set **UNUSED(args), uint16_t UNUSED(arg_count), struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
5313 { 
5314     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
5315         set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE); 
5316         return LY_SUCCESS; 
5317     } 
5318  
5319     set_fill_boolean(set, 1); 
5320     return LY_SUCCESS; 
5321 }

5323 /** 
5324  * @brief Skip prefix and return corresponding model if there is a prefix. Logs directly. 
5325  * 
5326  * XPath @p set is expected to be a (sc)node set! 
5327  * 
5328  * @param[in,out] qname Qualified node name. If includes prefix, it is skipped. 
5329  * @param[in,out] qname_len Length of @p qname, is updated accordingly. 
5330  * @param[in] set Set with general XPath context. 
5331  * @param[in] ctx_scnode Context node to inherit module for unprefixed node for ::LY_PREF_JSON. 
5332  * @param[out] moveto_mod Expected module of a matching node. 
5333  * @return LY_ERR 
5334  */ 
5335 static LY_ERR 
5336 moveto_resolve_model(const char **qname, uint16_t *qname_len, const struct lyxp_set *set, 
5337         const struct lysc_node *ctx_scnode, const struct lys_module **moveto_mod) 
5338 { 
5339     const struct lys_module *mod = NULL; 
5340     const char *ptr; 
5341     size_t pref_len; 
5342  
5343     assert((set->type == LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) || (set->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET)); 
5344  
5345     if ((ptr = ly_strnchr(*qname, ':', *qname_len))) { 
5346         /* specific module */ 
5347         pref_len = ptr - *qname; 
5348         mod = ly_resolve_prefix(set->ctx, *qname, pref_len, set->format, set->prefix_data); 
5349  
5350         /* check for errors and non-implemented modules, as they are not valid */ 
5351         if (!mod || !mod->implemented) { 
5352             LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INMOD, pref_len, *qname); 
5353             return LY_EVALID; 
5354         } 
5355  
5356         *qname += pref_len + 1; 
5357         *qname_len -= pref_len + 1; 
5358     } else if (((*qname)[0] == '*') && (*qname_len == 1)) { 
5359         /* all modules - special case */ 
5360         mod = NULL; 
5361     } else { 
5362         switch (set->format) { 
5363         case LY_VALUE_SCHEMA: 
5364         case LY_VALUE_SCHEMA_RESOLVED: 
5365             /* current module */ 
5366             mod = set->cur_mod; 
5367             break; 
5368         case LY_VALUE_CANON: 
5369         case LY_VALUE_JSON: 
5370         case LY_VALUE_LYB: 
5371             /* inherit parent (context node) module */ 
5372             if (ctx_scnode) { 
5373                 mod = ctx_scnode->module; 
5374             } else { 
5375                 mod = NULL; 
5376             } 
5377             break; 
5378         case LY_VALUE_XML: 
5379             /* all nodes need to be prefixed */ 
5380             LOGVAL(set->ctx, LYVE_DATA, "Non-prefixed node \"%.*s\" in XML xpath found.", *qname_len, *qname); 
5381             return LY_EVALID; 
5382         } 
5383     } 
5384  
5385     *moveto_mod = mod; 
5386     return LY_SUCCESS; 
5387 }

5389 /** 
5390  * @brief Move context @p set to the root. Handles absolute path. 
5391  *        Result is LYXP_SET_NODE_SET. 
5392  * 
5393  * @param[in,out] set Set to use. 
5394  * @param[in] options Xpath options. 
5395  * @return LY_ERR value. 
5396  */ 
5397 static LY_ERR 
5398 moveto_root(struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
5399 { 
5400     assert(!(options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR)); 
5401  
5402     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
5403         set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE); 
5404         LY_CHECK_RET(lyxp_set_scnode_insert_node(set, NULL, set->root_type, NULL)); 
5405     } else { 
5406         set->type = LYXP_SET_NODE_SET; 
5407         set->used = 0; 
5408         set_insert_node(set, NULL, 0, set->root_type, 0); 
5409     } 
5410  
5411     return LY_SUCCESS; 
5412 } 
5413  
5414 /** 
5415  * @brief Check @p node as a part of NameTest processing. 
5416  * 
5417  * @param[in] node Node to check. 
5418  * @param[in] set Set to read general context from. 
5419  * @param[in] node_name Node name in the dictionary to move to, NULL for any node. 
5420  * @param[in] moveto_mod Expected module of the node, NULL for no prefix. 
5421  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
5422  * @return LY_ERR (LY_ENOT if node does not match, LY_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when, 
5423  * LY_EINVAL if netither node nor any children match) 
5424  */ 
5425 static LY_ERR 
5426 moveto_node_check(const struct lyd_node *node, const struct lyxp_set *set, const char *node_name, 
5427         const struct lys_module *moveto_mod, uint32_t options) 
5428 { 
5429     if (!node->schema) { 
5430         /* opaque node never matches */ 
5431         return LY_ENOT; 
5432     } 
5433  
5434     /* module check */ 
5435     if (moveto_mod && (node->schema->module != moveto_mod)) { 
5436         return LY_ENOT; 
5437     } 
5438  
5439     /* context check */ 
5440     if ((set->root_type == LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG) && (node->schema->flags & LYS_CONFIG_R)) { 
5441         return LY_EINVAL; 
5442     } else if (set->context_op && (node->schema->nodetype & (LYS_RPC | LYS_ACTION | LYS_NOTIF)) && 
5443             (node->schema != set->context_op)) { 
5444         return LY_EINVAL; 
5445     } 
5446  
5447     /* name check */ 
5448     if (node_name && strcmp(node_name, "*") && (node->schema->name != node_name)) { 
5449         return LY_ENOT; 
5450     } 
5451  
5452     /* when check */ 
5453     if (!(options & LYXP_IGNORE_WHEN) && lysc_has_when(node->schema) && !(node->flags & LYD_WHEN_TRUE)) { 
5454         return LY_EINCOMPLETE; 
5455     } 
5456  
5457     /* match */ 
5458     return LY_SUCCESS; 
5459 } 
5460  
5461 /** 
5462  * @brief Check @p node as a part of schema NameTest processing. 
5463  * 
5464  * @param[in] node Schema node to check. 
5465  * @param[in] ctx_scnode Context node. 
5466  * @param[in] set Set to read general context from. 
5467  * @param[in] node_name Node name in the dictionary to move to, NULL for any nodes. 
5468  * @param[in] moveto_mod Expected module of the node, NULL for no prefix. 
5469  * @return LY_ERR (LY_ENOT if node does not match, LY_EINVAL if neither node nor any children match) 
5470  */ 
5471 static LY_ERR 
5472 moveto_scnode_check(const struct lysc_node *node, const struct lysc_node *ctx_scnode, const struct lyxp_set *set, 
5473         const char *node_name, const struct lys_module *moveto_mod) 
5474 { 
5475     if (!moveto_mod && node_name && strcmp(node_name, "*")) { 
5476         switch (set->format) { 
5477         case LY_VALUE_SCHEMA: 
5478         case LY_VALUE_SCHEMA_RESOLVED: 
5479             /* use current module */ 
5480             moveto_mod = set->cur_mod; 
5481             break; 
5482         case LY_VALUE_JSON: 
5483         case LY_VALUE_LYB: 
5484             /* inherit module of the context node, if any */ 
5485             if (ctx_scnode) { 
5486                 moveto_mod = ctx_scnode->module; 
5487             } 
5488             break; 
5489         case LY_VALUE_CANON: 
5490         case LY_VALUE_XML: 
5491             /* not defined */ 
5492             LOGINT(set->ctx); 
5493             return LY_EINVAL; 
5494         } 
5495     } 
5496  
5497     /* module check */ 
5498     if (moveto_mod && (node->module != moveto_mod)) { 
5499         return LY_ENOT; 
5500     } 
5501  
5502     /* context check */ 
5503     if ((set->root_type == LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG) && (node->flags & LYS_CONFIG_R)) { 
5504         return LY_EINVAL; 
5505     } else if (set->context_op && (node->nodetype & (LYS_RPC | LYS_ACTION | LYS_NOTIF)) && (node != set->context_op)) { 
5506         return LY_EINVAL; 
5507     } 
5508  
5509     /* name check */ 
5510     if (node_name && strcmp(node_name, "*") && (node->name != node_name)) { 
5511         return LY_ENOT; 
5512     } 
5513  
5514     /* match */ 
5515     return LY_SUCCESS; 
5516 }

5518 /** 
5519  * @brief Move context @p set to a node. Result is LYXP_SET_NODE_SET (or LYXP_SET_EMPTY). Context position aware. 
5520  * 
5521  * @param[in,out] set Set to use. 
5522  * @param[in] moveto_mod Matching node module, NULL for no prefix. 
5523  * @param[in] ncname Matching node name in the dictionary, NULL for any. 
5524  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
5525  * @return LY_ERR (LY_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when) 
5526  */ 
5527 static LY_ERR 
5528 moveto_node(struct lyxp_set *set, const struct lys_module *moveto_mod, const char *ncname, uint32_t options) 
5529 { 
5530     LY_ERR r, rc = LY_SUCCESS; 
5531     const struct lyd_node *siblings, *sub; 
5532     struct lyxp_set result; 
5533  
5534     if (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) { 
5535         return LY_SUCCESS; 
5536     } 
5537  
5538     if (set->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
5539         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INOP_1, "path operator", print_set_type(set)); 
5540         return LY_EVALID; 
5541     } 
5542  
5543     /* init result set */ 
5544     set_init(&result, set); 
5545  
5546     for (uint32_t i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
5547         if ((set->val.nodes[i].type == LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG) || (set->val.nodes[i].type == LYXP_NODE_ROOT)) { 
5548             assert(!set->val.nodes[i].node); 
5549  
5550             /* search in all the trees */ 
5551             siblings = set->tree; 
5552         } else { 
5553             /* search in children */ 
5554             siblings = lyd_child(set->val.nodes[i].node); 
5555         } 
5556  
5557         for (sub = siblings; sub; sub = sub->next) { 
5558             r = moveto_node_check(sub, set, ncname, moveto_mod, options); 
5559             if (r == LY_SUCCESS) { 
5560                 /* matching node */ 
5561                 set_insert_node(&result, sub, 0, LYXP_NODE_ELEM, result.used); 
5562             } else if (r == LY_EINCOMPLETE) { 
5563                 rc = r; 
5564                 goto cleanup; 
5565             } 
5566         } 
5567     } 
5568  
5569     /* move result to the set */ 
5570     lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
5571     *set = result; 
5572     result.type = LYXP_SET_NUMBER; 
5573     assert(!set_sort(set)); 
5574  
5575 cleanup: 
5576     lyxp_set_free_content(&result); 
5577     return rc; 
5578 } 
5579  
5580 /** 
5581  * @brief Move context @p set to a node using hashes. Result is LYXP_SET_NODE_SET (or LYXP_SET_EMPTY). 
5582  * Context position aware. 
5583  * 
5584  * @param[in,out] set Set to use. 
5585  * @param[in] scnode Matching node schema. 
5586  * @param[in] predicates If @p scnode is ::LYS_LIST or ::LYS_LEAFLIST, the predicates specifying a single instance. 
5587  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
5588  * @return LY_ERR (LY_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when) 
5589  */ 
5590 static LY_ERR 
5591 moveto_node_hash(struct lyxp_set *set, const struct lysc_node *scnode, const struct ly_path_predicate *predicates, 
5592         uint32_t options) 
5593 { 
5594     LY_ERR ret = LY_SUCCESS; 
5595     uint32_t i; 
5596     const struct lyd_node *siblings; 
5597     struct lyxp_set result; 
5598     struct lyd_node *sub, *inst = NULL; 
5599  
5600     assert(scnode && (!(scnode->nodetype & (LYS_LIST | LYS_LEAFLIST)) || predicates)); 
5601  
5602     /* init result set */ 
5603     set_init(&result, set); 
5604  
5605     if (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) { 
5606         goto cleanup; 
5607     } 
5608  
5609     if (set->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
5610         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INOP_1, "path operator", print_set_type(set)); 
5611         ret = LY_EVALID; 
5612         goto cleanup; 
5613     } 
5614  
5615     /* context check for all the nodes since we have the schema node */ 
5616     if ((set->root_type == LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG) && (scnode->flags & LYS_CONFIG_R)) { 
5617         lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
5618         goto cleanup; 
5619     } else if (set->context_op && (scnode->nodetype & (LYS_RPC | LYS_ACTION | LYS_NOTIF)) && 
5620             (scnode != set->context_op)) { 
5621         lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
5622         goto cleanup; 
5623     } 
5624  
5625     /* create specific data instance if needed */ 
5626     if (scnode->nodetype == LYS_LIST) { 
5627         LY_CHECK_GOTO(ret = lyd_create_list(scnode, predicates, &inst), cleanup); 
5628     } else if (scnode->nodetype == LYS_LEAFLIST) { 
5629         LY_CHECK_GOTO(ret = lyd_create_term2(scnode, &predicates[0].value, &inst), cleanup); 
5630     } 
5631  
5632     for (i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
5633         siblings = NULL; 
5634  
5635         if ((set->val.nodes[i].type == LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG) || (set->val.nodes[i].type == LYXP_NODE_ROOT)) { 
5636             assert(!set->val.nodes[i].node); 
5637  
5638             /* search in all the trees */ 
5639             siblings = set->tree; 
5640         } else if (set->val.nodes[i].type == LYXP_NODE_ELEM) { 
5641             /* search in children */ 
5642             siblings = lyd_child(set->val.nodes[i].node); 
5643         } 
5644  
5645         /* find the node using hashes */ 
5646         if (inst) { 
5647             lyd_find_sibling_first(siblings, inst, &sub); 
5648         } else { 
5649             lyd_find_sibling_val(siblings, scnode, NULL, 0, &sub); 
5650         } 
5651  
5652         /* when check */ 
5653         if (!(options & LYXP_IGNORE_WHEN) && sub && lysc_has_when(sub->schema) && !(sub->flags & LYD_WHEN_TRUE)) { 
5654             ret = LY_EINCOMPLETE; 
5655             goto cleanup; 
5656         } 
5657  
5658         if (sub) { 
5659             /* pos filled later */ 
5660             set_insert_node(&result, sub, 0, LYXP_NODE_ELEM, result.used); 
5661         } 
5662     } 
5663  
5664     /* move result to the set */ 
5665     lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
5666     *set = result; 
5667     result.type = LYXP_SET_NUMBER; 
5668     assert(!set_sort(set)); 
5669  
5670 cleanup: 
5671     lyxp_set_free_content(&result); 
5672     lyd_free_tree(inst); 
5673     return ret; 
5674 } 
5675  
5676 /** 
5677  * @brief Move context @p set to a schema node. Result is LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET (or LYXP_SET_EMPTY). 
5678  * 
5679  * @param[in,out] set Set to use. 
5680  * @param[in] moveto_mod Matching node module, NULL for no prefix. 
5681  * @param[in] ncname Matching node name in the dictionary, NULL for any. 
5682  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
5683  * @return LY_ERR 
5684  */ 
5685 static LY_ERR 
5686 moveto_scnode(struct lyxp_set *set, const struct lys_module *moveto_mod, const char *ncname, uint32_t options) 
5687 { 
5688     ly_bool temp_ctx = 0; 
5689     uint32_t getnext_opts; 
5690     uint32_t orig_used, i; 
5691     uint32_t mod_idx; 
5692     const struct lysc_node *iter, *start_parent; 
5693     const struct lys_module *mod; 
5694  
5695     if (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) { 
5696         return LY_SUCCESS; 
5697     } 
5698  
5699     if (set->type != LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) { 
5700         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INOP_1, "path operator", print_set_type(set)); 
5701         return LY_EVALID; 
5702     } 
5703  
5704     /* getnext opts */ 
5705     getnext_opts = 0; 
5706     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_OUTPUT) { 
5707         getnext_opts |= LYS_GETNEXT_OUTPUT; 
5708     } 
5709  
5710     orig_used = set->used; 
5711     for (i = 0; i < orig_used; ++i) { 
5712         uint32_t idx; 
5713  
5714         if (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx != LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_CTX) { 
5715             if (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx != LYXP_SET_SCNODE_START) { 
5716                 continue; 
5717             } 
5718  
5719             /* remember context node */ 
5720             set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_START_USED; 
5721         } else { 
5722             set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE; 
5723         } 
5724  
5725         start_parent = set->val.scnodes[i].scnode; 
5726  
5727         if ((set->val.scnodes[i].type == LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG) || (set->val.scnodes[i].type == LYXP_NODE_ROOT)) { 
5728             /* it can actually be in any module, it's all <running>, and even if it's moveto_mod (if set), 
5729              * it can be in a top-level augment (the root node itself is useless in this case) */ 
5730             mod_idx = 0; 
5731             while ((mod = ly_ctx_get_module_iter(set->ctx, &mod_idx))) { 
5732                 iter = NULL; 
5733                 /* module may not be implemented or not compiled yet */ 
5734                 while (mod->compiled && (iter = lys_getnext(iter, NULL, mod->compiled, getnext_opts))) { 
5735                     if (!moveto_scnode_check(iter, NULL, set, ncname, moveto_mod)) { 
5736                         LY_CHECK_RET(lyxp_set_scnode_insert_node(set, iter, LYXP_NODE_ELEM, &idx)); 
5737  
5738                         /* we need to prevent these nodes from being considered in this moveto */ 
5739                         if ((idx < orig_used) && (idx > i)) { 
5740                             set->val.scnodes[idx].in_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NEW_CTX; 
5741                             temp_ctx = 1; 
5742                         } 
5743                     } 
5744                 } 
5745             } 
5746  
5747         } else if (set->val.scnodes[i].type == LYXP_NODE_ELEM) { 
5748             iter = NULL; 
5749             while ((iter = lys_getnext(iter, start_parent, NULL, getnext_opts))) { 
5750                 if (!moveto_scnode_check(iter, start_parent, set, ncname, moveto_mod)) { 
5751                     LY_CHECK_RET(lyxp_set_scnode_insert_node(set, iter, LYXP_NODE_ELEM, &idx)); 
5752  
5753                     if ((idx < orig_used) && (idx > i)) { 
5754                         set->val.scnodes[idx].in_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NEW_CTX; 
5755                         temp_ctx = 1; 
5756                     } 
5757                 } 
5758             } 
5759         } 
5760     } 
5761  
5762     /* correct temporary in_ctx values */ 
5763     if (temp_ctx) { 
5764         for (i = 0; i < orig_used; ++i) { 
5765             if (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NEW_CTX) { 
5766                 set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_CTX; 
5767             } 
5768         } 
5769     } 
5770  
5771     return LY_SUCCESS; 
5772 } 
5773  
5774 /** 
5775  * @brief Move context @p set to a node and all its descendants. Result is LYXP_SET_NODE_SET (or LYXP_SET_EMPTY). 
5776  *        Context position aware. 
5777  * 
5778  * @param[in] set Set to use. 
5779  * @param[in] moveto_mod Matching node module, NULL for no prefix. 
5780  * @param[in] ncname Matching node name in the dictionary, NULL for any. 
5781  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
5782  * @return LY_ERR (LY_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when) 
5783  */ 
5784 static LY_ERR 
5785 moveto_node_alldesc(struct lyxp_set *set, const struct lys_module *moveto_mod, const char *ncname, uint32_t options) 
5786 { 
5787     uint32_t i; 
5788     const struct lyd_node *next, *elem, *start; 
5789     struct lyxp_set ret_set; 
5790     LY_ERR rc; 
5791  
5792     if (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) { 
5793         return LY_SUCCESS; 
5794     } 
5795  
5796     if (set->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
5797         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INOP_1, "path operator", print_set_type(set)); 
5798         return LY_EVALID; 
5799     } 
5800  
5801     /* replace the original nodes (and throws away all text and meta nodes, root is replaced by a child) */ 
5802     rc = moveto_node(set, NULL, NULL, options); 
5803     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
5804  
5805     /* this loop traverses all the nodes in the set and adds/keeps only those that match qname */ 
5806     set_init(&ret_set, set); 
5807     for (i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
5808  
5809         /* TREE DFS */ 
5810         start = set->val.nodes[i].node; 
5811         for (elem = next = start; elem; elem = next) { 
5812             rc = moveto_node_check(elem, set, ncname, moveto_mod, options); 
5813             if (!rc) { 
5814                 /* add matching node into result set */ 
5815                 set_insert_node(&ret_set, elem, 0, LYXP_NODE_ELEM, ret_set.used); 
5816                 if (set_dup_node_check(set, elem, LYXP_NODE_ELEM, i)) { 
5817                     /* the node is a duplicate, we'll process it later in the set */ 
5818                     goto skip_children; 
5819                 } 
5820             } else if (rc == LY_EINCOMPLETE) { 
5821                 return rc; 
5822             } else if (rc == LY_EINVAL) { 
5823                 goto skip_children; 
5824             } 
5825  
5826             /* TREE DFS NEXT ELEM */ 
5827             /* select element for the next run - children first */ 
5828             next = lyd_child(elem); 
5829             if (!next) { 
5830 skip_children: 
5831                 /* no children, so try siblings, but only if it's not the start, 
5832                  * that is considered to be the root and it's siblings are not traversed */ 
5833                 if (elem != start) { 
5834                     next = elem->next; 
5835                 } else { 
5836                     break; 
5837                 } 
5838             } 
5839             while (!next) { 
5840                 /* no siblings, go back through the parents */ 
5841                 if (lyd_parent(elem) == start) { 
5842                     /* we are done, no next element to process */ 
5843                     break; 
5844                 } 
5845                 /* parent is already processed, go to its sibling */ 
5846                 elem = lyd_parent(elem); 
5847                 next = elem->next; 
5848             } 
5849         } 
5850     } 
5851  
5852     /* make the temporary set the current one */ 
5853     ret_set.ctx_pos = set->ctx_pos; 
5854     ret_set.ctx_size = set->ctx_size; 
5855     lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
5856     memcpy(set, &ret_set, sizeof *set); 
5857  
5858     return LY_SUCCESS; 
5859 } 
5860  
5861 /** 
5862  * @brief Move context @p set to a schema node and all its descendants. Result is LYXP_SET_NODE_SET. 
5863  * 
5864  * @param[in] set Set to use. 
5865  * @param[in] moveto_mod Matching node module, NULL for no prefix. 
5866  * @param[in] ncname Matching node name in the dictionary, NULL for any. 
5867  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
5868  * @return LY_ERR 
5869  */ 
5870 static LY_ERR 
5871 moveto_scnode_alldesc(struct lyxp_set *set, const struct lys_module *moveto_mod, const char *ncname, uint32_t options) 
5872 { 
5873     uint32_t i, orig_used; 
5874     const struct lysc_node *next, *elem, *start; 
5875     LY_ERR rc; 
5876  
5877     if (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) { 
5878         return LY_SUCCESS; 
5879     } 
5880  
5881     if (set->type != LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) { 
5882         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INOP_1, "path operator", print_set_type(set)); 
5883         return LY_EVALID; 
5884     } 
5885  
5886     orig_used = set->used; 
5887     for (i = 0; i < orig_used; ++i) { 
5888         if (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx != LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_CTX) { 
5889             if (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx != LYXP_SET_SCNODE_START) { 
5890                 continue; 
5891             } 
5892  
5893             /* remember context node */ 
5894             set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_START_USED; 
5895         } else { 
5896             set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE; 
5897         } 
5898  
5899         /* TREE DFS */ 
5900         start = set->val.scnodes[i].scnode; 
5901         for (elem = next = start; elem; elem = next) { 
5902             if ((elem == start) || (elem->nodetype & (LYS_CHOICE | LYS_CASE))) { 
5903                 /* schema-only nodes, skip root */ 
5904                 goto next_iter; 
5905             } 
5906  
5907             rc = moveto_scnode_check(elem, start, set, ncname, moveto_mod); 
5908             if (!rc) { 
5909                 uint32_t idx; 
5910  
5911                 if (lyxp_set_scnode_contains(set, elem, LYXP_NODE_ELEM, i, &idx)) { 
5912                     set->val.scnodes[idx].in_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_CTX; 
5913                     if ((uint32_t)idx > i) { 
5914                         /* we will process it later in the set */ 
5915                         goto skip_children; 
5916                     } 
5917                 } else { 
5918                     LY_CHECK_RET(lyxp_set_scnode_insert_node(set, elem, LYXP_NODE_ELEM, NULL)); 
5919                 } 
5920             } else if (rc == LY_EINVAL) { 
5921                 goto skip_children; 
5922             } 
5923  
5924 next_iter: 
5925             /* TREE DFS NEXT ELEM */ 
5926             /* select element for the next run - children first */ 
5927             next = lysc_node_child(elem); 
5928             if (next && (next->nodetype == LYS_INPUT) && (options & LYXP_SCNODE_OUTPUT)) { 
5929                 next = next->next; 
5930             } else if (next && (next->nodetype == LYS_OUTPUT) && !(options & LYXP_SCNODE_OUTPUT)) { 
5931                 next = next->next; 
5932             } 
5933             if (!next) { 
5934 skip_children: 
5935                 /* no children, so try siblings, but only if it's not the start, 
5936                  * that is considered to be the root and it's siblings are not traversed */ 
5937                 if (elem != start) { 
5938                     next = elem->next; 
5939                 } else { 
5940                     break; 
5941                 } 
5942             } 
5943             while (!next) { 
5944                 /* no siblings, go back through the parents */ 
5945                 if (elem->parent == start) { 
5946                     /* we are done, no next element to process */ 
5947                     break; 
5948                 } 
5949                 /* parent is already processed, go to its sibling */ 
5950                 elem = elem->parent; 
5951                 next = elem->next; 
5952             } 
5953         } 
5954     } 
5955  
5956     return LY_SUCCESS; 
5957 }

5959 /** 
5960  * @brief Move context @p set to an attribute. Result is LYXP_SET_NODE_SET. 
5961  *        Indirectly context position aware. 
5962  * 
5963  * @param[in,out] set Set to use. 
5964  * @param[in] mod Matching metadata module, NULL for any. 
5965  * @param[in] ncname Matching metadata name in the dictionary, NULL for any. 
5966  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
5967  * @return LY_ERR 
5968  */ 
5969 static LY_ERR 
5970 moveto_attr(struct lyxp_set *set, const struct lys_module *mod, const char *ncname, uint32_t options) 
5971 { 
5972     struct lyd_meta *sub; 
5973  
5974     if (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) { 
5975         return LY_SUCCESS; 
5976     } 
5977  
5978     if (set->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
5979         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INOP_1, "path operator", print_set_type(set)); 
5980         return LY_EVALID; 
5981     } 
5982  
5983     for (uint32_t i = 0; i < set->used; ) { 
5984         ly_bool replaced = 0; 
5985  
5986         /* only attributes of an elem (not dummy) can be in the result, skip all the rest; 
5987          * our attributes are always qualified */ 
5988         if (set->val.nodes[i].type == LYXP_NODE_ELEM) { 
5989             for (sub = set->val.nodes[i].node->meta; sub; sub = sub->next) { 
5990  
5991                 /* check "namespace" */ 
5992                 if (mod && (sub->annotation->module != mod)) { 
5993                     continue; 
5994                 } 
5995  
5996                 if (!ncname || (sub->name == ncname)) { 
5997                     /* match */ 
5998                     if (!replaced) { 
5999                         set->val.meta[i].meta = sub; 
6000                         set->val.meta[i].type = LYXP_NODE_META; 
6001                         /* pos does not change */ 
6002                         replaced = 1; 
6003                     } else { 
6004                         set_insert_node(set, (struct lyd_node *)sub, set->val.nodes[i].pos, LYXP_NODE_META, i + 1); 
6005                     } 
6006                     ++i; 
6007                 } 
6008             } 
6009         } 
6010  
6011         if (!replaced) { 
6012             /* no match */ 
6013             set_remove_node(set, i); 
6014         } 
6015     } 
6016  
6017     return LY_SUCCESS; 
6018 }

6020 /** 
6021  * @brief Move context @p set1 to union with @p set2. @p set2 is emptied afterwards. 
6022  *        Result is LYXP_SET_NODE_SET. Context position aware. 
6023  * 
6024  * @param[in,out] set1 Set to use for the result. 
6025  * @param[in] set2 Set that is copied to @p set1. 
6026  * @return LY_ERR 
6027  */ 
6028 static LY_ERR 
6029 moveto_union(struct lyxp_set *set1, struct lyxp_set *set2) 
6030 { 
6031     LY_ERR rc; 
6032  
6033     if ((set1->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) || (set2->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET)) { 
6034         LOGVAL(set1->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INOP_2, "union", print_set_type(set1), print_set_type(set2)); 
6035         return LY_EVALID; 
6036     } 
6037  
6038     /* set2 is empty or both set1 and set2 */ 
6039     if (!set2->used) { 
6040         return LY_SUCCESS; 
6041     } 
6042  
6043     if (!set1->used) { 
6044         /* release hidden allocated data (lyxp_set.size) */ 
6045         lyxp_set_free_content(set1); 
6046         /* direct copying of the entire structure */ 
6047         memcpy(set1, set2, sizeof *set1); 
6048         /* dynamic memory belongs to set1 now, do not free */ 
6049         memset(set2, 0, sizeof *set2); 
6050         return LY_SUCCESS; 
6051     } 
6052  
6053     /* we assume sets are sorted */ 
6054     assert(!set_sort(set1) && !set_sort(set2)); 
6055  
6056     /* sort, remove duplicates */ 
6057     rc = set_sorted_merge(set1, set2); 
6058     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
6059  
6060     /* final set must be sorted */ 
6061     assert(!set_sort(set1)); 
6062  
6063     return LY_SUCCESS; 
6064 }

6066 /** 
6067  * @brief Move context @p set to an attribute in any of the descendants. Result is LYXP_SET_NODE_SET. 
6068  *        Context position aware. 
6069  * 
6070  * @param[in,out] set Set to use. 
6071  * @param[in] mod Matching metadata module, NULL for any. 
6072  * @param[in] ncname Matching metadata name in the dictionary, NULL for any. 
6073  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
6074  * @return LY_ERR (LY_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when) 
6075  */ 
6076 static int 
6077 moveto_attr_alldesc(struct lyxp_set *set, const struct lys_module *mod, const char *ncname, uint32_t options) 
6078 { 
6079     struct lyd_meta *sub; 
6080     struct lyxp_set *set_all_desc = NULL; 
6081     LY_ERR rc; 
6082  
6083     if (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) { 
6084         return LY_SUCCESS; 
6085     } 
6086  
6087     if (set->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
6088         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INOP_1, "path operator", print_set_type(set)); 
6089         return LY_EVALID; 
6090     } 
6091  
6092     /* can be optimized similarly to moveto_node_alldesc() and save considerable amount of memory, 
6093      * but it likely won't be used much, so it's a waste of time */ 
6094     /* copy the context */ 
6095     set_all_desc = set_copy(set); 
6096     /* get all descendant nodes (the original context nodes are removed) */ 
6097     rc = moveto_node_alldesc(set_all_desc, NULL, NULL, options); 
6098     if (rc != LY_SUCCESS) { 
6099         lyxp_set_free(set_all_desc); 
6100         return rc; 
6101     } 
6102     /* prepend the original context nodes */ 
6103     rc = moveto_union(set, set_all_desc); 
6104     if (rc != LY_SUCCESS) { 
6105         lyxp_set_free(set_all_desc); 
6106         return rc; 
6107     } 
6108     lyxp_set_free(set_all_desc); 
6109  
6110     for (uint32_t i = 0; i < set->used; ) { 
6111         ly_bool replaced = 0; 
6112  
6113         /* only attributes of an elem can be in the result, skip all the rest, 
6114          * we have all attributes qualified in lyd tree */ 
6115         if (set->val.nodes[i].type == LYXP_NODE_ELEM) { 
6116             for (sub = set->val.nodes[i].node->meta; sub; sub = sub->next) { 
6117                 /* check "namespace" */ 
6118                 if (mod && (sub->annotation->module != mod)) { 
6119                     continue; 
6120                 } 
6121  
6122                 if (!ncname || (sub->name == ncname)) { 
6123                     /* match */ 
6124                     if (!replaced) { 
6125                         set->val.meta[i].meta = sub; 
6126                         set->val.meta[i].type = LYXP_NODE_META; 
6127                         /* pos does not change */ 
6128                         replaced = 1; 
6129                     } else { 
6130                         set_insert_node(set, (struct lyd_node *)sub, set->val.meta[i].pos, LYXP_NODE_META, i + 1); 
6131                     } 
6132                     ++i; 
6133                 } 
6134             } 
6135         } 
6136  
6137         if (!replaced) { 
6138             /* no match */ 
6139             set_remove_node(set, i); 
6140         } 
6141     } 
6142  
6143     return LY_SUCCESS; 
6144 }

6146 /** 
6147  * @brief Move context @p set to self and al chilren, recursively. Handles '/' or '//' and '.'. Result is LYXP_SET_NODE_SET. 
6148  *        Context position aware. 
6149  * 
6150  * @param[in] parent Current parent. 
6151  * @param[in] parent_pos Position of @p parent. 
6152  * @param[in] parent_type Node type of @p parent. 
6153  * @param[in,out] to_set Set to use. 
6154  * @param[in] dup_check_set Set for checking duplicities. 
6155  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
6156  * @return LY_ERR (LY_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when) 
6157  */ 
6158 static LY_ERR 
6159 moveto_self_add_children_r(const struct lyd_node *parent, uint32_t parent_pos, enum lyxp_node_type parent_type, 
6160         struct lyxp_set *to_set, const struct lyxp_set *dup_check_set, uint32_t options) 
6161 { 
6162     const struct lyd_node *iter, *first; 
6163     LY_ERR rc; 
6164  
6165     switch (parent_type) { 
6166     case LYXP_NODE_ROOT: 
6167     case LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG: 
6168         assert(!parent); 
6169  
6170         /* add all top-level nodes as elements */ 
6171         first = to_set->tree; 
6172         break; 
6173     case LYXP_NODE_ELEM: 
6174         /* add just the text node of this term element node */ 
6175         if (parent->schema->nodetype & (LYD_NODE_TERM | LYD_NODE_ANY)) { 
6176             if (!set_dup_node_check(dup_check_set, parent, LYXP_NODE_TEXT, -1)) { 
6177                 set_insert_node(to_set, parent, parent_pos, LYXP_NODE_TEXT, to_set->used); 
6178             } 
6179             return LY_SUCCESS; 
6180         } 
6181  
6182         /* add all the children of this node */ 
6183         first = lyd_child(parent); 
6184         break; 
6185     default: 
6186         LOGINT_RET(parent->schema->module->ctx); 
6187     } 
6188  
6189     /* add all top-level nodes as elements */ 
6190     LY_LIST_FOR(first, iter) { 
6191         /* context check */ 
6192         if ((parent_type == LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG) && (iter->schema->flags & LYS_CONFIG_R)) { 
6193             continue; 
6194         } 
6195  
6196         /* when check */ 
6197         if (!(options & LYXP_IGNORE_WHEN) && lysc_has_when(iter->schema) && !(iter->flags & LYD_WHEN_TRUE)) { 
6198             return LY_EINCOMPLETE; 
6199         } 
6200  
6201         if (!set_dup_node_check(dup_check_set, iter, LYXP_NODE_ELEM, -1)) { 
6202             set_insert_node(to_set, iter, 0, LYXP_NODE_ELEM, to_set->used); 
6203  
6204             /* also add all the children of this node, recursively */ 
6205             rc = moveto_self_add_children_r(iter, 0, LYXP_NODE_ELEM, to_set, dup_check_set, options); 
6206             LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
6207         } 
6208     } 
6209  
6210     return LY_SUCCESS; 
6211 } 
6212  
6213 /** 
6214  * @brief Move context @p set to self. Handles '/' or '//' and '.'. Result is LYXP_SET_NODE_SET 
6215  *        (or LYXP_SET_EMPTY). Context position aware. 
6216  * 
6217  * @param[in,out] set Set to use. 
6218  * @param[in] all_desc Whether to go to all descendants ('//') or not ('/'). 
6219  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
6220  * @return LY_ERR (LY_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when) 
6221  */ 
6222 static LY_ERR 
6223 moveto_self(struct lyxp_set *set, ly_bool all_desc, uint32_t options) 
6224 { 
6225     struct lyxp_set ret_set; 
6226     LY_ERR rc; 
6227  
6228     if (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) { 
6229         return LY_SUCCESS; 
6230     } 
6231  
6232     if (set->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
6233         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INOP_1, "path operator", print_set_type(set)); 
6234         return LY_EVALID; 
6235     } 
6236  
6237     /* nothing to do */ 
6238     if (!all_desc) { 
6239         return LY_SUCCESS; 
6240     } 
6241  
6242     /* add all the children, they get added recursively */ 
6243     set_init(&ret_set, set); 
6244     for (uint32_t i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
6245         /* copy the current node to tmp */ 
6246         set_insert_node(&ret_set, set->val.nodes[i].node, set->val.nodes[i].pos, set->val.nodes[i].type, ret_set.used); 
6247  
6248         /* do not touch attributes and text nodes */ 
6249         if ((set->val.nodes[i].type == LYXP_NODE_TEXT) || (set->val.nodes[i].type == LYXP_NODE_META)) { 
6250             continue; 
6251         } 
6252  
6253         /* add all the children */ 
6254         rc = moveto_self_add_children_r(set->val.nodes[i].node, set->val.nodes[i].pos, set->val.nodes[i].type, &ret_set, 
6255                 set, options); 
6256         if (rc != LY_SUCCESS) { 
6257             lyxp_set_free_content(&ret_set); 
6258             return rc; 
6259         } 
6260     } 
6261  
6262     /* use the temporary set as the current one */ 
6263     ret_set.ctx_pos = set->ctx_pos; 
6264     ret_set.ctx_size = set->ctx_size; 
6265     lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
6266     memcpy(set, &ret_set, sizeof *set); 
6267  
6268     return LY_SUCCESS; 
6269 } 
6270  
6271 /** 
6272  * @brief Move context schema @p set to self. Handles '/' or '//' and '.'. Result is LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET 
6273  *        (or LYXP_SET_EMPTY). 
6274  * 
6275  * @param[in,out] set Set to use. 
6276  * @param[in] all_desc Whether to go to all descendants ('//') or not ('/'). 
6277  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
6278  * @return LY_ERR 
6279  */ 
6280 static LY_ERR 
6281 moveto_scnode_self(struct lyxp_set *set, ly_bool all_desc, uint32_t options) 
6282 { 
6283     uint32_t getnext_opts; 
6284     uint32_t mod_idx; 
6285     const struct lysc_node *iter, *start_parent; 
6286     const struct lys_module *mod; 
6287  
6288     if (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) { 
6289         return LY_SUCCESS; 
6290     } 
6291  
6292     if (set->type != LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) { 
6293         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INOP_1, "path operator", print_set_type(set)); 
6294         return LY_EVALID; 
6295     } 
6296  
6297     /* getnext opts */ 
6298     getnext_opts = 0; 
6299     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_OUTPUT) { 
6300         getnext_opts |= LYS_GETNEXT_OUTPUT; 
6301     } 
6302  
6303     /* add all the children, recursively as they are being added into the same set */ 
6304     for (uint32_t i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
6305         if (!all_desc) { 
6306             /* traverse the start node */ 
6307             if (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_START) { 
6308                 set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_CTX; 
6309             } 
6310             continue; 
6311         } 
6312  
6313         if (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx != LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_CTX) { 
6314             if (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx != LYXP_SET_SCNODE_START) { 
6315                 continue; 
6316             } 
6317  
6318             /* remember context node */ 
6319             set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_START_USED; 
6320         } else { 
6321             set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE; 
6322         } 
6323  
6324         start_parent = set->val.scnodes[i].scnode; 
6325  
6326         if ((set->val.scnodes[i].type == LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG) || (set->val.scnodes[i].type == LYXP_NODE_ROOT)) { 
6327             /* it can actually be in any module, it's all <running> */ 
6328             mod_idx = 0; 
6329             while ((mod = ly_ctx_get_module_iter(set->ctx, &mod_idx))) { 
6330                 iter = NULL; 
6331                 /* module may not be implemented */ 
6332                 while (mod->implemented && (iter = lys_getnext(iter, NULL, mod->compiled, getnext_opts))) { 
6333                     /* context check */ 
6334                     if ((set->root_type == LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG) && (iter->flags & LYS_CONFIG_R)) { 
6335                         continue; 
6336                     } 
6337  
6338                     LY_CHECK_RET(lyxp_set_scnode_insert_node(set, iter, LYXP_NODE_ELEM, NULL)); 
6339                     /* throw away the insert index, we want to consider that node again, recursively */ 
6340                 } 
6341             } 
6342  
6343         } else if (set->val.scnodes[i].type == LYXP_NODE_ELEM) { 
6344             iter = NULL; 
6345             while ((iter = lys_getnext(iter, start_parent, NULL, getnext_opts))) { 
6346                 /* context check */ 
6347                 if ((set->root_type == LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG) && (iter->flags & LYS_CONFIG_R)) { 
6348                     continue; 
6349                 } 
6350  
6351                 LY_CHECK_RET(lyxp_set_scnode_insert_node(set, iter, LYXP_NODE_ELEM, NULL)); 
6352             } 
6353         } 
6354     } 
6355  
6356     return LY_SUCCESS; 
6357 } 
6358  
6359 /** 
6360  * @brief Move context @p set to parent. Handles '/' or '//' and '..'. Result is LYXP_SET_NODE_SET 
6361  *        (or LYXP_SET_EMPTY). Context position aware. 
6362  * 
6363  * @param[in] set Set to use. 
6364  * @param[in] all_desc Whether to go to all descendants ('//') or not ('/'). 
6365  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
6366  * @return LY_ERR (LY_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when) 
6367  */ 
6368 static LY_ERR 
6369 moveto_parent(struct lyxp_set *set, ly_bool all_desc, uint32_t options) 
6370 { 
6371     LY_ERR rc = LY_SUCCESS; 
6372     struct lyd_node *node, *new_node; 
6373     enum lyxp_node_type new_type; 
6374     struct lyxp_set result; 
6375  
6376     if (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) { 
6377         return LY_SUCCESS; 
6378     } 
6379  
6380     if (set->type != LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
6381         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INOP_1, "path operator", print_set_type(set)); 
6382         return LY_EVALID; 
6383     } 
6384  
6385     if (all_desc) { 
6386         /* <path>//.. == <path>//./.. */ 
6387         rc = moveto_self(set, 1, options); 
6388         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
6389     } 
6390  
6391     /* init result set */ 
6392     set_init(&result, set); 
6393  
6394     for (uint32_t i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
6395         node = set->val.nodes[i].node; 
6396  
6397         if (set->val.nodes[i].type == LYXP_NODE_ELEM) { 
6398             new_node = lyd_parent(node); 
6399         } else if (set->val.nodes[i].type == LYXP_NODE_TEXT) { 
6400             new_node = node; 
6401         } else if (set->val.nodes[i].type == LYXP_NODE_META) { 
6402             new_node = set->val.meta[i].meta->parent; 
6403             if (!new_node) { 
6404                 LOGINT(set->ctx); 
6405                 rc = LY_EINT; 
6406                 goto cleanup; 
6407             } 
6408         } else { 
6409             /* root does not have a parent */ 
6410             continue; 
6411         } 
6412  
6413         /* when check */ 
6414         if (!(options & LYXP_IGNORE_WHEN) && new_node && lysc_has_when(new_node->schema) && 
6415                 !(new_node->flags & LYD_WHEN_TRUE)) { 
6416             rc = LY_EINCOMPLETE; 
6417             goto cleanup; 
6418         } 
6419  
6420         if (!new_node) { 
6421             /* node already there can also be the root */ 
6422             new_type = set->root_type; 
6423         } else { 
6424             /* node has a standard parent (it can equal the root, it's not the root yet since they are fake) */ 
6425             new_type = LYXP_NODE_ELEM; 
6426         } 
6427  
6428         /* check for duplicates, several nodes may have the same parent */ 
6429         if (!set_dup_node_check(&result, new_node, new_type, -1)) { 
6430             set_insert_node(&result, new_node, 0, new_type, result.used); 
6431         } 
6432     } 
6433  
6434     /* move result to the set */ 
6435     lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
6436     *set = result; 
6437     result.type = LYXP_SET_NUMBER; 
6438     assert(!set_sort(set)); 
6439  
6440 cleanup: 
6441     lyxp_set_free_content(&result); 
6442     return rc; 
6443 } 
6444  
6445 /** 
6446  * @brief Move context schema @p set to parent. Handles '/' or '//' and '..'. Result is LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET 
6447  *        (or LYXP_SET_EMPTY). 
6448  * 
6449  * @param[in] set Set to use. 
6450  * @param[in] all_desc Whether to go to all descendants ('//') or not ('/'). 
6451  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
6452  * @return LY_ERR 
6453  */ 
6454 static LY_ERR 
6455 moveto_scnode_parent(struct lyxp_set *set, ly_bool all_desc, uint32_t options) 
6456 { 
6457     uint32_t i, orig_used, idx; 
6458     ly_bool temp_ctx = 0; 
6459     const struct lysc_node *node, *new_node; 
6460     enum lyxp_node_type new_type; 
6461  
6462     if (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) { 
6463         return LY_SUCCESS; 
6464     } 
6465  
6466     if (set->type != LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) { 
6467         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INOP_1, "path operator", print_set_type(set)); 
6468         return LY_EVALID; 
6469     } 
6470  
6471     if (all_desc) { 
6472         /* <path>//.. == <path>//./.. */ 
6473         LY_CHECK_RET(moveto_scnode_self(set, 1, options)); 
6474     } 
6475  
6476     orig_used = set->used; 
6477     for (i = 0; i < orig_used; ++i) { 
6478         if (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx != LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_CTX) { 
6479             if (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx != LYXP_SET_SCNODE_START) { 
6480                 continue; 
6481             } 
6482  
6483             /* remember context node */ 
6484             set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_START_USED; 
6485         } else { 
6486             set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE; 
6487         } 
6488  
6489         node = set->val.scnodes[i].scnode; 
6490  
6491         if (set->val.scnodes[i].type == LYXP_NODE_ELEM) { 
6492             new_node = lysc_data_parent(node); 
6493         } else { 
6494             /* root does not have a parent */ 
6495             continue; 
6496         } 
6497  
6498         if (!new_node) { 
6499             /* node has no parent */ 
6500             new_type = set->root_type; 
6501  
6502         } else { 
6503             /* node has a standard parent (it can equal the root, it's not the root yet since they are fake) */ 
6504             new_type = LYXP_NODE_ELEM; 
6505         } 
6506  
6507         LY_CHECK_RET(lyxp_set_scnode_insert_node(set, new_node, new_type, &idx)); 
6508         if ((idx < orig_used) && (idx > i)) { 
6509             set->val.scnodes[idx].in_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NEW_CTX; 
6510             temp_ctx = 1; 
6511         } 
6512     } 
6513  
6514     if (temp_ctx) { 
6515         for (i = 0; i < orig_used; ++i) { 
6516             if (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NEW_CTX) { 
6517                 set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_CTX; 
6518             } 
6519         } 
6520     } 
6521  
6522     return LY_SUCCESS; 
6523 } 
6524  
6525 /** 
6526  * @brief Move context @p set to the result of a comparison. Handles '=', '!=', '<=', '<', '>=', or '>'. 
6527  *        Result is LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN. Indirectly context position aware. 
6528  * 
6529  * @param[in,out] set1 Set to use for the result. 
6530  * @param[in] set2 Set acting as the second operand for @p op. 
6531  * @param[in] op Comparison operator to process. 
6532  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
6533  * @return LY_ERR 
6534  */ 
6535 static LY_ERR 
6536 moveto_op_comp(struct lyxp_set *set1, struct lyxp_set *set2, const char *op, uint32_t options) 
6537 { 
6538     /* 
6539      * NODE SET + NODE SET = NODE SET + STRING /(1 NODE SET) 2 STRING 
6540      * NODE SET + STRING = STRING + STRING     /1 STRING (2 STRING) 
6541      * NODE SET + NUMBER = NUMBER + NUMBER     /1 NUMBER (2 NUMBER) 
6542      * NODE SET + BOOLEAN = BOOLEAN + BOOLEAN  /1 BOOLEAN (2 BOOLEAN) 
6543      * STRING + NODE SET = STRING + STRING     /(1 STRING) 2 STRING 
6544      * NUMBER + NODE SET = NUMBER + NUMBER     /(1 NUMBER) 2 NUMBER 
6545      * BOOLEAN + NODE SET = BOOLEAN + BOOLEAN  /(1 BOOLEAN) 2 BOOLEAN 
6546      * 
6547      * '=' or '!=' 
6548      * BOOLEAN + BOOLEAN 
6549      * BOOLEAN + STRING = BOOLEAN + BOOLEAN    /(1 BOOLEAN) 2 BOOLEAN 
6550      * BOOLEAN + NUMBER = BOOLEAN + BOOLEAN    /(1 BOOLEAN) 2 BOOLEAN 
6551      * STRING + BOOLEAN = BOOLEAN + BOOLEAN    /1 BOOLEAN (2 BOOLEAN) 
6552      * NUMBER + BOOLEAN = BOOLEAN + BOOLEAN    /1 BOOLEAN (2 BOOLEAN) 
6553      * NUMBER + NUMBER 
6554      * NUMBER + STRING = NUMBER + NUMBER       /(1 NUMBER) 2 NUMBER 
6555      * STRING + NUMBER = NUMBER + NUMBER       /1 NUMBER (2 NUMBER) 
6556      * STRING + STRING 
6557      * 
6558      * '<=', '<', '>=', '>' 
6559      * NUMBER + NUMBER 
6560      * BOOLEAN + BOOLEAN = NUMBER + NUMBER     /1 NUMBER, 2 NUMBER 
6561      * BOOLEAN + NUMBER = NUMBER + NUMBER      /1 NUMBER (2 NUMBER) 
6562      * BOOLEAN + STRING = NUMBER + NUMBER      /1 NUMBER, 2 NUMBER 
6563      * NUMBER + STRING = NUMBER + NUMBER       /(1 NUMBER) 2 NUMBER 
6564      * STRING + STRING = NUMBER + NUMBER       /1 NUMBER, 2 NUMBER 
6565      * STRING + NUMBER = NUMBER + NUMBER       /1 NUMBER (2 NUMBER) 
6566      * NUMBER + BOOLEAN = NUMBER + NUMBER      /(1 NUMBER) 2 NUMBER 
6567      * STRING + BOOLEAN = NUMBER + NUMBER      /(1 NUMBER) 2 NUMBER 
6568      */ 
6569     struct lyxp_set iter1, iter2; 
6570     int result; 
6571     int64_t i; 
6572     LY_ERR rc; 
6573  
6574     memset(&iter1, 0, sizeof iter1); 
6575     memset(&iter2, 0, sizeof iter2); 
6576  
6577     /* iterative evaluation with node-sets */ 
6578     if ((set1->type == LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) || (set2->type == LYXP_SET_NODE_SET)) { 
6579         if (set1->type == LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
6580             for (i = 0; i < set1->used; ++i) { 
6581                 /* cast set1 */ 
6582                 switch (set2->type) { 
6583                 case LYXP_SET_NUMBER: 
6584                     rc = set_comp_cast(&iter1, set1, LYXP_SET_NUMBER, i); 
6585                     break; 
6586                 case LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN: 
6587                     rc = set_comp_cast(&iter1, set1, LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN, i); 
6588                     break; 
6589                 default: 
6590                     rc = set_comp_cast(&iter1, set1, LYXP_SET_STRING, i); 
6591                     break; 
6592                 } 
6593                 LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
6594  
6595                 /* canonize set2 */ 
6596                 LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(rc = set_comp_canonize(&iter2, set2, &set1->val.nodes[i]), lyxp_set_free_content(&iter1), rc); 
6597  
6598                 /* compare recursively */ 
6599                 rc = moveto_op_comp(&iter1, &iter2, op, options); 
6600                 lyxp_set_free_content(&iter2); 
6601                 LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(rc, lyxp_set_free_content(&iter1), rc); 
6602  
6603                 /* lazy evaluation until true */ 
6604                 if (iter1.val.bln) { 
6605                     set_fill_boolean(set1, 1); 
6606                     return LY_SUCCESS; 
6607                 } 
6608             } 
6609         } else { 
6610             for (i = 0; i < set2->used; ++i) { 
6611                 /* set set2 */ 
6612                 switch (set1->type) { 
6613                 case LYXP_SET_NUMBER: 
6614                     rc = set_comp_cast(&iter2, set2, LYXP_SET_NUMBER, i); 
6615                     break; 
6616                 case LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN: 
6617                     rc = set_comp_cast(&iter2, set2, LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN, i); 
6618                     break; 
6619                 default: 
6620                     rc = set_comp_cast(&iter2, set2, LYXP_SET_STRING, i); 
6621                     break; 
6622                 } 
6623                 LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
6624  
6625                 /* canonize set1 */ 
6626                 LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(rc = set_comp_canonize(&iter1, set1, &set2->val.nodes[i]), lyxp_set_free_content(&iter2), rc); 
6627  
6628                 /* compare recursively */ 
6629                 rc = moveto_op_comp(&iter1, &iter2, op, options); 
6630                 lyxp_set_free_content(&iter2); 
6631                 LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(rc, lyxp_set_free_content(&iter1), rc); 
6632  
6633                 /* lazy evaluation until true */ 
6634                 if (iter1.val.bln) { 
6635                     set_fill_boolean(set1, 1); 
6636                     return LY_SUCCESS; 
6637                 } 
6638             } 
6639         } 
6640  
6641         /* false for all nodes */ 
6642         set_fill_boolean(set1, 0); 
6643         return LY_SUCCESS; 
6644     } 
6645  
6646     /* first convert properly */ 
6647     if ((op[0] == '=') || (op[0] == '!')) { 
6648         if ((set1->type == LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN) || (set2->type == LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN)) { 
6649             lyxp_set_cast(set1, LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN); 
6650             lyxp_set_cast(set2, LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN); 
6651         } else if ((set1->type == LYXP_SET_NUMBER) || (set2->type == LYXP_SET_NUMBER)) { 
6652             rc = lyxp_set_cast(set1, LYXP_SET_NUMBER); 
6653             LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
6654             rc = lyxp_set_cast(set2, LYXP_SET_NUMBER); 
6655             LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
6656         } /* else we have 2 strings */ 
6657     } else { 
6658         rc = lyxp_set_cast(set1, LYXP_SET_NUMBER); 
6659         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
6660         rc = lyxp_set_cast(set2, LYXP_SET_NUMBER); 
6661         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
6662     } 
6663
