6664     assert(set1->type == set2->type); 
6665  
6666     /* compute result */ 
6667     if (op[0] == '=') { 
6668         if (set1->type == LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN) { 
6669             result = (set1->val.bln == set2->val.bln); 
6670         } else if (set1->type == LYXP_SET_NUMBER) { 
6671             result = (set1->val.num == set2->val.num); 
6672         } else { 
6673             assert(set1->type == LYXP_SET_STRING); 
6674             result = !strcmp(set1->val.str, set2->val.str); 
6675         } 
6676     } else if (op[0] == '!') { 
6677         if (set1->type == LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN) { 
6678             result = (set1->val.bln != set2->val.bln); 
6679         } else if (set1->type == LYXP_SET_NUMBER) { 
6680             result = (set1->val.num != set2->val.num); 
6681         } else { 
6682             assert(set1->type == LYXP_SET_STRING); 
6683             result = strcmp(set1->val.str, set2->val.str); 
6684         } 
6685     } else { 
6686         assert(set1->type == LYXP_SET_NUMBER); 
6687         if (op[0] == '<') { 
6688             if (op[1] == '=') { 
6689                 result = (set1->val.num <= set2->val.num); 
6690             } else { 
6691                 result = (set1->val.num < set2->val.num); 
6692             } 
6693         } else { 
6694             if (op[1] == '=') { 
6695                 result = (set1->val.num >= set2->val.num); 
6696             } else { 
6697                 result = (set1->val.num > set2->val.num); 
6698             } 
6699         } 
6700     } 
6701  
6702     /* assign result */ 
6703     if (result) { 
6704         set_fill_boolean(set1, 1); 
6705     } else { 
6706         set_fill_boolean(set1, 0); 
6707     } 
6708  
6709     return LY_SUCCESS; 
6710 } 
6711  
6712 /** 
6713  * @brief Move context @p set to the result of a basic operation. Handles '+', '-', unary '-', '*', 'div', 
6714  *        or 'mod'. Result is LYXP_SET_NUMBER. Indirectly context position aware. 
6715  * 
6716  * @param[in,out] set1 Set to use for the result. 
6717  * @param[in] set2 Set acting as the second operand for @p op. 
6718  * @param[in] op Operator to process. 
6719  * @return LY_ERR 
6720  */ 
6721 static LY_ERR 
6722 moveto_op_math(struct lyxp_set *set1, struct lyxp_set *set2, const char *op) 
6723 { 
6724     LY_ERR rc; 
6725  
6726     /* unary '-' */ 
6727     if (!set2 && (op[0] == '-')) { 
6728         rc = lyxp_set_cast(set1, LYXP_SET_NUMBER); 
6729         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
6730         set1->val.num *= -1; 
6731         lyxp_set_free(set2); 
6732         return LY_SUCCESS; 
6733     } 
6734  
6735     assert(set1 && set2); 
6736  
6737     rc = lyxp_set_cast(set1, LYXP_SET_NUMBER); 
6738     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
6739     rc = lyxp_set_cast(set2, LYXP_SET_NUMBER); 
6740     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
6741  
6742     switch (op[0]) { 
6743     /* '+' */ 
6744     case '+': 
6745         set1->val.num += set2->val.num; 
6746         break; 
6747  
6748     /* '-' */ 
6749     case '-': 
6750         set1->val.num -= set2->val.num; 
6751         break; 
6752  
6753     /* '*' */ 
6754     case '*': 
6755         set1->val.num *= set2->val.num; 
6756         break; 
6757  
6758     /* 'div' */ 
6759     case 'd': 
6760         set1->val.num /= set2->val.num; 
6761         break; 
6762  
6763     /* 'mod' */ 
6764     case 'm': 
6765         set1->val.num = ((long long)set1->val.num) % ((long long)set2->val.num); 
6766         break; 
6767  
6768     default: 
6769         LOGINT_RET(set1->ctx); 
6770     } 
6771  
6772     return LY_SUCCESS; 
6773 } 
6774  
6775 /** 
6776  * @brief Evaluate Predicate. Logs directly on error. 
6777  * 
6778  * [9] Predicate ::= '[' Expr ']' 
6779  * 
6780  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
6781  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
6782  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set. 
6783  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
6784  * @param[in] parent_pos_pred Whether parent predicate was a positional one. 
6785  * @return LY_ERR (LY_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when) 
6786  */ 
6787 static LY_ERR 
6788 eval_predicate(const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options, ly_bool parent_pos_pred) 
6789 { 
6790     LY_ERR rc; 
6791     uint16_t orig_exp; 
6792     uint32_t i, orig_pos, orig_size; 
6793     int32_t pred_in_ctx; 
6794     struct lyxp_set set2 = {0}; 
6795     struct lyd_node *orig_parent; 
6796  
6797     /* '[' */ 
6798     LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
6799             lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
6800     ++(*tok_idx); 
6801  
6802     if (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) { 
6803 only_parse: 
6804         rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, 0, set, options | LYXP_SKIP_EXPR); 
6805         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
6806     } else if (set->type == LYXP_SET_NODE_SET) { 
6807         /* we (possibly) need the set sorted, it can affect the result (if the predicate result is a number) */ 
6808         assert(!set_sort(set)); 
6809  
6810         /* empty set, nothing to evaluate */ 
6811         if (!set->used) { 
6812             goto only_parse; 
6813         } 
6814  
6815         orig_exp = *tok_idx; 
6816         orig_pos = 0; 
6817         orig_size = set->used; 
6818         orig_parent = NULL; 
6819         for (i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
6820             set_init(&set2, set); 
6821             set_insert_node(&set2, set->val.nodes[i].node, set->val.nodes[i].pos, set->val.nodes[i].type, 0); 
6822             /* remember the node context position for position() and context size for last(), 
6823              * predicates should always be evaluated with respect to the child axis (since we do 
6824              * not support explicit axes) so we assign positions based on their parents */ 
6825             if (parent_pos_pred && (lyd_parent(set->val.nodes[i].node) != orig_parent)) { 
6826                 orig_parent = lyd_parent(set->val.nodes[i].node); 
6827                 orig_pos = 1; 
6828             } else { 
6829                 ++orig_pos; 
6830             } 
6831  
6832             set2.ctx_pos = orig_pos; 
6833             set2.ctx_size = orig_size; 
6834             *tok_idx = orig_exp; 
6835  
6836             rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, 0, &set2, options); 
6837             if (rc != LY_SUCCESS) { 
6838                 lyxp_set_free_content(&set2); 
6839                 return rc; 
6840             } 
6841  
6842             /* number is a position */ 
6843             if (set2.type == LYXP_SET_NUMBER) { 
6844                 if ((long long)set2.val.num == orig_pos) { 
6845                     set2.val.num = 1; 
6846                 } else { 
6847                     set2.val.num = 0; 
6848                 } 
6849             } 
6850             lyxp_set_cast(&set2, LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN); 
6851  
6852             /* predicate satisfied or not? */ 
6853             if (!set2.val.bln) { 
6854                 set_remove_node_none(set, i); 
6855             } 
6856         } 
6857         set_remove_nodes_none(set); 
6858  
6859     } else if (set->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) { 
6860         for (i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
6861             if (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_CTX) { 
6862                 /* there is a currently-valid node */ 
6863                 break; 
6864             } 
6865         } 
6866         /* empty set, nothing to evaluate */ 
6867         if (i == set->used) { 
6868             goto only_parse; 
6869         } 
6870  
6871         orig_exp = *tok_idx; 
6872  
6873         /* set special in_ctx to all the valid snodes */ 
6874         pred_in_ctx = set_scnode_new_in_ctx(set); 
6875  
6876         /* use the valid snodes one-by-one */ 
6877         for (i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
6878             if (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx != pred_in_ctx) { 
6879                 continue; 
6880             } 
6881             set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_CTX; 
6882  
6883             *tok_idx = orig_exp; 
6884  
6885             rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, 0, set, options); 
6886             LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
6887  
6888             set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx = pred_in_ctx; 
6889         } 
6890  
6891         /* restore the state as it was before the predicate */ 
6892         for (i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
6893             if (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_CTX) { 
6894                 set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE; 
6895             } else if (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx == pred_in_ctx) { 
6896                 set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx = LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_CTX; 
6897             } 
6898         } 
6899  
6900     } else { 
6901         set2.type = LYXP_SET_NODE_SET; 
6902         set_fill_set(&set2, set); 
6903  
6904         rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, 0, &set2, options); 
6905         if (rc != LY_SUCCESS) { 
6906             lyxp_set_free_content(&set2); 
6907             return rc; 
6908         } 
6909  
6910         lyxp_set_cast(&set2, LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN); 
6911         if (!set2.val.bln) { 
6912             lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
6913         } 
6914         lyxp_set_free_content(&set2); 
6915     } 
6916  
6917     /* ']' */ 
6918     assert(exp->tokens[*tok_idx] == LYXP_TOKEN_BRACK2); 
6919     LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
6920             lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
6921     ++(*tok_idx); 
6922  
6923     return LY_SUCCESS; 
6924 } 
6925  
6926 /** 
6927  * @brief Evaluate Literal. Logs directly on error. 
6928  * 
6929  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
6930  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
6931  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set. On NULL the rule is only parsed. 
6932  */ 
6933 static void 
6934 eval_literal(const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, struct lyxp_set *set) 
6935 { 
6936     if (set) { 
6937         if (exp->tok_len[*tok_idx] == 2) { 
6938             set_fill_string(set, "", 0); 
6939         } else { 
6940             set_fill_string(set, &exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx] + 1], exp->tok_len[*tok_idx] - 2); 
6941         } 
6942     } 
6943     LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (set ? "parsed" : "skipped"), 
6944             lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
6945     ++(*tok_idx); 
6946 } 
6947  
6948 /** 
6949  * @brief Try to compile list or leaf-list predicate in the known format to be used for hash-based instance search. 
6950  * 
6951  * @param[in] exp Full parsed XPath expression. 
6952  * @param[in,out] tok_idx Index in @p exp at the beginning of the predicate, is updated on success. 
6953  * @param[in] ctx_node Found schema node as the context for the predicate. 
6954  * @param[in] cur_mod Current module for the expression. 
6955  * @param[in] cur_node Current (original context) node. 
6956  * @param[in] format Format of any prefixes in key names/values. 
6957  * @param[in] prefix_data Format-specific prefix data (see ::ly_resolve_prefix). 
6958  * @param[out] predicates Parsed predicates. 
6959  * @param[out] pred_type Type of @p predicates. 
6960  * @return LY_SUCCESS on success, 
6961  * @return LY_ERR on any error. 
6962  */ 
6963 static LY_ERR 
6964 eval_name_test_try_compile_predicates(const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, const struct lysc_node *ctx_node, 
6965         const struct lys_module *cur_mod, const struct lysc_node *cur_node, LY_VALUE_FORMAT format, void *prefix_data, 
6966         struct ly_path_predicate **predicates, enum ly_path_pred_type *pred_type) 
6967 { 
6968     LY_ERR ret = LY_SUCCESS; 
6969     uint16_t key_count, e_idx, pred_idx = 0; 
6970     const struct lysc_node *key; 
6971     size_t pred_len; 
6972     uint32_t prev_lo; 
6973     struct lyxp_expr *exp2 = NULL; 
6974  
6975     assert(ctx_node->nodetype & (LYS_LIST | LYS_LEAFLIST)); 
6976  
6977     if (ctx_node->nodetype == LYS_LIST) { 
6978         /* get key count */ 
6979         if (ctx_node->flags & LYS_KEYLESS) { 
6980             return LY_EINVAL; 
6981         } 
6982         for (key_count = 0, key = lysc_node_child(ctx_node); key && (key->flags & LYS_KEY); key = key->next, ++key_count) {} 
6983         assert(key_count); 
6984  
6985         /* learn where the predicates end */ 
6986         e_idx = *tok_idx; 
6987         while (key_count) { 
6988             /* '[' */ 
6989             if (lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, e_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_BRACK1)) { 
6990                 return LY_EINVAL; 
6991             } 
6992             ++e_idx; 
6993  
6994             if (lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, e_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_NAMETEST)) { 
6995                 /* definitely not a key */ 
6996                 return LY_EINVAL; 
6997             } 
6998  
6999             /* ']' */ 
7000             while (lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, e_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_BRACK2)) { 
7001                 ++e_idx; 
7002             } 
7003             ++e_idx; 
7004  
7005             /* another presumably key predicate parsed */ 
7006             --key_count; 
7007         } 
7008     } else { 
7009         /* learn just where this single predicate ends */ 
7010         e_idx = *tok_idx; 
7011  
7012         /* '[' */ 
7013         if (lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, e_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_BRACK1)) { 
7014             return LY_EINVAL; 
7015         } 
7016         ++e_idx; 
7017  
7018         if (lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, e_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_DOT)) { 
7019             /* definitely not the value */ 
7020             return LY_EINVAL; 
7021         } 
7022  
7023         /* ']' */ 
7024         while (lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, e_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_BRACK2)) { 
7025             ++e_idx; 
7026         } 
7027         ++e_idx; 
7028     } 
7029  
7030     /* get the joined length of all the keys predicates/of the single leaf-list predicate */ 
7031     pred_len = (exp->tok_pos[e_idx - 1] + exp->tok_len[e_idx - 1]) - exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]; 
7032  
7033     /* turn logging off */ 
7034     prev_lo = ly_log_options(0); 
7035  
7036     /* parse the predicate(s) */ 
7037     LY_CHECK_GOTO(ret = ly_path_parse_predicate(ctx_node->module->ctx, ctx_node, exp->expr + exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx], 
7038             pred_len, LY_PATH_PREFIX_OPTIONAL, LY_PATH_PRED_SIMPLE, &exp2), cleanup); 
7039  
7040     /* compile */ 
7041     ret = ly_path_compile_predicate(ctx_node->module->ctx, cur_node, cur_mod, ctx_node, exp2, &pred_idx, format, 
7042             prefix_data, predicates, pred_type); 
7043     LY_CHECK_GOTO(ret, cleanup); 
7044  
7045     /* success, the predicate must include all the needed information for hash-based search */ 
7046     *tok_idx = e_idx; 
7047  
7048 cleanup: 
7049     ly_log_options(prev_lo); 
7050     lyxp_expr_free(ctx_node->module->ctx, exp2); 
7051     return ret; 
7052 } 
7053  
7054 /** 
7055  * @brief Search for/check the next schema node that could be the only matching schema node meaning the 
7056  * data node(s) could be found using a single hash-based search. 
7057  * 
7058  * @param[in] ctx libyang context. 
7059  * @param[in] node Next context node to check. 
7060  * @param[in] name Expected node name. 
7061  * @param[in] name_len Length of @p name. 
7062  * @param[in] moveto_mod Expected node module, can be NULL for JSON format with no prefix. 
7063  * @param[in] root_type XPath root type. 
7064  * @param[in] format Prefix format. 
7065  * @param[in,out] found Previously found node, is updated. 
7066  * @return LY_SUCCESS on success, 
7067  * @return LY_ENOT if the whole check failed and hashes cannot be used. 
7068  */ 
7069 static LY_ERR 
7070 eval_name_test_with_predicate_get_scnode(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, const struct lyd_node *node, const char *name, 
7071         uint16_t name_len, const struct lys_module *moveto_mod, enum lyxp_node_type root_type, LY_VALUE_FORMAT format, 
7072         const struct lysc_node **found) 
7073 { 
7074     const struct lysc_node *scnode; 
7075     const struct lys_module *mod; 
7076     uint32_t idx = 0; 
7077  
7078     assert((format == LY_VALUE_JSON) || moveto_mod); 
7079  
7080 continue_search: 
7081     scnode = NULL; 
7082     if (!node) { 
7083         if ((format == LY_VALUE_JSON) && !moveto_mod) { 
7084             /* search all modules for a single match */ 
7085             while ((mod = ly_ctx_get_module_iter(ctx, &idx))) { 
7086                 if (!mod->implemented) { 
7087                     continue; 
7088                 } 
7089  
7090                 scnode = lys_find_child(NULL, mod, name, name_len, 0, 0); 
7091                 if (scnode) { 
7092                     /* we have found a match */ 
7093                     break; 
7094                 } 
7095             } 
7096  
7097             if (!scnode) { 
7098                 /* all modules searched */ 
7099                 idx = 0; 
7100             } 
7101         } else { 
7102             /* search in top-level */ 
7103             scnode = lys_find_child(NULL, moveto_mod, name, name_len, 0, 0); 
7104         } 
7105     } else if (!*found || (lysc_data_parent(*found) != node->schema)) { 
7106         if ((format == LY_VALUE_JSON) && !moveto_mod) { 
7107             /* we must adjust the module to inherit the one from the context node */ 
7108             moveto_mod = node->schema->module; 
7109         } 
7110  
7111         /* search in children, do not repeat the same search */ 
7112         scnode = lys_find_child(node->schema, moveto_mod, name, name_len, 0, 0); 
7113     } /* else skip redundant search */ 
7114  
7115     /* additional context check */ 
7116     if (scnode && (root_type == LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG) && (scnode->flags & LYS_CONFIG_R)) { 
7117         scnode = NULL; 
7118     } 
7119  
7120     if (scnode) { 
7121         if (*found) { 
7122             /* we found a schema node with the same name but at different level, give up, too complicated 
7123              * (more hash-based searches would be required, not supported) */ 
7124             return LY_ENOT; 
7125         } else { 
7126             /* remember the found schema node and continue to make sure it can be used */ 
7127             *found = scnode; 
7128         } 
7129     } 
7130  
7131     if (idx) { 
7132         /* continue searching all the following models */ 
7133         goto continue_search; 
7134     } 
7135  
7136     return LY_SUCCESS; 
7137 } 
7138  
7139 /** 
7140  * @brief Generate message when no matching schema nodes were found for a path segment. 
7141  * 
7142  * @param[in] set XPath set. 
7143  * @param[in] scparent Previous schema parent in the context, if only one. 
7144  * @param[in] ncname XPath NCName being evaluated. 
7145  * @param[in] ncname_len Length of @p ncname. 
7146  * @param[in] expr Whole XPath expression. 
7147  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
7148  */ 
7149 static void 
7150 eval_name_test_scnode_no_match_msg(struct lyxp_set *set, const struct lyxp_set_scnode *scparent, const char *ncname, 
7151         uint16_t ncname_len, const char *expr, uint32_t options) 
7152 { 
7153     const char *format; 
7154     char *path = NULL, *ppath = NULL; 
7155  
7156     path = lysc_path(set->cur_scnode, LYSC_PATH_LOG, NULL, 0); 
7157     if (scparent) { 
7158         /* generate path for the parent */ 
7159         if (scparent->type == LYXP_NODE_ELEM) { 
7160             ppath = lysc_path(scparent->scnode, LYSC_PATH_LOG, NULL, 0); 
7161         } else if (scparent->type == LYXP_NODE_ROOT) { 
7162             ppath = strdup("<root>"); 
7163         } else if (scparent->type == LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG) { 
7164             ppath = strdup("<config-root>"); 
7165         } 
7166     } 
7167     if (ppath) { 
7168         format = "Schema node \"%.*s\" for parent \"%s\" not found; in expr \"%.*s\" with context node \"%s\"."; 
7169         if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ERROR) { 
7170             LOGERR(set->ctx, LY_EVALID, format, ncname_len, ncname, ppath, (ncname - expr) + ncname_len, expr, path); 
7171         } else { 
7172             LOGWRN(set->ctx, format, ncname_len, ncname, ppath, (ncname - expr) + ncname_len, expr, path); 
7173         } 
7174     } else { 
7175         format = "Schema node \"%.*s\" not found; in expr \"%.*s\" with context node \"%s\"."; 
7176         if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ERROR) { 
7177             LOGERR(set->ctx, LY_EVALID, format, ncname_len, ncname, (ncname - expr) + ncname_len, expr, path); 
7178         } else { 
7179             LOGWRN(set->ctx, format, ncname_len, ncname, (ncname - expr) + ncname_len, expr, path); 
7180         } 
7181     } 
7182     free(path); 
7183     free(ppath); 
7184 } 
7185  
7186 /** 
7187  * @brief Evaluate NameTest and any following Predicates. Logs directly on error. 
7188  * 
7189  * [5] Step ::= '@'? NodeTest Predicate* | '.' | '..' 
7190  * [6] NodeTest ::= NameTest | NodeType '(' ')' 
7191  * [7] NameTest ::= '*' | NCName ':' '*' | QName 
7192  * 
7193  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
7194  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
7195  * @param[in] attr_axis Whether to search attributes or standard nodes. 
7196  * @param[in] all_desc Whether to search all the descendants or children only. 
7197  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set. 
7198  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
7199  * @return LY_ERR (LY_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when, LY_ENOT for not found schema node) 
7200  */ 
7201 static LY_ERR 
7202 eval_name_test_with_predicate(const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, ly_bool attr_axis, ly_bool all_desc, 
7203         struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
7204 { 
7205     LY_ERR rc = LY_SUCCESS, r; 
7206     const char *ncname, *ncname_dict = NULL; 
7207     uint16_t ncname_len; 
7208     const struct lys_module *moveto_mod = NULL; 
7209     const struct lysc_node *scnode = NULL; 
7210     struct ly_path_predicate *predicates = NULL; 
7211     enum ly_path_pred_type pred_type = 0; 
7212     int scnode_skip_pred = 0; 
7213  
7214     LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
7215             lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
7216     ++(*tok_idx); 
7217  
7218     if (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) { 
7219         goto moveto; 
7220     } 
7221  
7222     ncname = &exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx - 1]]; 
7223     ncname_len = exp->tok_len[*tok_idx - 1]; 
7224  
7225     if ((ncname[0] == '*') && (ncname_len == 1)) { 
7226         /* all nodes will match */ 
7227         goto moveto; 
7228     } 
7229  
7230     /* parse (and skip) module name */ 
7231     rc = moveto_resolve_model(&ncname, &ncname_len, set, NULL, &moveto_mod); 
7232     LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
7233  
7234     if (((set->format == LY_VALUE_JSON) || moveto_mod) && !attr_axis && !all_desc && (set->type == LYXP_SET_NODE_SET)) { 
7235         /* find the matching schema node in some parent in the context */ 
7236         for (uint32_t i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
7237             if (eval_name_test_with_predicate_get_scnode(set->ctx, set->val.nodes[i].node, ncname, ncname_len, 
7238                     moveto_mod, set->root_type, set->format, &scnode)) { 
7239                 /* check failed */ 
7240                 scnode = NULL; 
7241                 break; 
7242             } 
7243         } 
7244  
7245         if (scnode && (scnode->nodetype & (LYS_LIST | LYS_LEAFLIST))) { 
7246             /* try to create the predicates */ 
7247             if (eval_name_test_try_compile_predicates(exp, tok_idx, scnode, set->cur_mod, set->cur_node ? 
7248                     set->cur_node->schema : NULL, set->format, set->prefix_data, &predicates, &pred_type)) { 
7249                 /* hashes cannot be used */ 
7250                 scnode = NULL; 
7251             } 
7252         } 
7253     } 
7254  
7255     if (!scnode) { 
7256         /* we are not able to match based on a schema node and not all the modules match ("*"), 
7257          * use dictionary for efficient comparison */ 
7258         LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc = lydict_insert(set->ctx, ncname, ncname_len, &ncname_dict), cleanup); 
7259     } 
7260  
7261 moveto: 
7262     /* move to the attribute(s), data node(s), or schema node(s) */ 
7263     if (attr_axis) { 
7264         if (!(options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) && (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL)) { 
7265             set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE); 
7266         } else { 
7267             if (all_desc) { 
7268                 rc = moveto_attr_alldesc(set, moveto_mod, ncname_dict, options); 
7269             } else { 
7270                 rc = moveto_attr(set, moveto_mod, ncname_dict, options); 
7271             } 
7272             LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
7273         } 
7274     } else { 
7275         if (!(options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) && (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL)) { 
7276             int64_t i; 
7277             const struct lyxp_set_scnode *scparent = NULL; 
7278  
7279             /* remember parent if there is only one, to print in the warning */ 
7280             for (i = 0; i < set->used; ++i) { 
7281                 if (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_CTX) { 
7282                     if (!scparent) { 
7283                         /* remember the context node */ 
7284                         scparent = &set->val.scnodes[i]; 
7285                     } else { 
7286                         /* several context nodes, no reasonable error possible */ 
7287                         scparent = NULL; 
7288                         break; 
7289                     } 
7290                 } 
7291             } 
7292  
7293             if (all_desc) { 
7294                 rc = moveto_scnode_alldesc(set, moveto_mod, ncname_dict, options); 
7295             } else { 
7296                 rc = moveto_scnode(set, moveto_mod, ncname_dict, options); 
7297             } 
7298             LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
7299  
7300             for (i = set->used - 1; i > -1; --i) { 
7301                 if (set->val.scnodes[i].in_ctx > LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE) { 
7302                     break; 
7303                 } 
7304             } 
7305             if (i == -1) { 
7306                 /* generate message */ 
7307                 eval_name_test_scnode_no_match_msg(set, scparent, ncname, ncname_len, exp->expr, options); 
7308  
7309                 if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ERROR) { 
7310                     /* error */ 
7311                     rc = LY_EVALID; 
7312                     goto cleanup; 
7313                 } 
7314  
7315                 /* skip the predicates and the rest of this path to not generate invalid warnings */ 
7316                 rc = LY_ENOT; 
7317                 scnode_skip_pred = 1; 
7318             } 
7319         } else { 
7320             if (all_desc) { 
7321                 rc = moveto_node_alldesc(set, moveto_mod, ncname_dict, options); 
7322             } else { 
7323                 if (scnode) { 
7324                     /* we can find the nodes using hashes */ 
7325                     rc = moveto_node_hash(set, scnode, predicates, options); 
7326                 } else { 
7327                     rc = moveto_node(set, moveto_mod, ncname_dict, options); 
7328                 } 
7329             } 
7330             LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
7331         } 
7332     } 
7333  
7334     if (scnode_skip_pred) { 
7335         /* skip predicates */ 
7336         options |= LYXP_SKIP_EXPR; 
7337     } 
7338  
7339     /* Predicate* */ 
7340     while (!lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_BRACK1)) { 
7341         r = eval_predicate(exp, tok_idx, set, options, 1); 
7342         LY_CHECK_ERR_GOTO(r, rc = r, cleanup); 
7343     } 
7344  
7345 cleanup: 
7346     if (scnode_skip_pred) { 
7347         /* restore options */ 
7348         options &= ~LYXP_SKIP_EXPR; 
7349     } 
7350     if (!(options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR)) { 
7351         lydict_remove(set->ctx, ncname_dict); 
7352         ly_path_predicates_free(set->ctx, pred_type, predicates); 
7353     } 
7354     return rc; 
7355 } 
7356  
7357 /** 
7358  * @brief Evaluate NodeType and any following Predicates. Logs directly on error. 
7359  * 
7360  * [5] Step ::= '@'? NodeTest Predicate* | '.' | '..' 
7361  * [6] NodeTest ::= NameTest | NodeType '(' ')' 
7362  * [8] NodeType ::= 'text' | 'node' 
7363  * 
7364  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
7365  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
7366  * @param[in] attr_axis Whether to search attributes or standard nodes. 
7367  * @param[in] all_desc Whether to search all the descendants or children only. 
7368  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set. 
7369  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
7370  * @return LY_ERR (LY_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when) 
7371  */ 
7372 static LY_ERR 
7373 eval_node_type_with_predicate(const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, ly_bool attr_axis, ly_bool all_desc, 
7374         struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
7375 { 
7376     LY_ERR rc; 
7377  
7378     /* TODO */ 
7379     (void)attr_axis; 
7380     (void)all_desc; 
7381  
7382     if (!(options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR)) { 
7383         assert(exp->tok_len[*tok_idx] == 4); 
7384         if (set->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) { 
7385             set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE); 
7386             options |= LYXP_SKIP_EXPR; 
7387         } else { 
7388             if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "node", 4)) { 
7389                 rc = xpath_node(NULL, 0, set, options); 
7390             } else { 
7391                 assert(!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "text", 4)); 
7392                 rc = xpath_text(NULL, 0, set, options); 
7393             } 
7394             LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
7395         } 
7396     } 
7397     LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
7398             lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
7399     ++(*tok_idx); 
7400  
7401     /* '(' */ 
7402     assert(exp->tokens[*tok_idx] == LYXP_TOKEN_PAR1); 
7403     LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
7404             lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
7405     ++(*tok_idx); 
7406  
7407     /* ')' */ 
7408     assert(exp->tokens[*tok_idx] == LYXP_TOKEN_PAR2); 
7409     LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
7410             lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
7411     ++(*tok_idx); 
7412  
7413     /* Predicate* */ 
7414     while (!lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_BRACK1)) { 
7415         rc = eval_predicate(exp, tok_idx, set, options, 1); 
7416         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
7417     } 
7418  
7419     return LY_SUCCESS; 
7420 } 
7421  
7422 /** 
7423  * @brief Evaluate RelativeLocationPath. Logs directly on error. 
7424  * 
7425  * [4] RelativeLocationPath ::= Step | RelativeLocationPath '/' Step | RelativeLocationPath '//' Step 
7426  * [5] Step ::= '@'? NodeTest Predicate* | '.' | '..' 
7427  * [6] NodeTest ::= NameTest | NodeType '(' ')' 
7428  * 
7429  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
7430  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
7431  * @param[in] all_desc Whether to search all the descendants or children only. 
7432  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set. 
7433  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
7434  * @return LY_ERR (YL_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when) 
7435  */ 
7436 static LY_ERR 
7437 eval_relative_location_path(const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, ly_bool all_desc, struct lyxp_set *set, 
7438         uint32_t options) 
7439 { 
7440     ly_bool attr_axis; 
7441     LY_ERR rc = LY_SUCCESS; 
7442     int scnode_skip_path = 0; 
7443  
7444     goto step; 
7445     do { 
7446         /* evaluate '/' or '//' */ 
7447         if (exp->tok_len[*tok_idx] == 1) { 
7448             all_desc = 0; 
7449         } else { 
7450             assert(exp->tok_len[*tok_idx] == 2); 
7451             all_desc = 1; 
7452         } 
7453         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
7454                 lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
7455         ++(*tok_idx); 
7456  
7457 step: 
7458         /* evaluate abbreviated axis '@'? if any */ 
7459         if (exp->tokens[*tok_idx] == LYXP_TOKEN_AT) { 
7460             attr_axis = 1; 
7461  
7462             LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
7463                     lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
7464             ++(*tok_idx); 
7465         } else { 
7466             attr_axis = 0; 
7467         } 
7468  
7469         /* Step */ 
7470         switch (exp->tokens[*tok_idx]) { 
7471         case LYXP_TOKEN_DOT: 
7472             /* evaluate '.' */ 
7473             if (!(options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) && (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL)) { 
7474                 rc = moveto_scnode_self(set, all_desc, options); 
7475             } else { 
7476                 rc = moveto_self(set, all_desc, options); 
7477             } 
7478             LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
7479             LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (set ? "parsed" : "skipped"), 
7480                     lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
7481             ++(*tok_idx); 
7482             break; 
7483  
7484         case LYXP_TOKEN_DDOT: 
7485             /* evaluate '..' */ 
7486             if (!(options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) && (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL)) { 
7487                 rc = moveto_scnode_parent(set, all_desc, options); 
7488             } else { 
7489                 rc = moveto_parent(set, all_desc, options); 
7490             } 
7491             LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
7492             LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
7493                     lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
7494             ++(*tok_idx); 
7495             break; 
7496  
7497         case LYXP_TOKEN_NAMETEST: 
7498             /* evaluate NameTest Predicate* */ 
7499             rc = eval_name_test_with_predicate(exp, tok_idx, attr_axis, all_desc, set, options); 
7500             if (rc == LY_ENOT) { 
7501                 assert(options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL); 
7502                 /* skip the rest of this path */ 
7503                 rc = LY_SUCCESS; 
7504                 scnode_skip_path = 1; 
7505                 options |= LYXP_SKIP_EXPR; 
7506             } 
7507             LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
7508             break; 
7509  
7510         case LYXP_TOKEN_NODETYPE: 
7511             /* evaluate NodeType Predicate* */ 
7512             rc = eval_node_type_with_predicate(exp, tok_idx, attr_axis, all_desc, set, options); 
7513             LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
7514             break; 
7515  
7516         default: 
7517             LOGINT(set->ctx); 
7518             rc = LY_EINT; 
7519             goto cleanup; 
7520         } 
7521     } while (!exp_check_token2(NULL, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_PATH, LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_RPATH)); 
7522  
7523 cleanup: 
7524     if (scnode_skip_path) { 
7525         options &= ~LYXP_SKIP_EXPR; 
7526     } 
7527     return rc; 
7528 } 
7529  
7530 /** 
7531  * @brief Evaluate AbsoluteLocationPath. Logs directly on error. 
7532  * 
7533  * [3] AbsoluteLocationPath ::= '/' RelativeLocationPath? | '//' RelativeLocationPath 
7534  * 
7535  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
7536  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
7537  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set. 
7538  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
7539  * @return LY_ERR (LY_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when) 
7540  */ 
7541 static LY_ERR 
7542 eval_absolute_location_path(const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
7543 { 
7544     ly_bool all_desc; 
7545  
7546     if (!(options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR)) { 
7547         /* no matter what tokens follow, we need to be at the root */ 
7548         LY_CHECK_RET(moveto_root(set, options)); 
7549     } 
7550  
7551     /* '/' RelativeLocationPath? */ 
7552     if (exp->tok_len[*tok_idx] == 1) { 
7553         /* evaluate '/' - deferred */ 
7554         all_desc = 0; 
7555         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
7556                 lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
7557         ++(*tok_idx); 
7558  
7559         if (lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_NONE)) { 
7560             return LY_SUCCESS; 
7561         } 
7562         switch (exp->tokens[*tok_idx]) { 
7563         case LYXP_TOKEN_DOT: 
7564         case LYXP_TOKEN_DDOT: 
7565         case LYXP_TOKEN_AT: 
7566         case LYXP_TOKEN_NAMETEST: 
7567         case LYXP_TOKEN_NODETYPE: 
7568             LY_CHECK_RET(eval_relative_location_path(exp, tok_idx, all_desc, set, options)); 
7569             break; 
7570         default: 
7571             break; 
7572         } 
7573  
7574     } else { 
7575         /* '//' RelativeLocationPath */ 
7576         /* evaluate '//' - deferred so as not to waste memory by remembering all the nodes */ 
7577         all_desc = 1; 
7578         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
7579                 lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
7580         ++(*tok_idx); 
7581  
7582         LY_CHECK_RET(eval_relative_location_path(exp, tok_idx, all_desc, set, options)); 
7583     } 
7584  
7585     return LY_SUCCESS; 
7586 } 
7587  
7588 /** 
7589  * @brief Evaluate FunctionCall. Logs directly on error. 
7590  * 
7591  * [11] FunctionCall ::= FunctionName '(' ( Expr ( ',' Expr )* )? ')' 
7592  * 
7593  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
7594  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
7595  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set. 
7596  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
7597  * @return LY_ERR (LY_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when) 
7598  */ 
7599 static LY_ERR 
7600 eval_function_call(const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
7601 { 
7602     LY_ERR rc; 
7603  
7604     LY_ERR (*xpath_func)(struct lyxp_set **, uint16_t, struct lyxp_set *, uint32_t) = NULL; 
7605     uint16_t arg_count = 0, i; 
7606     struct lyxp_set **args = NULL, **args_aux; 
7607  
7608     if (!(options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR)) { 
7609         /* FunctionName */ 
7610         switch (exp->tok_len[*tok_idx]) { 
7611         case 3: 
7612             if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "not", 3)) { 
7613                 xpath_func = &xpath_not; 
7614             } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "sum", 3)) { 
7615                 xpath_func = &xpath_sum; 
7616             } 
7617             break; 
7618         case 4: 
7619             if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "lang", 4)) { 
7620                 xpath_func = &xpath_lang; 
7621             } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "last", 4)) { 
7622                 xpath_func = &xpath_last; 
7623             } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "name", 4)) { 
7624                 xpath_func = &xpath_name; 
7625             } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "true", 4)) { 
7626                 xpath_func = &xpath_true; 
7627             } 
7628             break; 
7629         case 5: 
7630             if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "count", 5)) { 
7631                 xpath_func = &xpath_count; 
7632             } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "false", 5)) { 
7633                 xpath_func = &xpath_false; 
7634             } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "floor", 5)) { 
7635                 xpath_func = &xpath_floor; 
7636             } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "round", 5)) { 
7637                 xpath_func = &xpath_round; 
7638             } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "deref", 5)) { 
7639                 xpath_func = &xpath_deref; 
7640             } 
7641             break; 
7642         case 6: 
7643             if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "concat", 6)) { 
7644                 xpath_func = &xpath_concat; 
7645             } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "number", 6)) { 
7646                 xpath_func = &xpath_number; 
7647             } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "string", 6)) { 
7648                 xpath_func = &xpath_string; 
7649             } 
7650             break; 
7651         case 7: 
7652             if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "boolean", 7)) { 
7653                 xpath_func = &xpath_boolean; 
7654             } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "ceiling", 7)) { 
7655                 xpath_func = &xpath_ceiling; 
7656             } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "current", 7)) { 
7657                 xpath_func = &xpath_current; 
7658             } 
7659             break; 
7660         case 8: 
7661             if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "contains", 8)) { 
7662                 xpath_func = &xpath_contains; 
7663             } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "position", 8)) { 
7664                 xpath_func = &xpath_position; 
7665             } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "re-match", 8)) { 
7666                 xpath_func = &xpath_re_match; 
7667             } 
7668             break; 
7669         case 9: 
7670             if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "substring", 9)) { 
7671                 xpath_func = &xpath_substring; 
7672             } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "translate", 9)) { 
7673                 xpath_func = &xpath_translate; 
7674             } 
7675             break; 
7676         case 10: 
7677             if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "local-name", 10)) { 
7678                 xpath_func = &xpath_local_name; 
7679             } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "enum-value", 10)) { 
7680                 xpath_func = &xpath_enum_value; 
7681             } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "bit-is-set", 10)) { 
7682                 xpath_func = &xpath_bit_is_set; 
7683             } 
7684             break; 
7685         case 11: 
7686             if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "starts-with", 11)) { 
7687                 xpath_func = &xpath_starts_with; 
7688             } 
7689             break; 
7690         case 12: 
7691             if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "derived-from", 12)) { 
7692                 xpath_func = &xpath_derived_from; 
7693             } 
7694             break; 
7695         case 13: 
7696             if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "namespace-uri", 13)) { 
7697                 xpath_func = &xpath_namespace_uri; 
7698             } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "string-length", 13)) { 
7699                 xpath_func = &xpath_string_length; 
7700             } 
7701             break; 
7702         case 15: 
7703             if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "normalize-space", 15)) { 
7704                 xpath_func = &xpath_normalize_space; 
7705             } else if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "substring-after", 15)) { 
7706                 xpath_func = &xpath_substring_after; 
7707             } 
7708             break; 
7709         case 16: 
7710             if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "substring-before", 16)) { 
7711                 xpath_func = &xpath_substring_before; 
7712             } 
7713             break; 
7714         case 20: 
7715             if (!strncmp(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], "derived-from-or-self", 20)) { 
7716                 xpath_func = &xpath_derived_from_or_self; 
7717             } 
7718             break; 
7719         } 
7720  
7721         if (!xpath_func) { 
7722             LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INFUNC, exp->tok_len[*tok_idx], &exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]]); 
7723             return LY_EVALID; 
7724         } 
7725     } 
7726  
7727     LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
7728             lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
7729     ++(*tok_idx); 
7730  
7731     /* '(' */ 
7732     assert(exp->tokens[*tok_idx] == LYXP_TOKEN_PAR1); 
7733     LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
7734             lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
7735     ++(*tok_idx); 
7736  
7737     /* ( Expr ( ',' Expr )* )? */ 
7738     if (exp->tokens[*tok_idx] != LYXP_TOKEN_PAR2) { 
7739         if (!(options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR)) { 
7740             args = malloc(sizeof *args); 
7741             LY_CHECK_ERR_GOTO(!args, LOGMEM(set->ctx); rc = LY_EMEM, cleanup); 
7742             arg_count = 1; 
7743             args[0] = set_copy(set); 
7744             if (!args[0]) { 
7745                 rc = LY_EMEM; 
7746                 goto cleanup; 
7747             } 
7748  
7749             rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, 0, args[0], options); 
7750             LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
7751         } else { 
7752             rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, 0, set, options | LYXP_SKIP_EXPR); 
7753             LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
7754         } 
7755     } 
7756     while (!lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_COMMA)) { 
7757         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
7758                 lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
7759         ++(*tok_idx); 
7760  
7761         if (!(options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR)) { 
7762             ++arg_count; 
7763             args_aux = realloc(args, arg_count * sizeof *args); 
7764             LY_CHECK_ERR_GOTO(!args_aux, arg_count--; LOGMEM(set->ctx); rc = LY_EMEM, cleanup); 
7765             args = args_aux; 
7766             args[arg_count - 1] = set_copy(set); 
7767             if (!args[arg_count - 1]) { 
7768                 rc = LY_EMEM; 
7769                 goto cleanup; 
7770             } 
7771  
7772             rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, 0, args[arg_count - 1], options); 
7773             LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
7774         } else { 
7775             rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, 0, set, options | LYXP_SKIP_EXPR); 
7776             LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
7777         } 
7778     } 
7779  
7780     /* ')' */ 
7781     assert(exp->tokens[*tok_idx] == LYXP_TOKEN_PAR2); 
7782     LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
7783             lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
7784     ++(*tok_idx); 
7785  
7786     if (!(options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR)) { 
7787         /* evaluate function */ 
7788         rc = xpath_func(args, arg_count, set, options); 
7789  
7790         if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
7791             /* merge all nodes from arg evaluations */ 
7792             for (i = 0; i < arg_count; ++i) { 
7793                 set_scnode_clear_ctx(args[i], LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE); 
7794                 lyxp_set_scnode_merge(set, args[i]); 
7795             } 
7796         } 
7797     } else { 
7798         rc = LY_SUCCESS; 
7799     } 
7800  
7801 cleanup: 
7802     for (i = 0; i < arg_count; ++i) { 
7803         lyxp_set_free(args[i]); 
7804     } 
7805     free(args); 
7806     return rc; 
7807 } 
7808  
7809 /** 
7810  * @brief Evaluate Number. Logs directly on error. 
7811  * 
7812  * @param[in] ctx Context for errors. 
7813  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
7814  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
7815  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set. On NULL the rule is only parsed. 
7816  * @return LY_ERR 
7817  */ 
7818 static LY_ERR 
7819 eval_number(struct ly_ctx *ctx, const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, struct lyxp_set *set) 
7820 { 
7821     long double num; 
7822     char *endptr; 
7823  
7824     if (set) { 
7825         errno = 0; 
7826         num = strtold(&exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], &endptr); 
7827         if (errno) { 
7828             LOGVAL(ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INTOK, "Unknown", &exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]]); 
7829             LOGVAL(ctx, LYVE_XPATH, "Failed to convert \"%.*s\" into a long double (%s).", 
7830                     exp->tok_len[*tok_idx], &exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]], strerror(errno)); 
7831             return LY_EVALID; 
7832         } else if (endptr - &exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]] != exp->tok_len[*tok_idx]) { 
7833             LOGVAL(ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INTOK, "Unknown", &exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]]); 
7834             LOGVAL(ctx, LYVE_XPATH, "Failed to convert \"%.*s\" into a long double.", 
7835                     exp->tok_len[*tok_idx], &exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]]); 
7836             return LY_EVALID; 
7837         } 
7838  
7839         set_fill_number(set, num); 
7840     } 
7841  
7842     LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (set ? "parsed" : "skipped"), 
7843             lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
7844     ++(*tok_idx); 
7845     return LY_SUCCESS; 
7846 } 
7847  
7848 LY_ERR 
7849 lyxp_vars_find(struct lyxp_var *vars, const char *name, size_t name_len, struct lyxp_var **var) 
7850 { 
7851     LY_ERR ret = LY_ENOTFOUND; 
7852     LY_ARRAY_COUNT_TYPE u; 
7853  
7854     assert(vars && name); 
7855  
7856     name_len = name_len ? name_len : strlen(name); 
7857  
7858     LY_ARRAY_FOR(vars, u) { 
7859         if (!strncmp(vars[u].name, name, name_len)) { 
7860             ret = LY_SUCCESS; 
7861             break; 
7862         } 
7863     } 
7864  
7865     if (var && !ret) { 
7866         *var = &vars[u]; 
7867     } 
7868  
7869     return ret; 
7870 } 
7871  
7872 /** 
7873  * @brief Evaluate VariableReference. 
7874  * 
7875  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
7876  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
7877  * @param[in] vars [Sized array](@ref sizedarrays) of XPath variables. 
7878  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set. 
7879  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
7880  * @return LY_ERR value. 
7881  */ 
7882 static LY_ERR 
7883 eval_variable_reference(const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
7884 { 
7885     LY_ERR ret; 
7886     const char *name; 
7887     struct lyxp_var *var; 
7888     const struct lyxp_var *vars; 
7889     struct lyxp_expr *tokens = NULL; 
7890     uint16_t token_index; 
7891  
7892     vars = set->vars; 
7893  
7894     /* Find out the name and value of the variable. */ 
7895     name = &exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]]; 
7896     ret = lyxp_vars_find((struct lyxp_var *)vars, name, exp->tok_len[*tok_idx], &var); 
7897     LY_CHECK_ERR_RET(ret, LOGERR(set->ctx, ret, 
7898             "XPath variable \"%s\" not defined.", name), ret); 
7899  
7900     /* Parse value. */ 
7901     ret = lyxp_expr_parse(set->ctx, var->value, 0, 1, &tokens); 
7902     LY_CHECK_GOTO(ret, cleanup); 
7903  
7904     /* Evaluate value. */ 
7905     token_index = 0; 
7906     ret = eval_expr_select(tokens, &token_index, 0, set, options); 
7907     LY_CHECK_GOTO(ret, cleanup); 
7908  
7909 cleanup: 
7910     lyxp_expr_free(set->ctx, tokens); 
7911  
7912     return ret; 
7913 } 
7914  
7915 /** 
7916  * @brief Evaluate PathExpr. Logs directly on error. 
7917  * 
7918  * [12] PathExpr ::= LocationPath | PrimaryExpr Predicate* 
7919  *                 | PrimaryExpr Predicate* '/' RelativeLocationPath 
7920  *                 | PrimaryExpr Predicate* '//' RelativeLocationPath 
7921  * [2] LocationPath ::= RelativeLocationPath | AbsoluteLocationPath 
7922  * [10] PrimaryExpr ::= VariableReference | '(' Expr ')' | Literal | Number | FunctionCall 
7923  * 
7924  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
7925  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
7926  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set. 
7927  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
7928  * @return LY_ERR (LY_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when) 
7929  */ 
7930 static LY_ERR 
7931 eval_path_expr(const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
7932 { 
7933     ly_bool all_desc, parent_pos_pred; 
7934     LY_ERR rc; 
7935  
7936     switch (exp->tokens[*tok_idx]) { 
7937     case LYXP_TOKEN_PAR1: 
7938         /* '(' Expr ')' */ 
7939  
7940         /* '(' */ 
7941         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
7942                 lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
7943         ++(*tok_idx); 
7944  
7945         /* Expr */ 
7946         rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, 0, set, options); 
7947         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
7948  
7949         /* ')' */ 
7950         assert(exp->tokens[*tok_idx] == LYXP_TOKEN_PAR2); 
7951         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
7952                 lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
7953         ++(*tok_idx); 
7954  
7955         parent_pos_pred = 0; 
7956         goto predicate; 
7957  
7958     case LYXP_TOKEN_DOT: 
7959     case LYXP_TOKEN_DDOT: 
7960     case LYXP_TOKEN_AT: 
7961     case LYXP_TOKEN_NAMETEST: 
7962     case LYXP_TOKEN_NODETYPE: 
7963         /* RelativeLocationPath */ 
7964         rc = eval_relative_location_path(exp, tok_idx, 0, set, options); 
7965         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
7966         break; 
7967  
7968     case LYXP_TOKEN_VARREF: 
7969         /* VariableReference */ 
7970         rc = eval_variable_reference(exp, tok_idx, set, options); 
7971         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
7972         ++(*tok_idx); 
7973  
7974         parent_pos_pred = 1; 
7975         goto predicate; 
7976  
7977     case LYXP_TOKEN_FUNCNAME: 
7978         /* FunctionCall */ 
7979         rc = eval_function_call(exp, tok_idx, set, options); 
7980         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
7981  
7982         parent_pos_pred = 1; 
7983         goto predicate; 
7984  
7985     case LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_PATH: 
7986     case LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_RPATH: 
7987         /* AbsoluteLocationPath */ 
7988         rc = eval_absolute_location_path(exp, tok_idx, set, options); 
7989         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
7990         break; 
7991  
7992     case LYXP_TOKEN_LITERAL: 
7993         /* Literal */ 
7994         if ((options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) || (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL)) { 
7995             if (!(options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR)) { 
7996                 set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_VAL); 
7997             } 
7998             eval_literal(exp, tok_idx, NULL); 
7999         } else { 
8000             eval_literal(exp, tok_idx, set); 
8001         } 
8002  
8003         parent_pos_pred = 1; 
8004         goto predicate; 
8005  
8006     case LYXP_TOKEN_NUMBER: 
8007         /* Number */ 
8008         if ((options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) || (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL)) { 
8009             if (!(options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR)) { 
8010                 set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_VAL); 
8011             } 
8012             rc = eval_number(NULL, exp, tok_idx, NULL); 
8013         } else { 
8014             rc = eval_number(set->ctx, exp, tok_idx, set); 
8015         } 
8016         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
8017  
8018         parent_pos_pred = 1; 
8019         goto predicate; 
8020  
8021     default: 
8022         LOGVAL(set->ctx, LY_VCODE_XP_INTOK, lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), &exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]]); 
8023         return LY_EVALID; 
8024     } 
8025  
8026     return LY_SUCCESS; 
8027  
8028 predicate: 
8029     /* Predicate* */ 
8030     while (!lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_BRACK1)) { 
8031         rc = eval_predicate(exp, tok_idx, set, options, parent_pos_pred); 
8032         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
8033     } 
8034  
8035     /* ('/' or '//') RelativeLocationPath */ 
8036     if (!exp_check_token2(NULL, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_PATH, LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_RPATH)) { 
8037  
8038         /* evaluate '/' or '//' */ 
8039         if (exp->tokens[*tok_idx] == LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_PATH) { 
8040             all_desc = 0; 
8041         } else { 
8042             all_desc = 1; 
8043         } 
8044  
8045         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
8046                 lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
8047         ++(*tok_idx); 
8048  
8049         rc = eval_relative_location_path(exp, tok_idx, all_desc, set, options); 
8050         LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
8051     } 
8052  
8053     return LY_SUCCESS; 
8054 } 
8055  
8056 /** 
8057  * @brief Evaluate UnionExpr. Logs directly on error. 
8058  * 
8059  * [20] UnionExpr ::= PathExpr | UnionExpr '|' PathExpr 
8060  * 
8061  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
8062  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
8063  * @param[in] repeat How many times this expression is repeated. 
8064  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set. 
8065  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
8066  * @return LY_ERR (LY_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when) 
8067  */ 
8068 static LY_ERR 
8069 eval_union_expr(const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, uint16_t repeat, struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
8070 { 
8071     LY_ERR rc = LY_SUCCESS; 
8072     struct lyxp_set orig_set, set2; 
8073     uint16_t i; 
8074  
8075     assert(repeat); 
8076  
8077     set_init(&orig_set, set); 
8078     set_init(&set2, set); 
8079  
8080     set_fill_set(&orig_set, set); 
8081  
8082     rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, LYXP_EXPR_UNION, set, options); 
8083     LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
8084  
8085     /* ('|' PathExpr)* */ 
8086     for (i = 0; i < repeat; ++i) { 
8087         assert(exp->tokens[*tok_idx] == LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_UNI); 
8088         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
8089                 lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
8090         ++(*tok_idx); 
8091  
8092         if (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) { 
8093             rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, LYXP_EXPR_UNION, set, options); 
8094             LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
8095             continue; 
8096         } 
8097  
8098         set_fill_set(&set2, &orig_set); 
8099         rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, LYXP_EXPR_UNION, &set2, options); 
8100         LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
8101  
8102         /* eval */ 
8103         if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
8104             lyxp_set_scnode_merge(set, &set2); 
8105         } else { 
8106             rc = moveto_union(set, &set2); 
8107             LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
8108         } 
8109     } 
8110  
8111 cleanup: 
8112     lyxp_set_free_content(&orig_set); 
8113     lyxp_set_free_content(&set2); 
8114     return rc; 
8115 }

8117 /** 
8118  * @brief Evaluate UnaryExpr. Logs directly on error. 
8119  * 
8120  * [19] UnaryExpr ::= UnionExpr | '-' UnaryExpr 
8121  * 
8122  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
8123  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
8124  * @param[in] repeat How many times this expression is repeated. 
8125  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set. 
8126  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
8127  * @return LY_ERR (LY_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when) 
8128  */ 
8129 static LY_ERR 
8130 eval_unary_expr(const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, uint16_t repeat, struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
8131 { 
8132     LY_ERR rc; 
8133     uint16_t this_op, i; 
8134  
8135     assert(repeat); 
8136  
8137     /* ('-')+ */ 
8138     this_op = *tok_idx; 
8139     for (i = 0; i < repeat; ++i) { 
8140         assert(!lyxp_check_token(NULL, exp, *tok_idx, LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_MATH) && (exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]] == '-')); 
8141  
8142         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
8143                 lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
8144         ++(*tok_idx); 
8145     } 
8146  
8147     rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, LYXP_EXPR_UNARY, set, options); 
8148     LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
8149  
8150     if (!(options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) && (repeat % 2)) { 
8151         if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
8152             warn_operands(set->ctx, set, NULL, 1, exp->expr, exp->tok_pos[this_op]); 
8153         } else { 
8154             rc = moveto_op_math(set, NULL, &exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[this_op]]); 
8155             LY_CHECK_RET(rc); 
8156         } 
8157     } 
8158  
8159     return LY_SUCCESS; 
8160 }

8177 static LY_ERR 
8178 eval_multiplicative_expr(const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, uint16_t repeat, struct lyxp_set *set, 
8179         uint32_t options)

8197     for (i = 0; i < repeat; ++i) { 
8198         this_op = *tok_idx; 
8199

8210  
8211         set_fill_set(&set2, &orig_set);

8223         } 
8224     } 
8225  
8226 cleanup:

8300 /**

8316 static LY_ERR 
8317 eval_relational_expr(const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, uint16_t repeat, struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options)

8370 /** 
8371  * @brief Evaluate EqualityExpr. Logs directly on error. 
8372  * 
8373  * [15] EqualityExpr ::= RelationalExpr | EqualityExpr '=' RelationalExpr 
8374  *                     | EqualityExpr '!=' RelationalExpr 
8375  * 
8376  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
8377  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
8378  * @param[in] repeat How many times this expression is repeated. 
8379  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set. 
8380  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
8381  * @return LY_ERR (LY_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when) 
8382  */ 
8383 static LY_ERR 
8384 eval_equality_expr(const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, uint16_t repeat, struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
8385 { 
8386     LY_ERR rc; 
8387     uint16_t this_op; 
8388     struct lyxp_set orig_set, set2; 
8389     uint16_t i; 
8390  
8391     assert(repeat); 
8392  
8393     set_init(&orig_set, set); 
8394     set_init(&set2, set); 
8395  
8396     set_fill_set(&orig_set, set); 
8397  
8398     rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, LYXP_EXPR_EQUALITY, set, options); 
8399     LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
8400  
8401     /* ('=' / '!=' RelationalExpr)* */ 
8402     for (i = 0; i < repeat; ++i) { 
8403         this_op = *tok_idx; 
8404  
8405         assert((exp->tokens[*tok_idx] == LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_EQUAL) || (exp->tokens[*tok_idx] == LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_NEQUAL)); 
8406         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
8407                 lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
8408         ++(*tok_idx); 
8409  
8410         if (options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) { 
8411             rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, LYXP_EXPR_EQUALITY, set, options); 
8412             LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
8413             continue; 
8414         } 
8415  
8416         set_fill_set(&set2, &orig_set); 
8417         rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, LYXP_EXPR_EQUALITY, &set2, options); 
8418         LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
8419  
8420         /* eval */ 
8421         if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
8422             warn_operands(set->ctx, set, &set2, 0, exp->expr, exp->tok_pos[this_op - 1]); 
8423             warn_equality_value(exp, set, *tok_idx - 1, this_op - 1, *tok_idx - 1); 
8424             warn_equality_value(exp, &set2, this_op - 1, this_op - 1, *tok_idx - 1); 
8425             lyxp_set_scnode_merge(set, &set2); 
8426             set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_VAL); 
8427         } else { 
8428             rc = moveto_op_comp(set, &set2, &exp->expr[exp->tok_pos[this_op]], options); 
8429             LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
8430         } 
8431     } 
8432  
8433 cleanup: 
8434     lyxp_set_free_content(&orig_set); 
8435     lyxp_set_free_content(&set2); 
8436     return rc; 
8437 }

8439 /** 
8440  * @brief Evaluate AndExpr. Logs directly on error. 
8441  * 
8442  * [14] AndExpr ::= EqualityExpr | AndExpr 'and' EqualityExpr 
8443  * 
8444  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
8445  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
8446  * @param[in] repeat How many times this expression is repeated. 
8447  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set. 
8448  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
8449  * @return LY_ERR (LY_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when) 
8450  */ 
8451 static LY_ERR 
8452 eval_and_expr(const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, uint16_t repeat, struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
8453 { 
8454     LY_ERR rc; 
8455     struct lyxp_set orig_set, set2; 
8456     uint16_t i; 
8457  
8458     assert(repeat); 
8459  
8460     set_init(&orig_set, set); 
8461     set_init(&set2, set); 
8462  
8463     set_fill_set(&orig_set, set); 
8464  
8465     rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, LYXP_EXPR_AND, set, options); 
8466     LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
8467  
8468     /* cast to boolean, we know that will be the final result */ 
8469     if (!(options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) && (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL)) { 
8470         set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE); 
8471     } else { 
8472         lyxp_set_cast(set, LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN); 
8473     } 
8474  
8475     /* ('and' EqualityExpr)* */ 
8476     for (i = 0; i < repeat; ++i) { 
8477         assert(exp->tokens[*tok_idx] == LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_LOG); 
8478         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, ((options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) || !set->val.bln ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
8479                 lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
8480         ++(*tok_idx); 
8481  
8482         /* lazy evaluation */ 
8483         if ((options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) || ((set->type == LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN) && !set->val.bln)) { 
8484             rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, LYXP_EXPR_AND, set, options | LYXP_SKIP_EXPR); 
8485             LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
8486             continue; 
8487         } 
8488  
8489         set_fill_set(&set2, &orig_set); 
8490         rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, LYXP_EXPR_AND, &set2, options); 
8491         LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
8492  
8493         /* eval - just get boolean value actually */ 
8494         if (set->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) { 
8495             set_scnode_clear_ctx(&set2, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE); 
8496             lyxp_set_scnode_merge(set, &set2); 
8497         } else { 
8498             lyxp_set_cast(&set2, LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN); 
8499             set_fill_set(set, &set2); 
8500         } 
8501     } 
8502  
8503 cleanup: 
8504     lyxp_set_free_content(&orig_set); 
8505     lyxp_set_free_content(&set2); 
8506     return rc; 
8507 } 
8508  
8509 /** 
8510  * @brief Evaluate OrExpr. Logs directly on error. 
8511  * 
8512  * [13] OrExpr ::= AndExpr | OrExpr 'or' AndExpr 
8513  * 
8514  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
8515  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
8516  * @param[in] repeat How many times this expression is repeated. 
8517  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set. 
8518  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
8519  * @return LY_ERR (LY_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when) 
8520  */ 
8521 static LY_ERR 
8522 eval_or_expr(const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, uint16_t repeat, struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
8523 { 
8524     LY_ERR rc; 
8525     struct lyxp_set orig_set, set2; 
8526     uint16_t i; 
8527  
8528     assert(repeat); 
8529  
8530     set_init(&orig_set, set); 
8531     set_init(&set2, set); 
8532  
8533     set_fill_set(&orig_set, set); 
8534  
8535     rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, LYXP_EXPR_OR, set, options); 
8536     LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
8537  
8538     /* cast to boolean, we know that will be the final result */ 
8539     if (!(options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) && (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL)) { 
8540         set_scnode_clear_ctx(set, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE); 
8541     } else { 
8542         lyxp_set_cast(set, LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN); 
8543     } 
8544  
8545     /* ('or' AndExpr)* */ 
8546     for (i = 0; i < repeat; ++i) { 
8547         assert(exp->tokens[*tok_idx] == LYXP_TOKEN_OPER_LOG); 
8548         LOGDBG(LY_LDGXPATH, "%-27s %s %s[%u]", __func__, ((options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) || set->val.bln ? "skipped" : "parsed"), 
8549                 lyxp_print_token(exp->tokens[*tok_idx]), exp->tok_pos[*tok_idx]); 
8550         ++(*tok_idx); 
8551  
8552         /* lazy evaluation */ 
8553         if ((options & LYXP_SKIP_EXPR) || ((set->type == LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN) && set->val.bln)) { 
8554             rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, LYXP_EXPR_OR, set, options | LYXP_SKIP_EXPR); 
8555             LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
8556             continue; 
8557         } 
8558  
8559         set_fill_set(&set2, &orig_set); 
8560         /* expr_type cound have been LYXP_EXPR_NONE in all these later calls (except for the first one), 
8561          * but it does not matter */ 
8562         rc = eval_expr_select(exp, tok_idx, LYXP_EXPR_OR, &set2, options); 
8563         LY_CHECK_GOTO(rc, cleanup); 
8564  
8565         /* eval - just get boolean value actually */ 
8566         if (set->type == LYXP_SET_SCNODE_SET) { 
8567             set_scnode_clear_ctx(&set2, LYXP_SET_SCNODE_ATOM_NODE); 
8568             lyxp_set_scnode_merge(set, &set2); 
8569         } else { 
8570             lyxp_set_cast(&set2, LYXP_SET_BOOLEAN); 
8571             set_fill_set(set, &set2); 
8572         } 
8573     } 
8574  
8575 cleanup: 
8576     lyxp_set_free_content(&orig_set); 
8577     lyxp_set_free_content(&set2); 
8578     return rc; 
8579 } 
8580  
8581 /** 
8582  * @brief Decide what expression is at the pointer @p tok_idx and evaluate it accordingly. 
8583  * 
8584  * @param[in] exp Parsed XPath expression. 
8585  * @param[in] tok_idx Position in the expression @p exp. 
8586  * @param[in] etype Expression type to evaluate. 
8587  * @param[in,out] set Context and result set. 
8588  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
8589  * @return LY_ERR (LY_EINCOMPLETE on unresolved when) 
8590  */ 
8591 static LY_ERR 
8592 eval_expr_select(const struct lyxp_expr *exp, uint16_t *tok_idx, enum lyxp_expr_type etype, struct lyxp_set *set, 
8593         uint32_t options) 
8594 { 
8595     uint16_t i, count; 
8596     enum lyxp_expr_type next_etype; 
8597     LY_ERR rc; 
8598  
8599     /* process operator repeats */ 
8600     if (!exp->repeat[*tok_idx]) { 
8601         next_etype = LYXP_EXPR_NONE; 
8602     } else { 
8603         /* find etype repeat */ 
8604         for (i = 0; exp->repeat[*tok_idx][i] > etype; ++i) {} 
8605  
8606         /* select one-priority lower because etype expression called us */ 
8607         if (i) { 
8608             next_etype = exp->repeat[*tok_idx][i - 1]; 
8609             /* count repeats for that expression */ 
8610             for (count = 0; i && exp->repeat[*tok_idx][i - 1] == next_etype; ++count, --i) {} 
8611         } else { 
8612             next_etype = LYXP_EXPR_NONE; 
8613         } 
8614     } 
8615  
8616     /* decide what expression are we parsing based on the repeat */ 
8617     switch (next_etype) { 
8618     case LYXP_EXPR_OR: 
8619         rc = eval_or_expr(exp, tok_idx, count, set, options); 
8620         break; 
8621     case LYXP_EXPR_AND: 
8622         rc = eval_and_expr(exp, tok_idx, count, set, options); 
8623         break; 
8624     case LYXP_EXPR_EQUALITY: 
8625         rc = eval_equality_expr(exp, tok_idx, count, set, options); 
8626         break; 
8627     case LYXP_EXPR_RELATIONAL: 
8628         rc = eval_relational_expr(exp, tok_idx, count, set, options); 
8629         break; 
8630     case LYXP_EXPR_ADDITIVE: 
8631         rc = eval_additive_expr(exp, tok_idx, count, set, options); 
8632         break; 
8633     case LYXP_EXPR_MULTIPLICATIVE: 
8634         rc = eval_multiplicative_expr(exp, tok_idx, count, set, options); 
8635         break; 
8636     case LYXP_EXPR_UNARY: 
8637         rc = eval_unary_expr(exp, tok_idx, count, set, options); 
8638         break; 
8639     case LYXP_EXPR_UNION: 
8640         rc = eval_union_expr(exp, tok_idx, count, set, options); 
8641         break; 
8642     case LYXP_EXPR_NONE: 
8643         rc = eval_path_expr(exp, tok_idx, set, options); 
8644         break; 
8645     default: 
8646         LOGINT_RET(set->ctx); 
8647     } 
8648  
8649     return rc; 
8650 } 
8651  
8652 /** 
8653  * @brief Get root type. 
8654  * 
8655  * @param[in] ctx_node Context node. 
8656  * @param[in] ctx_scnode Schema context node. 
8657  * @param[in] options XPath options. 
8658  * @return Root type. 
8659  */ 
8660 static enum lyxp_node_type 
8661 lyxp_get_root_type(const struct lyd_node *ctx_node, const struct lysc_node *ctx_scnode, uint32_t options) 
8662 { 
8663     const struct lysc_node *op; 
8664  
8665     if (options & LYXP_SCNODE_ALL) { 
8666         /* schema */ 
8667         for (op = ctx_scnode; op && !(op->nodetype & (LYS_RPC | LYS_ACTION | LYS_NOTIF)); op = op->parent) {} 
8668  
8669         if (op || (options & LYXP_SCNODE)) { 
8670             /* general root that can access everything */ 
8671             return LYXP_NODE_ROOT; 
8672         } else if (!ctx_scnode || (ctx_scnode->flags & LYS_CONFIG_W)) { 
8673             /* root context node can access only config data (because we said so, it is unspecified) */ 
8674             return LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG; 
8675         } 
8676         return LYXP_NODE_ROOT; 
8677     } 
8678  
8679     /* data */ 
8680     op = ctx_node ? ctx_node->schema : NULL; 
8681     for ( ; op && !(op->nodetype & (LYS_RPC | LYS_ACTION | LYS_NOTIF)); op = op->parent) {} 
8682  
8683     if (op || !(options & LYXP_SCHEMA)) { 
8684         /* general root that can access everything */ 
8685         return LYXP_NODE_ROOT; 
8686     } else if (!ctx_node || !ctx_node->schema || (ctx_node->schema->flags & LYS_CONFIG_W)) { 
8687         /* root context node can access only config data (because we said so, it is unspecified) */ 
8688         return LYXP_NODE_ROOT_CONFIG; 
8689     } 
8690     return LYXP_NODE_ROOT; 
8691 } 
8692  
8693 LY_ERR 
8694 lyxp_eval(const struct ly_ctx *ctx, const struct lyxp_expr *exp, const struct lys_module *cur_mod, 
8695         LY_VALUE_FORMAT format, void *prefix_data, const struct lyd_node *ctx_node, const struct lyd_node *tree, 
8696         const struct lyxp_var *vars, struct lyxp_set *set, uint32_t options) 
8697 { 
8698     uint16_t tok_idx = 0; 
8699     LY_ERR rc; 
8700  
8701     LY_CHECK_ARG_RET(ctx, ctx, exp, set, LY_EINVAL); 
8702     if (!cur_mod && ((format == LY_VALUE_SCHEMA) || (format == LY_VALUE_SCHEMA_RESOLVED))) { 
8703         LOGARG(NULL, "Current module must be set if schema format is used."); 
8704         return LY_EINVAL; 
8705     } 
8706  
8707     if (tree) { 
8708         /* adjust the pointer to be the first top-level sibling */ 
8709         while (tree->parent) { 
8710             tree = lyd_parent(tree); 
8711         } 
8712         tree = lyd_first_sibling(tree); 
8713     } 
8714  
8715     /* prepare set for evaluation */ 
8716     memset(set, 0, sizeof *set); 
8717     set->type = LYXP_SET_NODE_SET; 
8718     set->root_type = lyxp_get_root_type(ctx_node, NULL, options); 
8719     set_insert_node(set, (struct lyd_node *)ctx_node, 0, ctx_node ? LYXP_NODE_ELEM : set->root_type, 0); 
8720  
8721     set->ctx = (struct ly_ctx *)ctx; 
8722     set->cur_node = ctx_node; 
8723     for (set->context_op = ctx_node ? ctx_node->schema : NULL; 
8724             set->context_op && !(set->context_op->nodetype & (LYS_RPC | LYS_ACTION | LYS_NOTIF)); 
8725             set->context_op = set->context_op->parent) {} 
8726     set->tree = tree; 
8727     set->cur_mod = cur_mod; 
8728     set->format = format; 
8729     set->prefix_data = prefix_data; 
8730     set->vars = vars; 
8731  
8732     LOG_LOCSET(NULL, set->cur_node, NULL, NULL); 
8733  
8734     /* evaluate */ 
8735     rc = eval_expr_select(exp, &tok_idx, 0, set, options); 
8736     if (rc != LY_SUCCESS) { 
8737         lyxp_set_free_content(set); 
8738     } 
8739  
8740     if (set->cur_node) { 
8741         LOG_LOCBACK(0, 1, 0, 0); 
8742     } 
8743     return rc; 
8744 }
